n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Laba Dhacdo Aan Wada Dhici Karin: Ma Madaxbanaan Yihiin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Kala sooc "ma wada dhici karaan" iyo "madaxbanaan," oo sharax sababeynta adigoo isticmaalaya macnaha madaxbanaanida (ogaanshaha mid ma beddelo suurtagalnimada kan kale).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: Dhagax-ciyaareed cadaalad ah ayaa mar la tuuray. Dhacdada A waa "tuurku waa 1 ama 2," B na waa "tuurku waa 3 ama 4." Labada dhacdo isku mar ma dhici karaan. Jimin wuxuu eegay tan wuxuuna sameeyey sheegashada hoose.

n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.1: Hubi madaxbanaanida adigoo isticmaalaya ku dhufasho
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.2: Sharax sababta adigoo isticmaalaya suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: Jimin wuxuu yiri, "Dhacdooyinka A iyo B isku mar ma dhici karaan, sidaas darteed midba midka kale ma saameeyaan. Sidaas darteed way madaxbanaan yihiin." Waa kuma qiimaynta ugu habboon ee sheegashada Jimin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Naftaada ka fikir waxa ku dhaca fursadda B marka aad ogaato A inay dhacday.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii ay madaxbanaan yihiin, ogaanshaha A waa inuu suurtagalnimada B ka dhigaa isku mid sidii hore. Barbar dhig haddii xaaladdan sidaas tahay.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Khalad. Haddii aad ogtahay A inay dhacday, B mar dambe ma dhici karto, sidaas darteed suurtagalnimada B way ka duwan tahay sidii hore.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Sax. Maadaama labada dhacdo isku mar aanay dhicin, mid ma beddelo suurtagalnimada kan kale.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u akhrisay "isku mar ma dhici karaan" sida "midba midka kale ma saameeyaan." In hal dhacdo dhacdo ay kan kale ka dhigto mid aan suurtagal ahayn laftiisa waa saameyn xoog leh.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Sax. Maadaama A iyo B ay leeyihiin isla suurtagalnimo, mid midka kale ma saameeyo.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Suurtagalnimooyinka oo cabbir isku mid ah iyo madaxbanaanidu waa wax kala duwan. Madaxbanaanidu waxay ku saabsan tahay haddii suurtagalnimada hal dhacdo ay isbeddesho marka aad ogaato kan kale.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Khalad. Maadaama A iyo B ay leeyihiin suurtagalnimooyin kala duwan, mid midka kale wuu saameeyaa.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Suurtagalnimooyin kala duwan macnaheedu ma aha dhacdooyinku ma madaxbanaana. Waxa aad barbar dhigi lahayd waa haddii suurtagalnimada hal ay isbeddesho marka aad ogaato kan kale.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Haddii A iyo B isku mar aanay dhici karin mid kastaa na uu leeyahay suurtagalnimo ka weyn 0, markaas ogaanshaha A inay dhacday wuxuu suurtagalnimada B u beddelaa 0. Haddii ay madaxbanaan yihiin, P(B|A)=P(B) waa inay run noqotaa, sidaas darteed ma madaxbanaana. Dhagax-ciyaareed, marka A uu yahay 1 ama 2 B na uu yahay 3 ama 4, P(B)=1/3, laakiin haddii A dhacdo, P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Iyadoo isla tuurka dhagax-ciyaareedka hal, sidoo kale tixgeli dhacdada C (tuur lamaan ah) iyo dhacdada D (tuur 3 ama ka yar). Dooro dhammaan lammaanayaasha dhacdooyinka midba midka kale madaxbanaan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lammaane kasta, hel P(labada dhacdo dhacaan) iyo P(koowaad)×P(labaad) oo barbar dhig haddii ay siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore qor tuurarka dhacdo kasta ka tirsan oo hel tuurarka labada dhacdoba ka tirsan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad ula dhaqantay lammaane aan wada dhici karin sida madaxbanaan. Haddii mid dhaco, suurtagalnimada kan kale waxay noqotaa 0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad u tixgelisay A oo ku jira D sida "aan xiriir lahayn." Haddii A dhacdo, D hubaal ayuu dhacayaa, sidaas darteed suurtagalnimada D way isbeddeshaa.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: P(A)=1/3, P(C)=1/2, iyo P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), sidaas darteed A iyo C waa madaxbanaan yihiin. B iyo C sidoo kale waa madaxbanaan yihiin, maadaama B∩C={4} iyo 1/6=1/3×1/2. Ee A iyo D, P(A∩D)=1/3 laakiin P(A)P(D)=1/6, sidaas darteed ma madaxbanaana. Dhacdooyinku way madaxbanaan karaan xitaa marka ay is dulsaaraan, dhacdooyin aan is dulsaarin (marka suurtagalnimooyinkoodu ka weyn yihiin 0) na ma madaxbanaan karaan.

n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Haddii dhacdooyinku madaxbanaan yihiin, suurtagalnimada B waxay sii ahaan lahayd 1/3 xitaa kadib marka aan ogaanno A inay dhacday. n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Laakiin taxanaha 0+0+0+… ee Mina ku sameysay koobidda si cad ayuu u isku dhawaaqaa 0.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii taxanaha asalka ahi isku dhawaaqo, taxanaha la koobay wuxuu isku dhawaaqaa isla qiime. Laakiin ka soo horjeedkiisa ma qabto, sababtoo ah taxanaha la koobay wuxuu isticmaalaa S_2, S_4, … oo keliya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Taxanaha asalka ah sidoo kale wuu isku dhawaaqaa, isla wadar: sababtoo ah waxaan kaliya koobnay erayada
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad ku dabaqday dareenka ah in koobiddu ilaaliso wadarta labada jiho.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Waxba lama go'aamin karo: sababtoo ah wadarooyinka qayb ah ee taxanaha la koobay waa qaar ka mid ah wadarooyinka qayb ah ee asalka ah oo keliya
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad tilmaantay in taxanaha la koobay uu isticmaalo qaar ka mid ah wadarooyinka qayb ah ee asalka ah oo keliya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wadarta taxanaha asalka ahi waa 0 iyo 1 labadaba: sababtoo ah hab koob kasta wuxuu leeyahay wadar
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad tidhi taxane aan isku dhawaaqin wuxuu leeyahay laba wadar. Wadar waxaa loo qeexaa hal xad oo wadarooyinka qayb ah ah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga xisaabinta 0 ee kooxeynta ayaa u muuqatay mid macquul ah, laakiin xukunkaaga wuu is beddelay marka aad qortay isugeynta qaybta ah. Haddii taxane ururo lagu go'aamiyo ma aha sida loo kooxeeyo laakiin dhaqanka dhammaan isugeynta qaybta ah ee S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.prompt: Soyoung waxay tiri, "Kooxeynta qawsaha waxay siisay 0+0+0+…, sidaa darteed isugeynta 1−1+1−1+… waa 0." Qor sharaxaad loo diro Soyoung. Ku dar sida isugeynta qaybta ah ee taxanaha asalka ahi u dhaqmaan iyo sida isugeynta qaybta ah ee taxanaha la kooxeeyey ugu xidhan yihiin isugeynta qaybta ah ee asalka ah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore naftaada u qor S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4 oo xus sida qiimayaashu u beddelmaan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tilmaam kuwee ka mid ah isugeynta qaybta ah ee asalka ah ayaa ah isugeynta qaybta ah ee taxanaha la kooxeeyey (1−1)+(1−1)+….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma runtii hubisay qiimayaasha isugeynta qaybta ah S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay kuwee ka mid ah isugeynta qaybta ah ee asalka ah ayuu taxanaha la kooxeeyey isticmaalayo?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ka fikirtay haddii "taxanaha la kooxeeyey ururo" uu dammaanad qaado "taxanaha asalka ah ururo"?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.0: Isugeynta qaybta ah ee taxanaha asalka ah waa 1, 0, 1, 0, …, oo u kala beddelaysa 0 iyo 1 oo aan u dhowaanayn hal qiime. Sidaa darteed isugeyn ma laha. Isugeynta qaybta ah ee taxanaha la kooxeeyey waxay doortaa qaar keliya (kuwa tirada labaad ah), sida S_2, S_4, …, sidaa darteed si kediso ah ayay 0 u soo baxdaa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.1: Isugeynta qaybta ah waxay ku celinaysaa 1,0,1,0 mana ururaan. Haddii aan kooxeynta u beddelno 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, waxay siinaysaa 1, sidaa darteed qiimuhu wuxuu ku xidhan yahay kooxeynta. Taxanaha la kooxeeyey oo ah 0 waxba kuma laha isugeynta taxanaha asalka ah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: Soyoung, taxanaha asalka ah S_n waa 1 marka n ay tahay ay ka kooban tahay mid iyo 0 marka n ay tahay labo, sidaa darteed xad ma laha (wuu kala firdhaa). Kooxeynta qawsaha macnaheedu waa inaad eegto S_2, S_4, … oo keliya, kuwaas oo siinaya 0, sidaa darteed caddayn uma aha in taxanaha asalka ahi ururo.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Isugeynta lama go'aamin: sababtoo ah isugeynta qaybta ah way sii beddelaysaa weligeed oo ma yeelan karto hal qiime

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: Yuna waa sax: isugeyn qayb ahi ma la simna 1, sidaa darteed 0.999… wuu ka duwan yahay 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad sifo isugeyn qayb kasta si toos ah ugu qaadatay xadka. Xadku maaha isugeyn qayb ah mid ka mid ah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Labaduba waa sax: 0.999… wuu ka yar yahay 1 xaddi aad u yar, laakiin xisaabaha waxaa loo daweeyaa sida 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad tiri farqi togan oo 1 ka duwan ayaa hadha, oo sidoo kale waxaad tiri waxay la simanyihiin 1. Tirooyinka dhabta ah dhexdooda, laba tiro waa isku mid kaliya haddii farqigoodu yahay 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Isugeynta taxane waa xadka isugeynta qaybta ah ee S_n. Halkan S_n=1−(1/10)^n xadkuna waa 1, sidaa darteed 0.999…=1. Caddaynta Yuna waa run, laakiin "dhammaan S_n way ka yar yihiin 1" ma ka imanayso "lim S_n wuu ka yar yahay 1" (xadka dhexdiisa wuxuu noqdaa ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Hadalka Yuna "n kasta ilaa aad isku darto, isugeynta qaybta ah waxay ka yar tahay 1" waa run. Hase ahaatee gunaanadkeedu waa khalad. Sharax sababta adigoo isticmaalaya 1−S_n, qiimaha 1 laga jaray isugeynta qaybta ah S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qor S_1, S_2, S_3 oo qor farqiga mid walba ee 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isku xidh sida farqigaas u dhaqmo marka n sii weynaado iyo xadka isugeynta taxanuhu lagu go'aamiyo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ku muujisay 1−S_n sida qaacido n ah?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma isku xidhay qiimahaas oo u dhowaanaya 0 iyo isugeynta oo ah 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay in xadku noqon karo 1 xataa haddii isugeynta qaybta ah aysan weligeed gaadhin 1?

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Isugeyn qayb ahi weligeed ma gaadho 1, laakiin 1−S_n=(1/10)^n wuxuu ururaa 0. Isugeynta taxane waa xadka isugeynta qaybta ah, sidaa darteed waa 1. Xataa haddii isugeyn qayb kasta ay ka yar tahay 1, xadku wuxuu noqon karaa 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: S_n kasta wuu ka yar yahay 1, laakiin farqiga 0.00…01 wuxuu noqdaa mid aad u yar marka n sii weynaado, sidaa darteed xadku waa 1, sidaa darteed 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Naftaada u samee taxane leh isla sifadaas. Geli laba taxane joomatari oo aan dhammaad lahayn a + ar + ar² + … oo leh eray koowaad a iyo saamiga guud r oo isugeyntoodu tahay 1 oo dhammaan isugeynta qaybta ahna ay ka yar yihiin 1, adigoo isticmaalaya saamiyo guud oo kala duwan. (Waxaad geli kartaa jajab tobanle ah.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor isla'egta ay tahay inay u dhexeyso a iyo r si isugeyntu u noqoto 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Xisaabi S_1 iyo S_2 si aad u hubiso calaamadda r ay tahay inay yeelato si dhammaan isugeynta qaybta ah ay uga yaraadaan 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Qiimaha saafiga ah ee saamiga guud wuu ka yar yahay 1, sidaa darteed wuu ururaa.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Dhammaan erayadu waa togan yihiin, sidaa darteed isugeynta qaybta ah way ka yar yihiin 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Saamiga guud ma aha togan, sidaa darteed isugeyn qayb ah ayaa ka weyn karta 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Haddii a=1−r iyo 0<r<1, isugeynta qaybta ah S_n=1−r^n had iyo jeer waa ka yar tahay 1 laakiin xadkeedu waa 1. a=0.9, r=0.1 waa saxda 0.999…. Haddii r uu yahay taban, a=1−r>1, sidaa darteed isugeynta qaybta ah ee ugu horreysa horey ayay uga weyn tahay 1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee aan sax ahayn ee xalka Seojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Ma Aamini Kartaa Qiimaha Lagu Helay Isku-dhejin Qaybo?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: Isku-dhejin: khaladaadka isku-dhejinta qaybaha iyo hubinta calaamadda isku-dhejiyaha
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Hel oo sax safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka isku-dhejinta qaybaha, oo sharax sida loo hubiyo calaamadda isku-dhejin cayiman adigoo isticmaalaya calaamadda isku-dhejiyaha, iyo xadka hubintaas.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: Seojin wuxuu xalliyay ∫_0^π x sin x dx isagoo isticmaalaya isku-dhejinta qaybaha. (∫_0^π waa isku-dhejin cayiman laga bilaabo 0 ilaa π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.0: Hubi saf kasta oo xal ah
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Sii sheeg calaamadda isku-dhejin cayiman calaamadda isku-dhejiyaha
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Baar xadka hubinta ku dabaqanto (inta u dhexeysa calaamaddu is beddesho)
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Saf kasta oo bixiya shaqo cusub la helay (u', v), ku hubi shaqadaas shuruudda asalka ah.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Safka v lagu helo, naftaada kala-duw v oo hubi haddii uu la mid yahay v'.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: ∫_0^π x sin x dx, ha noqdo u=x iyo v'=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Qaacidada isku-dhejinta qaybaha, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, iyo ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed ∫_0^π x sin x dx = −π.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 ayaa ugu horreeya ee khaldama. Kala-duhaha cos x waa −sin x, sidaas darteed v oo v'=sin x waa −cos x, ma aha cos x. Laga bilaabo safka 3, v-ga khaldan si fudud ayaa lagu geliyaa qaacidada, sidaas darteed qaacidada iyo xisaabtu waa sax laakiin natiijadu waa khalad.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Hagaaji safka khaldan oo hel qiimaha ∫_0^π x sin x dx. Ka dibna, adigoo isticmaalaya calaamadda x sin x oo 0≤x≤π ah, qor hal ama laba jumladood sababta −π ee Seojin aysan u noqon karin qiimaha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Mar kale hel v oo leh v'=sin x, geli qaacidada safka 3, oo qiimee xadadka.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Miis ku hubi haddii x iyo sin x mid walba ugu yaraan 0 yahay 0≤x≤π, oo ka fikir calaamadda isku-dhafka cayiman ee shaqo ugu yaraan 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale. Haddii aan dhigno v, ..., qiimuhuna waa .... Laakiin x sin x waa ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma hagaajisay v inuu noqdo −cos x oo dib ugu celisay qaacidada?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma tilmaantay in sin x uu yahay ugu yaraan 0 0≤x≤π sidii sababtaada?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ku xidhay sifada ah haddii shaqada isku-dhafka ay tahay ugu yaraan 0, isku-dhafka cayiman waa ugu yaraan 0?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Haddii v'=sin x, markaas v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. 0≤x≤π, x≥0 iyo sin x≥0, sidaas darteed x sin x≥0, taasoo la macno ah isku-dhafka cayiman ma noqon karo taban (−π).
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Haddii aad hagaajiso v inuu noqdo −cos x, qiimuhu waa π. Kala-dhexaadka gudihiisa x sin x had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 0, sidaas darteed sida bed ma ka soo bixi karo wax ka yar 0, −π-na waa taban, taasoo is-diidmo ah.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Hadda isla shaqada ayaa la isticmaalaa, laakiin kala-dhexaadka waxaa loo beddelay [0,2π]. Dooro hadalka saxda ah ee ku saabsan habka hubinta calaamadda isku-dhafka cayiman adigoo isticmaalaya calaamadda shaqada isku-dhafka.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Hubi calaamadda sin x [π,2π] oo sawir qaabka jaantuska x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Marka ay jiraan labadaba qaybo togan iyo kuwa taban, ka fikir waxa calaamadda wadarku ku xidhan yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: x sin x waa ugu yaraan 0 [0,2π], sidaas darteed qiimuhu sidoo kale waa inuu noqdaa mid togan.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Hubi calaamadda sin x [π,2π]. Ma aadan baarin haddii calaamaddu isku mid sii ahaato marka kala-dhexaadku isbeddelo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Xitaa haddii calaamaddu isbeddesho, qaybta togan ayaa horreysa, sidaas darteed qiimuhu had iyo jeer waa togan
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad eegtay isku xigxigga oo keliya adigoon barbar dhigin cabbirrada qaybaha togan iyo kuwa taban. Qaybta tabanku waa ka weyn kartaa.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Calaamadda x sin x waxay isbeddeshaa kala-dhexaadka gudihiisa, sidaas darteed calaamadda oo keliya ma go'aamin karto calaamadda qiimaha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad xusay in hubinta calaamaddu tahay qalab lagu isticmaali karo kala-dhexaad calaamaddu hal nooc tahay.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Xitaa haddii kala-dhexaadka la kordhiyo, qaybta lagu daray way is baabbi'isaa, sidaas darteed qiimuhu waa π, la mid [0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay in kala-dhexaadka lagu daray [π,2π] uu is baabbi'in doono adigoon si toos ah u hubin isku-dhafkiisa.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: [π,2π], sin x≤0, sidaas darteed x sin x≤0. Sidaas darteed calaamaddu ma aha hal nooc kala-dhexaadka oo dhan, qaybta togan iyo qaybta tabanna waxay ku dhex galaan midba midka kale. Dhab ahaan, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, taas oo taban. Hubinta calaamaddu waxay kuu sheegtaa calaamadda qiimaha marka calaamaddu aysan isbeddelin kala-dhexaadka gudihiisa oo keliya.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Bedka Isla Aagga: Laba Qof, Laba Xal oo Kala Duwan
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Isku-dar: bed — isku-darka marka loo eego x iyo marka loo eego y (beddelidda matalaadda)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Sharax, adigoo isticmaalaya qaabka aagga, sababta isku-darka marka loo eego x iyo marka loo eego y ay siinayaan isla bed isla aag, oo xukun shuruudaha habka labaad la isticmaali karo.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Laba qof ayaa helay bedka aagga R ee ay xidhaan qalooca y=ln x, ulaha x, iyo xariiqda x=e iyagoo isticmaalaya hababka kala duwan. Jian wuxuu xalliyey ∫_1^e ln x dx isku-darka qaybaha wuxuuna helay [x ln x − x]_1^e = (e−e)−(0−1) = 1. Soyul wuxuu ka jaray ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1 bedka leydiga 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 e, wuxuuna helay e−(e−1)=1. (∫_1^e waa integral-ka go'an laga bilaabo 1 ilaa e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Ku hubi sawir aagga laga jarayo
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Shaqooyinka rogan iyo integral-yada go'an ee shaqooyinka logarithmic iyo exponential
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: Sawirka, bedka qaybtee ayaa ah ∫_0^1 eʸ dy ee Soyul ka jarayo e?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Qaado dherer y, sawir hal xariiq toosan oo ka gudba leydiga, oo hel barta qalooca ka jaro xariiqdaas.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Xariiqdaas, sheeg dhinaca qalooca, bidix ama midig, ee R yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Aagga R laftiisa, kaas oo aan rabno inaan helno bedkiisa
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Bedka R waa qiimaha lagu helo ka jarista odhaahdan e. Haddii R uu la mid ahaan lahaa aagga odhaahdan, looma baahnayn in e laga jaro.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.b: Inta harsan ee leydiga 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 kadib ka saaridda R
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad aragtay inay tahay qaybta bidixda qalooca x=eʸ, taasi waa, qaybta leydiga ee aan ahayn R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Qaybta hoose ee qalooca y=ln x oo leh 1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Qaybtaas waa si sax ah R. Soyul kama jarayo R e; wuxuu ka jarayaa inta harsan.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.d: Qaybta u dhexeysa ulaha x iyo qalooca oo leh 0<x<1
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Ee 0<x<1 qaloocu wuxuu ka hooseeyaa ulaha x, sidaas darteed ma ka tirsana R, odhaahdanna xiriir kuma laha.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Bedka leydiga 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 waa e. Dherer y kasta, barta qalooca waa x=eʸ, sidaas darteed ballaadhka qaybta bidixdeeda waa eʸ, bedkeeduna waa ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1. R waa qaybta midigta qalooca, sidaas darteed bedkeedu waa e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Raacitaanka habka Soyul, hel bedka aagga ay xidhaan y=ln x, ulaha x, iyo xariiqda x=e². Muuji ballaadhka iyo dhererka leydiga iyo integral-ka go'an ee aad ka jarayso, oo qor natiijada.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Hel dhererka qalooca x=e², y=ln e², si aad u go'aamiso dhererka leydiga.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Dherer y kasta, muuji isku-duwaha x ee qalooca marka loo eego y, ka dibna isku dar odhaahdaas laga bilaabo 0 ilaa dhererka leydiga.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Leydigu wuxuu leeyahay ballaadh ..., dherer ..., iyo ...
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma xaqiijisay in dhererka leydigu yahay ln e²=2?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma hubisay inay la jaanqaadayso qiimaha laga helay isku-darka qaybaha?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Leydigu wuxuu leeyahay ballaadh e² iyo dherer ln e²=2, sidaas darteed bedkiisu waa 2e². Qaybta bidixda qalooca waa ∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1. Sidaas darteed bedka R waa 2e² − (e²−1) = e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Iyadoo x=e², y wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 0 ilaa 2, sidaas darteed bedka leydigu waa 2e² qaybta laga jarayo na waa ∫_0^2 e^y dy=e²−1. Bedku waa 2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Habka Soyul waa la isticmaali karaa "marka qalooca loo qori karo hal odhaah oo qaabka x=h(y)." Dooro dhammaan qaloocyada hoose ee sidaas loo qori karo dhexda la bixiyey.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Qalooc kasta, qaado hal qiime y oo tiri imisa x dhexda ah ayaa leh qiimahaas y.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi haddii garaafku kor iyo hoos u socdo dhexda (ama kordhayo oo keliya).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Qiime y kasta wuxuu u dhigmaa laba qiime x (x iyo −x). Looma qori karo hal odhaah qaabka x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in y kasta uu u dhigmo hal x oo keliya (x=ln y), sidaas darteed loo qori karo hal odhaah qaabka x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Qiime y kasta wuxuu u dhigmaa laba qiime x (x iyo π−x). Looma qori karo hal odhaah qaabka x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad aragtay in y kasta uu u dhigmo hal x oo keliya (x= xididka saddex-jibbaaran ee y), sidaas darteed loo qori karo hal odhaah qaabka x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) iyo y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) waa kordhayaan dhexdooda, sidaas darteed y kasta wuxuu u dhigmaa hal x (waxay leeyihiin shaqooyin rogan). Ee y=x² ama y=sin x, waxaa jira laba x isla y, sidaas darteed sida ay yihiin looma noqon karo hal odhaah x=h(y), dhexdana waa in loo kala qaybiyo.

n-m-h3-vec-04.title: Ma xagalka u dhexeeya laba xariiq wuxuu la mid yahay xagalka u dhexeeya vector-yada jihadooda?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Fahan farqiga u dhexeeya xagalka u dhexeeya vector-yada jihada iyo xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada adigoo dib u eegaya xukunkaaga marka macluumaad la daro, oo isticmaal qaacidada saxda ah ee xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho xagalka θ ee u dhexeeya laba xariiq l iyo m diyaarada isku-duubyada. Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid. (u·v waxaa loo akhriyaa "u dot v," |u| waa cabbirka u, √5-na waxaa loo akhriyaa "xidid 5.")
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.0: Dib u eegista xukunka marka macluumaad cusub soo muuqdo
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Hubinta haddii qiimuhu isku mid yahay xitaa haddii vector-ka jihada si kale loo doorto
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.2: Sharaxaadda sababta qiimaha saafiga ah loo baahan yahay
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: Wax-ku-dhigga dot ee vector-yada diyaarada iyo xagalka u dhexeeya
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid. Marxalad kasta, dooro xukun adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda taqaanno oo keliya.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo muuqdo, hubi haddii xukunkii hore wali sax yahay.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isla xariiqda, dooro vector-ka jihada ee ka soo horjeedda, samee isla xisaabta, oo barbar dhig natiijooyinka.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxaad dooratay u=(1, 2) sidii vector-ka jihada ee xariiqda l iyo v=(1, −3) sidii vector-ka jihada ee xariiqda m. Xisaabintu waxay siinaysaa u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Sidee u xukumaysaa xagalka θ ee u dhexeeya labada xariiq?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Xagalka u dhexeeya u iyo v wuxuu leeyahay cos = −1/√2, taas oo ah, 135°. Laakiin weli lama xaqiijin haddii qiimahan loo qaadan karo xagalka u dhexeeya labada xariiq.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad xagalka u dhexeeya labada vector si toos ah ugu wareejisay xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada. Kani waa xukunka ugu horreeya ee maanka ku soo dhaca.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan hubino in qiimahani runtii qeexayo xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada, iyo haddii uu isku mid yahay marka vector-yada jihada si kale loo doorto
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad xusuustay in vector jihadu aysan ahayn hal qiime go'an xariiq kasta.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Maadaama wax-soo-saarka dot uu yahay taban, waxaan odhan karnaa labada xariiq oo keliya inaysan is-toosnayn
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad tidhi kaliya ma is-toosna. Ma go'aamin cabbirka xagalka.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Xitaa haddii aad qaadato −v=(−1, 3) sida vector-ka jihada ee xariiqda m halkii v, waa isla xariiqda m.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Xagalka u dhexeeya u iyo −v waa maxay, tanna maxay naga tustaa xagalka θ ee u dhexeeya xariiqyada?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Xagalka u dhexeeya u iyo v waa 135°, xagalka u dhexeeya u iyo −v-na waa 45°. Xitaa isla labada xariiq, qiimuhu wuu is beddelaa iyadoo ku xidhan sida vector-ka jihada loo doorto. Marka laba xariiq ay ku kulmaan, xagallo 45° iyo 135° ayaa samaysmaya, sidaas darteed waxaan u baahanahay isku raacsanaan ku saabsan kee loogu yeedho xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 iyo cos=1/√2, sidaas darteed waa 45°. Isla xariiqyada, laba xagal, 135° iyo 45°, ayaa soo baxa, sidaas darteed wax-soo-saarka dot ee calaamadda leh keligiis ma go'aamiyo xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Si toos ah ayaad u hubisay in qiimuhu is beddelo iyadoo ku xidhan sida vector-ka jihada loo doorto.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Helidda 45° waa qalad xisaabeed, 135° na waa sax
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Beddelidda −v waxay rogtaa calaamadda wax-soo-saarka dot, sidaas darteed cos wuxuu noqdaa +1/√2; tani ma aha qalad.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 iyo xagalku waa 45°, sidaas darteed 135° ee hore wuu khaldanaa xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyadana waa 45°
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sax ayaad ahayd in 45° soo baxo, laakiin waxaad seegtay in labada 135° iyo 45° ay ka yimaadeen isla labada xariiq. Waxaan u baahanahay isku raacsanaan ku saabsan kee loo qaado xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Waxaan isku raacnay in xagalka θ ee u dhexeeya laba xariiq uu yahay midka ka mid ah labada nooc ee xagal ee ku samaysmay meesha ay ku kulmaan (45° iyo 135°) ee aan ka weynayn, taasi waa, midka leh 0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Qaacidee ayaa had iyo jeer siisa θ si kasta oo vector-yada jihada loo doorto?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, sidaas darteed cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 iyo θ=45°. Xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada waa in lagu helaa qaacido qaadanaysa qiimaha saxda ah ee wax-soo-saarka dot, si isla qiime u soo baxo si kasta oo vector-yada jihada loo doorto.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Calaamaddu way is beddelaa iyadoo ku xidhan doorashada vector-ka jihada, sidaas darteed waxaa laga yaabaa inaysan ku habboonayn isku raacsanaanta θ inuu u dhexeeyo 0° iyo 90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Isticmaalka qiimaha saxda ah ee wax-soo-saarka dot wuxuu siinayaa isla qiime xitaa haddii vector-ka jihada la rogo, cosθ≥0 na, sidaas darteed θ waa ugu badnaan 90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waa sax marka −v la isticmaalo oo keliya; haddii si kale loo doorto calaamaddu way kala duwan tahay, sidaas darteed ma aha qaacido had iyo jeer sax ah.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga waxaad si toos ah u beddeshay xagalka u dhexeeya vector-yada jihada xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada, laakiin xukunkaagu wuu is beddelay marka macluumaadka lagu daray in xitaa isla xariiqda ay leedahay vector-yo jihada oo laba jiho oo ka soo horjeeda ah. Xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada waa inuu noqdaa cabbir aan is beddelin calaamadda vector-ka jihada, sidaas darteed waxaan ku helnaa adigoo qaadanaya qiimaha saxda ah ee wax-soo-saarka dot.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: Vector-ka jihada ee xariiqda p waa (2, 1) vector-ka jihada ee xariiqda q-na waa (1, −3). Hel qiimaha cosθ ee xagalka θ u dhexeeya labada xariiq, oo hal jumlad ku qor sababta qaacidadu u baahan tahay qiime sax ah.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hel qiimaha wax-soo-saarka dot iyo cabbirka labada vector, oo geli qaacidada.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Samee isla xisaabtaas adigoo isticmaalaya (−1, 3), kan ka soo horjeeda vector-ka jihada (1, −3), oo barbar dhig natiijooyinka.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: tus. cosθ = ... Qiimaha saxda ah ayaa loo baahan yahay sababtoo ah ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma xisaabisay qiimaha u·v iyo cabbirka labada vector?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma barbar dhigtay xagalka soo baxa haddii aad isticmaasho wax-soo-saarka dot sida uu yahay marka uu taban yahay?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ku xidhay sababta qiimaha saxda ah "sida vector-ka jihada loo doorto"?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 iyo cabbirradu waa √5 iyo √10, sidaas darteed cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Haddii aan rogno vector-ka jihada, calaamadda wax-soo-saarka dot way is beddelaa, sidaas darteed waxaan u baahanahay qiimaha saxda ah si xagalka u dhexeeya xariiqyada si gaar ah loo go'aamiyo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa −1 iyo |p|=√5, |q|=√10, sidaas darteed cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Waxaan isticmaalnaa qiimaha saxda ah sababtoo ah waxaan isku raacnay in xagalka u dhexeeya laba xariiq uu yahay ugu badnaan 90°, waxaanan rabnaa isla qiime si kasta oo vector-yada jihada loo doorto.

n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga marka macluumaadku kordho
n-m-h3-dist-06.title: Haddii Lacag Jeer Badan La Tuuro, Ma Saxda Badh Ayaa Madax Noqonaysa?
n-m-h3-dist-06.topic: Qaybinta ixtimaalka: qaybinta laba-geesood iyo tirada tijaabooyinka
n-m-h3-dist-06.goal: Tallaabo-tallaabo hubi sida ixtimaalka "saxda badh" iyo ixtimaalka "badh agtiisa" ay si kala duwan u dhaqdhaqaaqaan marka tirada tijaabooyinku kororto, oo dib u eeg fikraddaada koowaad.
n-m-h3-dist-06.material: Ha noqdo X tirada madaxa marka qadaadiic cadaalad ah la tuuro. Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid. (Itimaalka tuuris badan waxaa lagu helay xisaabiye.)
n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.1: Kala saar itimaalka qiime sax ah iyo itimaalka baaxad
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.prompt: Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun ku salaysan wixii aad ilaa hadda taqaanno.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo muuqdo, ka fikir haddii jawaabta isla su'aasha ay tahay inay isbeddesho.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dhig dhinac-dhinac itimaalka helista 4, 5, iyo 6 madax 10 tuuris, oo eeg sida tirooyinka ku dhow noocan ah ay u isbeddelaan marka tirada tuurista weynaato.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Qiyaastii intee ayay u badan tahay inaad hesho si sax ah 5 madax?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.after: C(10,5)/2¹⁰=252/1024≈0.246. Inkasta oo tani tahay tirada ugu badan ee suurtagalka ah, itimaalkeedu waa qiyaastii 25% oo keliya.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Qiyaastii 50%: sababtoo ah si sax ah badh waa natiijada ugu dabiiciga ah
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in helista badh ay tahay natiijada ugu dabiiciga ah, sidaas darteed itimaalkeedu waa inuu noqdaa 50%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Qiyaastii 25%: sababtoo ah waa tirada dhexe, laakiin waxay la wadaagtaa itimaal tirooyinka ku dhow sida 4 iyo 6
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in xitaa tirada dhexe ee ugu badan ay la wadaagto itimaalkeeda tirooyinka agteeda ku jira.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ka yar 5%: sababtoo ah gaarista tirada saxda ah waa dhif
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay in gaarista tirada saxda ah ay aad u dhif tahay.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Markan waxaad qadaadiicda tuurtaa 100 jeer, su'aashuna waa itimaalka helista si sax ah 50 madax.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee ay ula barbar dhigantaa qiyaastii 25% ee 10 tuuris?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.after: C(100,50)/2¹⁰⁰≈0.080. Marka tirada tuurista weynaato, itimaalka "si sax ah badh" runtii wuu yaraadaa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wuu yaraadaa: sababtoo ah waxaa jira tirooyin ku dhow oo aad u badan oo leh itimaal la mid ah
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad aragtay in tirooyin badan oo ku dhow ay leeyihiin itimaal la mid ah tirada dhexe, sidaas darteed saamiga hal qiime oo dhexe wuu yaraadaa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wuu weynaadaa: sababtoo ah marka aad badan tuurto, ayaad badh u dhowaan
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad u malaysay in marka aad badan tuurto, badh ay si sax ah u soo baxdo.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Wuxuu sii ahaadaa qiyaastii isku mid: sababtoo ah weli waa badh iyo badh
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad eegtay oo keliya xaqiiqada ah in uu yahay badh iyo badh mana aadan arkin saameynta tirada tuurista ee la beddelay.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Hadda su'aashu waa itimaalka in, 100 tuuris, saamiga madaxa uu u dhexeeyo 40% iyo 60% oo ay ku jiraan (40 ilaa 60 madax). 10 tuuris, itimaalka helista 4 ilaa 6 madax waa qiyaastii 66%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Itimaalka 40 ilaa 60 madax waa qiyaastii 0.965. Itimaalka si sax ah 50 wuu hoos u dhacay, laakiin itimaalka ku dhaca agagaarka badh runtii wuu kordhay.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ka hooseeya 66%: sababtoo ah itimaalka si sax ah badh sidoo kale wuu hoos u dhacay
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in maadaama itimaalka si sax ah badh uu yaraaday, itimaalka agagaarka badh sidoo kale uu yaraaday.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Qiyaastii 8%: sababtoo ah itimaalka 100 tuuris wuxuu ahaa 8%
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad ku khaldantay itimaalka si sax ah 50 itimaalka baaxad.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ka badan 90%: sababtoo ah natiijooyinka way isugu uruuriyaan agagaarka badh
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad eegtay itimaalka isku-dhafan ee baaxadda agagaarka badh, ma aha qiime sax ah.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga waa fudud in la yiraahdo "marka aad badan tuurto, badh ayaa si sax ah u soo baxda." Laakiin marka tirada tuurista weynaato, itimaalka si sax ah badh wuu hoos u dhacaa, halka itimaalka in saamiga madaxu ku dhaco agagaarka badh uu kordho. n-m-h3-serieslim-02.topic: Taxane: wadarooyin qayb ah iyo taxane juqraafi ah oo aan dhammaad lahayn
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.title: Hubinta Xal Helay Eray Guud Laga Bilaabo Qaacidada Isugeynta Qaybta ah

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.material: Isugeynta n erayada ugu horreeya ee taxane waa S_n = 4 − 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Akhri xalka Minjae ee helitaanka isugeynta taxanahan. ((1/2)^(n−1) macnaheedu waa badh awoodda n−1.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.0: Helitaanka sadarka ugu horreeya ee xalka halkaas oo uu ka khaldamay
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.2: Hubinta habka kale (xadka isugeynta qaybta ah)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.3: Helitaanka shuruudda qaacidada ay sidoo kale run ugu tahay n=1
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.prereq.1: Qaacidada isugeynta taxane joomatari oo aan dhammaad lahayn
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka ugu horreeya ee xalka Minjae halkaas oo uu ka khaldamay.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar-sadar u hubi haddii sadar kasta runtii uu ka imanayo kii hore.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Isugeynta taxanuhu waa lim S_n, n ≥ 2 na, a_n = S_n − S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Iyadoo la malaynayo in qaacidadan loo isticmaali karo n=1 sidoo kale, deji a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) n kasta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Kani waa taxane joomatari oo aan dhammaad lahayn oo leh eray koowaad 3 iyo saamiga guud 1/2, sidaa darteed isugeyntu waa 3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Waa sadarka 3. S_n−S_(n−1) waxaa loo isticmaali karaa kaliya n≥2, sidaa darteed in qaacidada la helay ay sidoo kale run tahay n=1 waa in si gooni ah loo hubiyo. Halkan a_1=S_1=4−3=1, laakiin gelinta n=1 qaacidada waxay siinaysaa 3, kaas oo ka duwan. Xisaabaha sadarrada 1 iyo 2 waa sax, sadarka 4 na waa natiijo raacaysa sadarka 3.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.prompt: Saxo xalka Minjae oo hel isugeynta taxanahan. Kadibna si toos ah u hel eraygii koowaad a_1, la barbar dhig qiimaha Minjae, oo qor sababta isugeyntu u beddelmayso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Si toos ah u hel xadka S_n oo la barbar dhig qiimaha Minjae helay.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.1: Geli qaacidada si aad u hesho a_1 S_1, kadibna la barbar dhig qiimaha aad hesho marka aad n=1 gelisid qaacidada erayga guud ee Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma si gooni ah u xisaabisay a_1=S_1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay haddii qaacidada loo helay n≥2 sidoo kale run tahay n=1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma mar labaad hubisay isugeynta lim S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.0: a_1=S_1=4−3=1. Laakiin gelinta n=1 3·(1/2)^(n−1) waxay siinaysaa 3, sidaa darteed a_1 way ka duwan tahay. Sidaa darteed a_1=1, n≥2 na erayga waa 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Isugeyntu waa 1+(3/2)/(1−1/2)=1+3=4, taasoo sidoo kale la simanyahay lim S_n=4.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.2: Si toos ah u qaadista xadka S_n waxay siinaysaa 4−0=4, 6 ee Minjae qoray na waa qiimaha leh 3 dheeraad ah sababtoo ah wuxuu si khalad ah u qaatay a_1 inuu yahay 3. a_1 dhabta ah waa S_1=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.3: lim S_n=4. a_1=S_1=1, laakiin Minjae wuxuu u qaatay 3. Sidaa darteed jawaabta saxda ahi waa 4, ma aha 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: S_n kasta oo hoose, dooro midka qaacidada erayga guud ee loo helay n≥2 ay sidoo kale sidaas u run tahay n=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qaacido kasta, hel S_1 oo la barbar dhig qiimaha aad hesho marka aad n=1 gelisid qaacidada laga helay S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qaacido kasta, ku beddel qiimayaal kala duwan oo n ah S_n oo isbarbar dhig, oo ka raadi wax is waafaqsan qaacidooyinka halkaas oo S_1 si toos ah loo xisaabiyey uu la simanyahay qiimaha qaacidada a_1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.a: Kani waa taxanaha Minjae. a_1=1 laakiin qaacidadu waxay siinaysaa 3, sidaa darteed ma is waafaqayso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.b: a_1=S_1=1, laakiin gelinta n=1 qaacidada 2·(1/2)^(n−1) n≥2 waxay siinaysaa 2, sidaa darteed ma is waafaqayso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.c: a_1=S_1=3, gelinta n=1 qaacidada 3·(1/2)^(n−1) n≥2 na sidoo kale waxay siinaysaa 3, sidaa darteed way is waafaqaysaa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.d: a_1=S_1=7/2, laakiin gelinta n=1 qaacidada 3·(1/2)^n n≥2 waxay siinaysaa 3/2, sidaa darteed ma is waafaqayso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.explain: Haddii gelinta n=0 qaacidada S_n ay siinayso S_0=0 (c: 6−6=0), qaacidadu sidoo kale run ayay tahay n=1. Kuwa kale, S_0 waa −2, −1, 2 si kala horreyn ah, sidaa darteed a_1 waa in si gooni ah loo helo.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Marka x Yahay 0, Isugeynta Taxanuhu Ma Isla Qaacidada Ayay Bixisaa?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Taxane joomatari oo saamigiisa guud uu ku beddelmayo x, baar xadka qaacidada isugeyntu ku dhaqmaan, oo sharax in xisaabinta gooni ah x=0 ay muujinayso in isugeyntu ay ka duwan tahay barta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Tiro dhab ah x, ha noqoto f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Waa taxane leh eray koowaad x² halkaas oo erayga xiga mid walba lagu dhufto 1/(1+x²).) Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gabal markiiba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Dib u eegidda xukunkaaga marka macluumaadku kordho
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.1: Hubinta shuruudda lagu dabaqo qaacidada (eray koowaad ≠ 0)
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.2: Tijaabinta adigoo si toos ah u gelinaya qiimaha xadka
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub yimaado, mar kale hubi haddii qaacidada aad hore u isticmaashay weli sidaas ku dhaqanto.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Si toos ah geli x=0 oo qor waxa dhowr eray ee ugu horreeya yihiin.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Qaacido noocee ah ayaad filaysaa f(x) inuu noqdo tiro dhab ah x kasta?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² waa qaacido la helay ka dib marka la baabi'iyey. Xusuuso inuu jiro x oo x² la baabi'iyey uu yahay 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: sababtoo ah labada qiime labaduba waxay la jaanqaadaan 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad qaacido ku habboon laba bar u kordhisay x kasta. Kani waa xukunka ugu horreeya ee maskaxda ku soo dhaca.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², laakiin x oo saamiga guud uu yahay mid aan caadi ahayn waa in si gooni ah loo baaro
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad shaki ka qabtaa haddii natiijooyinka laba bar ay quseeyaan x kasta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: sababtoo ah qaacido kale ayaa sidoo kale ku habboon karta labada qiime
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: x=1 wuxuu siinayaa 2 x=2 na wuxuu siinayaa 4.25, sidaa darteed mid ka mid ah labada qiime ma ku habboona. Ma gelin si aad u hubiso qaacidada.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Hadda tixgeli xaaladda x=0. Si toos ah geli x=0 qaacidada qeexidda ee f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Xataa haddii saamiga guud uu yahay 1, haddii eraygii koowaad yahay 0 markaas isugeyn qayb kasta waa 0, sidaa darteed wuxuu ururaa 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 1: sababtoo ah waxaan ku dari karnaa x=0 qaacidada 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad ku dabaqday qaacidada laga helay x≠0 x=0 sida ay tahay.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: sababtoo ah erayo kasta waa 0, sidaas darteed dhammaan wadarrada qayb ahaaneed waa 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad ka bilowday qeexidda oo si toos ah u xisaabisay wadarrada qayb ahaaneed.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Lama go'aamin: sababtoo ah saamiga guud waa 1, sidaas darteed wuu kala duwan yahay
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay in saamiga guud 1 uu mar walba kala duwan yahay. Waxaad ka tagtay xaaladda halka erayga koowaad uu yahay 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Si loo soo koobo, f(x)=1+x² haddii x≠0, f(0)=0 na haddii x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hadalkee ayaa sax ah ee ku saabsan xadka f(x) marka x→0 iyo joogtonimada x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Eray kasta waa joogto, laakiin wadarta f waa jabtay x=0. Wadar aan dhammaad lahayn, "haddii eray kasta joogto yahay, wadartu waa joogto" mar walba run ma aha.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Xadku waa 1 f(0)=0 na, sidaas darteed f ma joogto x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad ku xukuntay joogtonimada adigoo barbar dhigaya qiimaha xadka iyo qiimaha shaqada.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Eray kasta waa shaqo joogto ah, sidaas darteed wadarta f waa joogto x kasta
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad ku dabaqday sifo run ah wadarrada dhammaadka leh wadar aan dhammaad lahayn sida ay tahay.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Xadka iyo f(0) labaduba waa 0, sidaas darteed f waa joogto x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ma hubin halka qaacidada 1+x² ee x≠0 ay aado marka x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii waxaad rabtay inaad isticmaasho qaacidada ku habboon laba bar x kasta, laakiin xukunkaagu wuu isbeddelay markaad hubisay shuruudda x²≠0 ee lagu isticmaalay baabi'inta. Marka la isticmaalayo qaacidada, waa inaad si toos ah u tijaabisaa qiime xad ah haddii shuruudaha qaacidadu run tahay ay ku dabaqmaan xaaladdan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Eray kasta x²/(1+x²)^n waa shaqo joogto ah ee x. Qor waxa f(0) tahay x=0, iyo sida ay uga duwan tahay qaacidada 1+x² ee x≠0, oo sabab la socota.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.0: Si toos ah u beddel x=0 qaacidada qeexidda f oo qor dhowr eray oo ugu horreeya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.1: Marka la isticmaalayo qaacidada wadarta isku xigga joomatari, hubi haddii ay jirto xaalad halka qaybiyuhu noqdo 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma runtii beddelay x=0 oo qortay dhowr eray oo ugu horreeya?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka fikirtay haddii qaacidada laga helay x≠0 loo isticmaali karo x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma tiri xitaa haddii eray kasta joogto yahay, wadartu laga yaabaa inaysan joogto ahayn?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Haddii x=0, eray kasta waa 0²/1^n=0, sidaas darteed f(0)=0. Laakiin haddii x≠0, f(x)=1+x², sidaas darteed x=0 agteeda qiimayaashiisu waxay ku dhow yihiin 1. Sidaas darteed xadka 1 wuu ka duwan yahay f(0)=0, f na waa joogto la'aan x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Beddelka x=0 wuxuu siinayaa saamiga guud 1, laakiin eray kasta laga bilaabo kan koowaad waa 0, sidaas darteed wadartu waa 0. Tani way ka duwan tahay 1, taasoo aad hesho marka aad 0 gelisid 1+x², f na waa jabtay x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: Qaacidada 1+x² waxaa loo isticmaalaa x≠0 oo keliya. Haddii x=0, dhammaan erayadu waa 0 sidaas darteed wadartu waa 0, taasna way ka duwan tahay 1+0²=1, sidaas darteed shaqadu bartaas kuma xidhna.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Haddii x=0, saamiga guud wuxuu noqonayaa 1 sidaas darteed qaacidada lama isticmaali karo, dhammaan erayadu na waa 0, sidaas darteed f(0)=0. Taasi way ka duwan tahay 1, taasoo aad hesho marka aad 0 gelisid 1+x².
