n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Hubinta xal ku saabsan aagga saddex-xagalka PF₁F₂
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Garo in xataa xal xisaabihiisa oo dhan ay sax yihiin uu gunaanad macno daran yeelan karo haddii aadan hubin in shuruudda dhibaatadu runtii run noqon karto, oo hel xadka shuruuddu run tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Buug shaqo ayaa leh dhibaatadan iyo jawaabtan: "Ha noqdaan F₁ iyo F₂ labada xudun ee ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1. Barta P ee ellipse-ka marka ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, hel aagga saddex-xagalka PF₁F₂. (Jawaab: 16)" Hoos waxaa ah xalka helaya jawaabtan.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Kala saar haddii sadar kasta oo xalka ah uu yahay xisaab ama aqbalid shuruud
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Tijaabi haddii shuruudda la bixiyey runtii run noqon karto adigoo tijaabinaya booska xad-dhaaf
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Hel xadka halbeegga ee shuruuddu run tahay
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Sadar kasta oo xalka hoose ah waa sax xisaab ahaan. Laakiin jawaabta 16 ee dhibaatadan way adag tahay in la rumaysto. Dooro sadarka ugu horreeya ee ka dhigaya jawaabta mid adag in la rumaysto.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kala saar haddii sadar kasta uu ka yimid sadarkii hore xisaab ahaan ama si fudud u aqbalayo shuruud laga qaaday dhibaatada.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isku geyn natiijada sadarka aqbalaya shuruud iyo natiijada sadar kale oo hore loo helay, oo geli tirooyin si aad u aragto haddii labaduba isla mar run noqon karaan.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1, a=5 iyo b=4, sidaa darteed c²=a²−b²=9, c=3, iyo F₁(−3, 0), F₂(3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Qeexidda ellipse, PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a = 10, iyo F₁F₂ = 6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Maadaama ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, aragtida Pythagorean PF₁² + PF₂² = F₁F₂² = 36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Maadaama (PF₁ + PF₂)² = PF₁² + PF₂² + 2·PF₁·PF₂, waxaan helnaa 100 = 36 + 2·PF₁·PF₂, sidaa darteed PF₁·PF₂ = 32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Waa sadarka 3. Sadarkan wuxuu qaatay "∠F₁PF₂=90°" ee dhibaatada ku qoran sida la bixiyey wuxuuna dejiyey isla'ego. Laakiin maadaama PF₁+PF₂=10 sadarka 2, PF₁²+PF₂² waa kan ugu yar marka labada dherer ay isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 5²+5²=50. Ma noqon karo 36, sidaa darteed ma jirto bar P oo noocaas ah ellipse-ka. Sadarrada 4 iyo 5 waa xisaabo ka soo baxa natiijada sadarka 3, sidaa darteed inkastoo xisaabuhu sax yihiin, waa macno la'aan.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Sharax, adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyinka ku jira xalka, sababta aadan u rumaysan karin jawaabta 16. Sidoo kale qor waxa saxda ah ee laga odhan karo dhibaatadan.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir qiimaha ugu yar ee PF₁²+PF₂² qaadan karo marka PF₁+PF₂ la go'o 10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sawir shaxan si aad u saadaaliso meesha ∠F₁PF₂ ugu weyn yahay marka P ay ku socoto ellipse-ka, oo qiyaas xagalka halkaas.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma si toos ah u isticmaashay tirooyinka xalka (36, 10, 50, iwm.) sharaxaaddaada?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ku sheegtay gunaanadkaaga qaabka "shuruuddu run ma noqon karto" halkii aad ka odhan lahayd "xisaabtu waa khalad"?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma garatay in tan lagu hubin karo sidoo kale shaxan ama booska xad-dhaaf (dhammaadka dhidibka yar)?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Haddii PF₁+PF₂=10, isugeynta labajibbaarrada waa tan ugu yar marka labada dherer ay isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed waa ugu yaraan 5²+5²=50. Laakiin sadarka 3 wuxuu yiri 36, sidaa darteed tani waa is-diidmo. Bar P oo noocaas ah ma jirto, 16 na waa qiime macno daran.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: Dhammaadka dhidibka yar (0, 4), PF₁=PF₂=5 iyo F₁F₂=6, sidaa darteed 25+25>36, taasoo macnaheedu yahay ∠F₁PF₂ wuu ka yar yahay 90° barta. Xagalkan wuxuu halkaas ku yahay kan ugu weyn ellipse-ka, sidaa darteed ma jirto bar uu yahay 90°. Sidaa darteed aagga lama heli karo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Jawaabta 16 sax ma aha. Haddii isugeyntu tahay 10, isugeynta labajibbaarrada waa ugu yaraan 50, laakiin waa 36, sidaa darteed ma is waafaqayso. Bar noocaas ah ma jirto.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 sax ma aha. Haddii isugeynta labada dherer tahay 10, isugeynta labajibbaarrada ma noqon karto 36, sidaa darteed P noocaas ah ma jirto.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Hadda ellipse-ka u beddel x²/25 + y²/b² = 1 (0 < b < 5). Hel oo geli saddex qiime oo kala duwan oo b ah oo bar P leh ∠F₁PF₂ = 90° runtii ku jirto ellipse-ka.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore eeg sida masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun u beddesho marka b uu sii weynaado.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qiime kasta oo b ah, qiyaas haddii xagalka barta ellipse-ka ee ∠F₁PF₂ ugu weyn yahay uu gaadho 90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Waa inay noqotaa tiro xadka 0<b<5 ku jirta.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: b-gan, bar leh ∠F₁PF₂=90° ayaa ku jirta ellipse-ka.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Si xudumuhu u arkaan bar P ellipse-ka ah 90°, ∠F₁PF₂ waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 90° dhammaadka dhidibka yar, halkaas oo xagalku ugu weyn yahay. Tani waxay dhacdaa marka c ≥ b, taasi waa, marka 25−b² ≥ b². Sidaa darteed b² ≤ 12.5, 0<b<5 na, bar P way jirtaa marka b uu yahay ugu badnaan ku dhawaad 3.54. b=3.5 wuu shaqeeyaa, laakiin 3.6 ma shaqeeyo.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Maxaa kale oo aan u baahanahay si aan u go'aamino isla'egta hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Xukun haddii macluumaad ku filan jiro si loo go'aamiyo isla'egta qalooc adigoo isbarbar dhigaya tirada aan la aqoon iyo tirada isla'egyada madaxbannaan.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Buug shaqo ayaa leh dhibaatada "Hel isla'egta hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (a>0, b>0) leh xudumo (5, 0) iyo (−5, 0)." Macallinku wuxuu yiri, "Dhibaatadan hal shuruud ayaa ka maqan." Waxaad rabtaa inaad dhammaystirto dhibaatada adigoo buuxinaya shuruudda maqan.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.0: Tirinta isla'egyada macluumaadka la bixiyey soo saaro
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.1: Kala saarista waxa aad hore u taqaanay iyo macluumaad cusub
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Muujinta in macluumaadku aanu ku filnayn adigoo isticmaalaya tusaale lid ku ah (qalooc kale oo leh isla xudumaha)
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Qaabka caadiga ah x²/a²−y²/b²=1 ee hyperbola, iyo macnaha xudumaha, fiiqaannada, iyo asymptote-yada
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qaybaha macluumaadka, marka lagu daro macluumaadka ah in xudumuhu yihiin (5, 0) iyo (−5, 0) iyadoo ah ku-darka keliya, go'aamiya a iyo b si gaar ah. (a>0, b>0)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hal mar qor haddii qayb kasta oo macluumaad ah ay bixiso isla'ego cusub oo isku xidhaysa a iyo b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore ka shaqee isla'egta isku xidhaysa a iyo b ee horey u jirta marka kaliya xudumaha la og yahay.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.b: Masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun waa 10.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: Tan horey ayaa looga ogaa isku-xidhka xudumaha (±5, 0), sidaa darteed ma aha macluumaad cusub. Weli waxaa jirta hal oo keliya ee isla'egyada loo baahan yahay ee isku xidhaya a iyo b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.c: Jiirka mid ka mid ah asymptote-yada waa 4/3.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.d: Qalloocku wuxuu isku mid yahay asalka.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Tani had iyo jeer way run tahay qalooc kasta oo qaabka x²/a²−y²/b²=1 ah. Maaha macluumaad cusub oo ku saabsan a iyo b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Gelinta x=0 waxay siinaysaa −y²/b²=1, sidaa darteed hyperbola qaabkan ah weligeed ma kulanto dhidibka y. Maaha macluumaad cusub oo ku saabsan a iyo b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Macluumaadka xudumuhu wuxuu siinayaa hal isla'ego oo keliya, a²+b²=25. Fiiqaanka (3, 0) wuxuu siinayaa a=3, sidaa darteed b=4 waa go'aamiyey, jiirka asymptote 4/3 na wuxuu siinayaa b/a=4/3, sidaa darteed a=3 iyo b=4 waa go'aamiyeen. Masaafada xudumaha oo ah 10, isku-midka asalka, iyo in aan la kulmin dhidibka y waa horey loo yaqaanay ama had iyo jeer run, sidaa darteed isla'ego ma darayaan.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee laba hyperbola oo qaabab kala duwan leh oo leh xudumo (5, 0) iyo (−5, 0) oo ah qaabka x²/a² − y²/b² = 1, oo geli (a, b). (Haddii aad qorto jajab tobanle ah, isticmaal laba lambar oo tobanle ah.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Geli qiimaha c isla'egta ka dhex jirta a, b, iyo c ee hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro hal qiime oo a ah oo buuxiya isla'egtaas oo hubi waxa b noqonayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa togan yihiin.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a iyo b waa inay noqdaan togan.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Haddii xudumuhu isku mid yihiin, c=5, sidaa darteed a²+b²=25. Maaha kaliya (3, 4) iyo (4, 3) laakiin sidoo kale lammaanayaasha sida (2, ku dhawaad 4.58) dhammaantood waa suurtagal, sidaa darteed waxaa jira hyperbola aan tiro lahayn oo qaabab kala duwan leh.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sharax sababta hyperbola kala duwan ay u soo baxaan inkastoo xudumuhu isku mid yihiin.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tiri imisa isla'ego oo isku xidhaysa a iyo b ayaa jira iyo imisa tirooyin aan la aqoon.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lammaane kasta oo labada lammaane ee aad samaysay ah xisaabi a²+b² oo isbarbar dhig.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay in hal isla'ego oo keliya ay u dhexeyso a iyo b?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay laba ama in ka badan tusaalayaal (a, b) oo buuxiya isla'egtaas?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Haddii xudumuhu yihiin (±5, 0), markaas c=5, hyperbola-na hal isla'ego oo keliya ayaa soo baxda: a²+b²=c²=25. Waxaa jira laba tiro oo aan la aqoon, a iyo b, sidaa darteed b wuu is beddelaa iyadoo ku xidhan sida a loo doorto, waxaana jira qalooc aan tiro lahayn.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Waxaa nala siiyey a²+b²=25 oo keliya, sidaa darteed (3, 4) wuu shaqeeyaa, (4, 3) wuu shaqeeyaa, kuwa kale oo badan sidoo kale. Sidaa darteed xudumaha oo keliya si gaar ah ma go'aamiyaan.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: Markan, dooro hab loo isticmaali karo qalooc aan ahayn hyperbola. Marka aad hesho macluumaad cusub, waa maxay habka ugu lagu kalsoonaan karo ee lagu go'aamiyo haddii macluumaadkaas keligiis uu qalloocka si gaar ah u go'aamiyo?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dhinac-dhinac dhig tirada isla'egyada laga helay labada macluumaad ee ilaa hadda la isticmaalay iyo tirada tirooyinka aan la aqoon.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir sida hal macluumaad cusub u beddelo tirooyinkaas.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Go'aami adigoo eegaya haddii macluumaadka cusubi ka kooban yahay tirooyin gaar ah.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Xataa haddii ay jiraan tirooyin, waxay ku celin karaan wax horey loo yaqaanay (tusaale, masaafada xudumaha). Jiritaanka tirooyinku ma noqon karo halbeegga.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Hubi haddii uu bixinayo hal isla'ego oo dheeraad ah oo isku xidhaysa a iyo b oo ka duwan shuruudda xudumaha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Hubi haddii qalloocka lagu sawiri karo macluumaadka cusub.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Awoodda lagu sawiri karo shax macnaheedu maaha in tirooyinka la go'aamiyey. Waa inaad go'aamisaa haddii la go'aamiyey adigoo isticmaalaya isla'egyo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Go'aami adigoo eegaya haddii macluumaadka cusub lagu muujiyey si la mid ah xudumaha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Habka wax loo muujiyo waxba kuma laha cabbirka macluumaadka. Waxa muhiimka ah waa isla'egta uu ku darayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Si gaar ah loo go'aamiyo, waxaad u baahan tahay isla'egyo madaxbannaan oo la mid ah tirada tirooyinka aan la aqoon. Xudumuhu waxay siiyeen hal isla'ego a iyo b na waa laba tiro oo aan la aqoon, sidaa darteed waa inaad hubisaa haddii macluumaadka cusubi bixinayo hal isla'ego oo dheeraad ah oo ka duwan waxa horey loo yaqaanay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xataa laba isla'ego xalku laga yaabaa inuusan gaar ahayn, sidaa darteed ugu dambayn xalli si aad u xaqiijiso.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Dhisidda xariiqyada taabanaya hyperbola adigoo adiga
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Naftaada samee dhowr xariiq oo taabanaya, ogow in ay jirto baaxad janjeerayaal ah oo xariiq taabanaya ay jirto, oo sharax tan adigoo isticmaalaya kala-saaraha.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: Waxaa jira hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1. Waxaad ogaan doontaa xariiqyada y = mx + k ee taabanaya qalooca adigoo iyaga naftaada dhisaya.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Naftaada dhis xariiqyo taabanaya oo hel qaabka
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Xiriirka goobta ee xariiq iyo conic (isla'egaha isku-mar)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Dhis saddex xariiq oo kala duwan y = mx + k oo taabanaya hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 oo gali (m, k). (Isticmaal tobanaadyo saddex god tobanaad ah.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Geli isla'egta xariiqda isla'egta hyperbola si aad u samayso isla'eg x ah.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir xaaladda isla'egtaasi ay tahay inay ku jirto si xariiqdu ugu taabato qalooca si sax ah hal bar.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Beddelka xariiqda wuxuu siinayaa isla'eg laba-jibbaaran x ah.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Janjeerahan, beddelka xariiqda ma siinayo isla'eg laba-jibbaaran.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c2: Isla'egta laba-jibbaarani waxay leedahay xidid labajeer ah (taabasho).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Xariiqdani ma taabato hyperbola (kala-saaruhu ma aha 0).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Beddelka y=mx+k 9x²−4y²=36 waxay siinaysaa (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. Kala-saaruhu waa 144(k²+9−4m²), sidaas darteed si loo taabto, k²=4m²−9. Tusaale ahaan, haddii m=2.5, markaas k²=16, sidaas darteed k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Xusuuso xariiqyada aad hore u dhistay. Dooro dhammaan janjeerayaasha uu xariiq y = mx + k oo taabanaya hyperbola-gan uu jiro.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qor shuruudda kala-saaraha isla'egta aad hore u dejisay inuu noqdo 0 sida isla'eg k² ah.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Janjeer m kasta, go'aami haddii k² ay noqon lahayd taban.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Xariiq toosan y=k waxay ka gudubtaa mid kasta oo laba laamood ee hyperbola hal mar ama midna ma kulanto. Weligeed ma taabto.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Waxay u muuqataa inaad u malaysay in janjeer yar uu leeyahay xariiq taabanaya. Haddii aad qaaciddada taabashada ellipse k²=a²m²+b² sidii ay tahay u gudbiso, waxaad helaysaa k=±√13, laakiin xariiqdani waxay kulantaa hyperbola laba bar.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Si loo taabto, k²=4m²−9≥0 ayaa loo baahan yahay, marka laga reebo xaaladda la barbar socota asymptote (janjeer ±3/2), 4m²>9, taasi waa, |m|>3/2. Janjeerayaasha 2 iyo −3 way shaqeeyaan; ee 0 iyo 1, k² waa taban, sidaas darteed ma shaqeeyaan.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Xariiq leh janjeer 1 ma taabto hyperbola-gan. Sharax sababta, oo sharax baaxadda janjeerayaasha m ee xariiq taabanaya uu jiro.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Beddel m=1 oo hel k ka dhigaya kala-saaraha 0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Shaqee baaxadda m ay tahay inay ku jirto si k² aanu u noqon taban.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday sababta adigoo isticmaalaya kala-saaraha (ama calaamadda k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri xadka baaxadda uu ku xidhan yahay janjeerka asymptotes?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Beddelka y=x+k waxay siinaysaa kala-saaraha 144(k²+5), kaas oo weligiis ma noqon karo 0. Si uu u noqdo xariiq taabanaya, k²=4m²−9≥0 ayaa loo baahan yahay, sidaas darteed qiimaha saafiga ah ee m waa inuu ka weyn yahay 3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Iyadoo janjeer 1, k²=−5, sidaas darteed k dhab ah ma jiro oo sidaas darteed xariiq taabanaya ma jiro. Janjeerayaasha xariiqyada taabanaya waxay u baahan yihiin 4m²−9 inuu noqdo ugu yaraan 0, laakiin ±1.5, kuwaas oo la barbar socda asymptotes, waa in la reebo, sidaas darteed |m|>1.5.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Haddii k isbeddelo, ma nooca qalooca sidoo kale wuu isbeddelaa?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: Isla'eg conic ah oo xarfo ka kooban, hel oo si toos ah u hubi dhexda halka nooca shaxda uu isbeddelo iyadoo ku xidhan calaamadaha hooseeyayaasha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Ee k dhab ah, baar sida shaxda isla'egta x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 ay u matasho u isbeddesho k. Haddii aad geliso k=2, wuxuu noqonayaa x²/7 + y²/2 = 1, kaas oo ah ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.1: Dhis tusaale buuxiya baaxadda oo dhan
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Hubi in isla'egtu laga yaabo inayna matalin shax gabi ahaanba
n-m-h3-conic-05.prereq.0: Qaababka caadiga ah ee ellipses iyo hyperbolas
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Haddii aad geliso k=6, waxaad helaysaa x²/3 + y²/(−2) = 1. Shaxee ayay isla'egtani matasho?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dib u qor eraygii leh hooseeye taban qaabka ka jarista.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig isla'egta dib loo qoray iyo qaabka caadiga ah oo hubi kee eray ayaa togan.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Waa ellipse, sababtoo ah isla'egta waxaa loo qoray sida wadarta laba eray.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ka tagtay in calaamadda hooseeye ay isbeddeli karto marka aad geliso k. Waxaad eegtay muuqaalka banaanka ee isla'egta oo keliya.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Waa hyperbola leh dhidib hore jihada dhidibka y, sababtoo ah taban waxay ku taal dhinaca y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Haddii hooseeyaha taban uu ku yaal dhinaca y², eraygii x² waa togan, sidaas darteed wuxuu u furmaa jihada dhidibka x. Hubi kee eray ayaa togan.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Waa shax midna, sababtoo ah hal hooseeye waa taban.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Haddii hal hooseeye uu yahay taban, isla'egtu waxay isu beddeshaa ka jarid. Ma aha inaan baro jirin; nooca qalooca ayaa isbeddelaya.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Waa hyperbola, sababtoo ah hal hooseeye wuxuu noqonayaa taban isla'egtuna waxay qaadataa qaabka ka jarista.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: y²/(−2) waa −y²/2, sidaas darteed isla'egtu waa x²/3 − y²/2 = 1. Eraygii x² waa togan, sidaas darteed waa hyperbola u furmaysa jihada dhidibka x.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo gali saddex qiime oo kala duwan oo k oo isla'egta x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 ay noqoto hyperbola qaabka x²/A − y²/B = 1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qor calaamadaha labada hooseeye ay tahay inay noqdaan si isla'egtu u qaadato qaabka ka jarista.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: U beddel shuruudda calaamaddaas is-sinnaan la'aan k oo hel baaxadda.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Hooseeyaha eraygii x² ma aha togan.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Eraygii y² wuxuu qaataa qaabka ka jarista.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Eraygii y² ma isu beddelo ka jarid.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Haddii hooseeyaha 9−k ee eraygii x² uu yahay togan hooseeyaha 4−k ee eraygii y² na uu yahay taban, isla'egtu waxay qaadataa qaabka x²/(9−k) − y²/(k−4) = 1. Taasi waa, k kasta oo 4<k<9 wuu shaqeeyaa (k=4 iyo 9 ma shaqeeyaan sababtoo ah hooseeye waa 0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Marka k=2 waxay ahayd ellipse, laakiin marka k=6 waxay noqotay hyperbola. Sharax qaybtee ee isla'egta ayaa isbeddeshay iyo sidee.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qor calaamadaha labada hooseeye k=2 iyo k=6 oo barbar dhig.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hel kee hooseeye ayaa calaamaddiisa beddelay.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma barbar dhigtay isbeddelada calaamadaha labada hooseeye k=2 iyo k=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma tilmaantay si sax ah kee hooseeye ayaa calaamaddiisa beddelay?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Marka k=2, labada hooseeye waa 7 iyo 2, labaduba waa togan, sidaas darteed wuxuu leeyahay qaabka wadar (ellipse). Marka k=6, hooseeyaha 4−k ee dhinaca y² wuxuu noqdaa −2, taban, sidaas darteed isla'egtu waxay isu beddeshaa qaabka ka jarista (hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Marka k ka dhaafo 4, 4−k wuxuu noqdaa taban. Markaas calaamadda ka hor eraygii y² way isbeddeshaa, sidaas darteed ellipse wuxuu noqdaa hyperbola. 9−k wuxuu sii ahaadaa togan.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Haddii aad geliso k=10, isla'egtu waxay noqonaysaa x²/(−1) + y²/(−6) = 1. Hadalkee ee ku saabsan shaxda isla'egtani matasho ayaa sax ah?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dib u qor dhinaca bidix adigoo baabi'inaya hooseeyayaasha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig baaxadda qiimayaasha dhinaca bidix qaadan karo iyo dhinaca midig, 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Bar (x, y) midna ma buuxiyo isla'egtan.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Waa ellipse, sababtoo ah inkasta oo labada hooseeye ay isbeddeleen, weli waa qaabka wadar.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Xitaa marka labada hooseeye ay yihiin taban, weli waa qaabka wadar, laakiin ma hubin in dhinaca bidix uusan ka weynaan karin 0, sidaas darteed ma le'eg noqon karo 1 midigta.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Waa hyperbola u furmaysa jihada dhidibka x, sababtoo ah 9−k waa taban.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Labada hooseeye waa taban yihiin, sidaas darteed ma aha qaabka ka jarista. Mar kale eeg calaamadaha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Waa goobo, sababtoo ah labada eray way isku egyihiin.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Hooseeyayaashu waxay leeyihiin qiimayaal kala duwan, sidaas darteed ma noqon karto goobo, waxaadna sidoo kale hubin calaamadaha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Dhinaca bidix waa −x²−y²/6, kaas oo ah ugu badnaan 0. Ma le'eg noqon karo 1 midigta, sidaas darteed (x, y) dhab ah midna ma buuxiyo isla'egtan. Iyadoo ku xidhan haddii hooseeyayaashu yihiin togan ama taban, wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa ellipse, hyperbola, ama midna.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Wadarta laba waddo oo ka gudubta bar parabola ah
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya goobta baraha, arag in xadka hoose ee is-sinnaan la'aanta saddexagalka aanu mar walba ahayn qiime la gaaro, oo mar kale hel ugu yaraanta adigoo isticmaalaya qeexidda parabola (masaafada xarunta = masaafada directrix).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: Parabola y² = 8x waxay leedahay xarun F(2, 0) iyo directrix x = −2. Seoyun wuxuu sheegaa, "Bar P oo qalooca saran iyo bar A kasta, ugu yaraanta PA + PF mar walba waa AF iyadoo la adeegsanayo is-sinnaan la'aanta saddexagalka."
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Dib u qor qaab kale adigoo isticmaalaya qeexidda
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.2: U kala qaybi xaalado iyadoo ku xidhan goobta barta
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Parabola y² = 8x oo leh bog F(2, 0) iyo bar A(4, 2), waxaad dhaqaajisay barta P ee qalooca ku taal si aad u hesho ugu yaraanta PA+PF. Qiimee iyo sababtee ayaa ugu habboon?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dooro dhowr bar P oo qalooca ku taal, si toos ah u xisaabi PA+PF, oo samee miis.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Xusuuso qeexidda oo hubi haddii aad PF u dib u qori karto sidii dherer kale oo ah bar parabola ku taal.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, sababtoo ah wuxuu la mid yahay masaafada laga bilaabo A ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, sababtoo ah PA+PF ≥ AF oo waxaa jira P oo sinnaantu run u tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Sinnaanta aan-sinnaanta saddex-geesoodka waxay run tahay marka P ay ku taal qaybta AF oo keliya. Ma aadan hubin haddii P noocaas ahi ay ku taal qalooca.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.c: 4, sababtoo ah wuxuu la mid yahay isku-duubka x ee A.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad eegtay isku-duubyada barta A oo keliya. Sharaxaad ku saabsan wadarka masaafooyinka kee ee qiimahani yahay ma jirto.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.d: 2+2√5, sababtoo ah waa qiimaha qoolka P=(0, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad heshay qiimaha hal bar oo keliya mana aadan hubin haddii uu yahay ugu yar.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Bar parabola ku taal, PF wuxuu la mid yahay masaafada laga bilaabo P ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda x=−2. Sidaas darteed PA+PF waa wadarka PA iyo "masaafada laga bilaabo P ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda," taas oo ah ugu yaraan 6, masaafada laga bilaabo A ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda. Wuxuu la mid yahay 6 barta qalooca ku taal ee isla dherer la ah A, sida P=(0.5, 2). 2√2 waa AF, laakiin A iyo F labaduba waa qalooca gudihiisa, sidaas darteed qaybta AF ma goysto qalooca lamana gaari karo.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: Markan dooro bar A(x, y) oo leh isku-duubyo tiro dhan (−10 ilaa 10), oo hel oo geli saddex bar oo kala duwan A oo ugu yaraanta PA+PF ay la mid tahay AF marka P ay ku dhaqaaqdo qalooca.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dheh meesha P tahay inay joogto si sinnaanta aan-sinnaanta saddex-geesoodku run u noqoto.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: U kala qaybi kiisaska A uu qalooca gudihiisa yahay iyo dibaddiisa yahay, oo sawir haddii qaybta AF ay la kulanto qalooca.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Kuwani waa isku-duubyo tiro dhan baaxadda gudaheeda.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Isku-duubyadu waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo −10 ilaa 10 oo ay ku jiraan.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Qaybta AF waxay la kulantaa qalooca, sidaas darteed waxaa jira P oo PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Barta kani, ma jirto P qalooca ku taal oo la mid ah AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, sinnaantuna waa run marka P ay ku taal qaybta AF oo keliya. F waa qalooca gudihiisa, sidaas darteed haddii A ay ku taal qalooca ama dibaddiisa (y² ≥ 8x), qaybta AF waxay goysaa qalooca. Haddii A ay gudaha tahay (y² < 8x), qaybtu ma goyso qalooca, sidaas darteed ugu yaraantu waa ka weyn tahay AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: A(4, 2), ugu yaraantu waxay u soo baxday ka weyn AF. Sharax sababta sheegashada Seoyun "ugu yaraanta PA+PF had iyo jeer waa AF" ay khalad u tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Dheh meesha P tahay inay joogto si sinnaantu run ugu noqoto aan-sinnaanta Seoyun isticmaashay.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi haddii shuruuddaas A(4, 2) la buuxiyay adigoo isticmaalaya meelaha qaybta AF iyo qalooca.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay shuruudda sinnaanta ee aan-sinnaanta saddex-geesoodka?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri natiijadu way kala duwan tahay iyadoo ku xidhan booska barta A (gudaha/dibadda qalooca)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: PF wuxuu la mid yahay masaafada laga bilaabo P ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda, sidaas darteed PA+PF waa ugu yaraan 6, masaafada laga bilaabo A ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda. 6-kan aad buu uga weyn yahay AF=2√2. Sheegashada Seoyun had iyo jeer run ma aha, maadaama ay jiraan kiisas halkaas oo AF uu yahay ugu yar.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Sinnaanta aan-sinnaanta saddex-geesoodka PA+PF≥AF waa run marka P ay ku taal qaybta AF oo keliya. Haddii A iyo F labaduba ay yihiin qalooca gudihiisa, qaybta AF ma goyso qalooca, sidaas darteed P noocaas ahi ma jirto. Sidaas darteed ugu yaraantu waa ka weyn tahay AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Haddii shaqada gudaha ay leedahay geeska, ma shaqada isku-dhafan sidoo kale way leedahay?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.topic: Kala duwaynta: kala duwaynta shaqooyinka isku-dhafan
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Tijaabi sheegashada "haddii shaqada gudaha aan la kala duwi karin, shaqada isku-dhafan sidoo kale lama kala duwi karo" adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal, oo xaqiiji shuruudaha shaqada isku-dhafan ay noqoto mid la kala duwi karo adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal aad adigu dhistay.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| lama kala duwi karo x=0. (Janjeerka bidixda x=0 waa −1, janjeerka midig na waa 1.) Minseo wuxuu sheegaa, "Haddii shaqada gudaha g aan la kala duwi karin x=0, markaas shaqo la kala duwi karo f kasta, shaqada isku-dhafan h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) lama kala duwi karo x=0."
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.0: Hel tusaale lid ku ah sheegashada
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.1: Dhis oo hubi tusaale buuxiya shuruudaha
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Sharax natiijada xaalad halka xeerka silsiladda aan la isticmaali karin
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.0: Shaqada qiimaha saafiga ah |x| lama kala duwi karo x=0
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan f oo h(x)=f(|x|) noqdo mid la kala duwi karo x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: f kasta, si toos ah u qor h(x)=f(|x|) marka loo eego |x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: X=0 agtiisa, isticmaal |x|=x ee x>0 iyo |x|=−x ee x<0 si aad u barbar dhigto qaabka h bidix iyo midig.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, x² na ma qarin karo geeska |x|. Ee f kan, janjeerka x=0 ma aha 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, sidaas darteed janjeerayaasha labada dhinac ee x=0 waxay u dhowaadaan 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, −2|x| awgeed na wuxuu leeyahay geeska x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: Derivative-ka midig ee h x=0 waa f′(0) kan bidix na waa −f′(0). Si ay u siman yihiin, f′(0)=0 ayaa loo baahan yahay. x³ iyo x²+3 waxay leeyihiin f′(0)=0, sidaas darteed waa la kala duwi karaa, kuwa kale na waxay leeyihiin f′(0) oo le'eg 1, 3, iyo −2 siday u kala horreeyaan, sidaas darteed waxay leeyihiin geesas.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: Ha noqoto f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Gali labo ama in ka badan oo saddex-saddex kala duwan (a, b, c) oo ka dhigaya h(x)=f(|x|) mid la kala duwi karo x=0. Halkan a iyo b ma aha 0, dhammaantood na waa tirooyin dhan oo −9 ilaa 9 ah.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qor f(|x|) sida odhaah oo kala sooc erayada |x| ku harsan yahay sida taabbagal kaydhaas ah iyo erayada taabbagalo lamaan ah, halkaas oo |x| ay baxdo.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hel kee eray ayaa |x| u daayay sida uu yahay oo siinaya geeska x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Saddexda isku-dhufteyaal dhammaantood waa tirooyin dhan baaxadda gudaheeda.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, iyo c waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo −9 ilaa 9 ah.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c2: a iyo b waa inaanay noqon 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Janjeerayaasha bidix iyo midig ee x=0 waa siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Haddii isku-dhufteyaasha x aanu ahayn 0, h wuxuu leeyahay geeska x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: Gudaha h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ iyo bx² waa la kala duwi karaa x=0, c|x| na wuxuu leeyahay geeska haddii c≠0. Sidaas darteed c waa inuu noqdaa 0. Taasi waa, f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) wuxuu leeyahay c≠0, sidaas darteed wuxuu leeyahay geeska; (0, 2, 0) iyo (1, 0, −2) waxay leeyihiin a=0 iyo b=0 siday u kala horreeyaan, sidaas darteed waxay jebiyaan shuruudda c2, kan ugu dambeeyana wuxuu jebiyaa c3 sidoo kale.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Sharax in sheegashada Minseo ay khaldan tahay adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaasha kor ku xusan, oo qor shuruudda ay tahay in f buuxiyo si f(|x|) loo kala duwi karo x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dhig dhinac dhinac f-yada la kala duwi karay tallaabadii hore iyo kuwa aan la kala duwi karin, oo barbar dhig janjeeraha f x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Muuji janjeeraha midig iyo bidix ee h x=0 marka loo eego janjeeraha f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma bixisay hal f gaar ah oo ma muujisay h(x) in la kala duwi karo x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri sida janjeeraha bidix iyo midig ay u siman yihiin?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Haddii f(x)=x²+3, markaas h(x)=x²+3, taasoo la kala duwi karo x=0. Inkasta oo |x| uu leeyahay geeska, isku-dhafanku midna ma leh. Janjeeraha midig ee h waa f′(0) kan bidix na waa −f′(0), sidaas darteed haddii f′(0)=0 labada janjeer waa siman yihiin oo waa la kala duwi karaa. Sidaas darteed sheegashada Minseo waa khalad.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Tusaale lid ku ah waa f(x)=x³. h(x)=|x|³ wuxuu leeyahay janjeer 0 x=0. Guud ahaan, haddii f′(0)=0, derivative-yada bidix iyo midig waa 0 iyo 0, sidaas darteed waa la kala duwi karaa, haddii f′(0) aanu ahayn 0 na, wuxuu leeyahay geeska.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal qayb mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun ku salaysan waxa aad ilaa hadda taqaan oo keliya.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Maxaa dhaca haddii janjeerku yahay 0 oo xaddiga foororku sidoo kale yahay 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Kala duwaynta: fasiraadda garaafyada, qiimayaasha ugu badnaanta/ugu yaraanta, iyo derivative-ka labaad
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Marka macluumaadka hal-hal lagu daro, dib u eeg xukunnada ku saabsan qiimayaasha ugu badnaanta/ugu yaraanta, oo fahan marka qiimaha derivative-ka labaad uu yahay 0, waa inaad si toos ah u eegtaa isbeddelka calaamadda derivative-ka.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Shaqo polynomial f waxay buuxisaa f′(0)=0 x=0. Mar kasta oo macluumaad la muujiyo, hubi xukunkaaga ku saabsan qaabka garaafku leeyahay x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga iyadoo loo eegayo macluumaad cusub
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Hubi qiimayaasha ugu badnaanta/ugu yaraanta isbeddelka calaamadda derivative-ka
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Xiriirka u dhexeeya qiimayaasha ugu badnaanta/ugu yaraanta iyo isbeddelada calaamadda derivative-ka
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.2: Macnaha barta isbeddelka foororka (bar halka foororku isbeddelo)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo muuqdo, go'aami imtixaanka loo isticmaalo iyo haddii shuruudaha ku habboon yihiin imtixaankaas inuu gabagabo keeno.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii xaqiiqooyinka ah f′ iyo f″ mid kastaa yahay 0 ay sheegayaan isla wax calaamadaha bidix iyo midig ee bartaas.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f′(0)=0. (X=0, xariiqda taabata waxay la barbar socotaa ulaha x.)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma odhan karnaa f wuxuu leeyahay qiime ugu badan/ugu yar x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: f′(x)=0 wuxuu kuu sheegayaa musharax qiime ugu badan/ugu yar oo keliya. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad wax badan ogaato ku saabsan calaamadda f′ ka hor iyo ka dib x=0, ama calaamadda f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waa ugu yaraanta gudaha: haddii xariiqda taabata ay toosan tahay, garaafku wuxuu ku kulmaa hoos
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad ula dhaqantay bar kasta oo xariiq taabata toosan leh sida ugu yaraanta gudaha. Xariiq taabata toosan waxay ka dhici kartaa ugu badnaanta gudaha, ugu yaraanta gudaha, ama barta isbeddelka foororka.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waa ugu badnaanta gudaha: haddii xariiqda taabata ay toosan tahay, waa dhaladka garaafka
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad ula dhaqantay bar kasta oo xariiq taabata toosan leh sida ugu badnaanta gudaha.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Weli ma ogin: waxay noqon kartaa qiime ugu badan/ugu yar ama ma aha, sidaas darteed waxaan u baahanahay inaan wax badan ogaano
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad ka fikirtay in xariiq taabata toosan oo keliya aanay xaqiijin karin inay tahay qiime ugu badan/ugu yar.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Sidoo kale waxaad baratay in f″(0)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Marka aad aragto macluumaadkan, waa maxay xukunkaaga hadda?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Imtixaanka ah f″(0)>0 wuxuu siinayaa ugu yaraanta gudaha f″(0)<0 na ugu badnaanta gudaha waxba kuma sheego marka f″(0)=0. f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, iyo x³ dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin f′(0)=f″(0)=0, laakiin qaababkoodu way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ma aha qiime ugu badan/ugu yar: haddii f″(0) uu yahay 0, ma aha qiime ugu badan/ugu yar
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad u akhrisay f″(0)=0 sida caddayn ah inaanay ahayn qiime ugu badan/ugu yar. Waxa kaliya ee macnaheedu yahay waa imtixaanka "derivative labaad oo togan macnaheedu waa ugu yaraanta gudaha, taban macnaheedu waa ugu badnaanta gudaha" lama isticmaali karo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lagama go'aamin karo macluumaadkan: imtixaanka isticmaalaya derivative-ka labaad wuu joogsadaa shaqada
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad ogaatay haddii f″(0)=0, f″ looma isticmaali karo go'aaminta haddii ay tahay ugu badnaanta gudaha ama ugu yaraanta gudaha.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waa ugu yaraanta gudaha: janjeerku waa 0 foororkuna waa 0, sidaas darteed waa kan ugu fidsan
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad sheegtay ugu yaraanta gudaha dareenka "fidsan." Bar fidsan ma aha bar hoose.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ugu dambeyntii, waa maxay qaabka f x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: f′(x)=4x³ waa taban x<0 togan na x>0, sidaas darteed f wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraanta gudaha x=0. Sidoo kale f″(x)=12x²≥0, sidaas darteed foororku ma isbeddelo, mana aha barta isbeddelka foororka.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraanta gudaha, barta ma aha bar isbeddel foor
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad wada akhrisay in calaamadda f′ ay ka beddelanayso taban ilaa togan iyo in f″ uu yahay ugu yaraan 0 oo aanu beddelin calaamad.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ma leh qiime ugu badan/ugu yar, barta waa bar isbeddel foor
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad go'aamisay inay tahay bar isbeddel foor f″(0)=0 awgeed oo keliya. Si ay u noqoto bar isbeddel foor, calaamadda f″ waa inay isbeddelaa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraanta gudaha, barta sidoo kale waa bar isbeddel foor
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay f″(0)=0 macnaheedu waa bar isbeddel foor. f″(x)=12x² waa ugu yaraan 0, sidaas darteed calaamaddiisu ma isbeddesho.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii, f′(0)=0 oo keliya wuxuu ka dhigay qiime ugu badan/ugu yar, markii f″(0)=0 soo muuqdayna, imtixaankii wuu joogsaday. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaad gaari kartaa gabagabo adigoo si toos ah u hubinaya haddii calaamadda f′ ay isbeddesho. Qiimaha oo ah 0 wuu ka duwan yahay calaamad isbeddelaysa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Dooro shaqada leh f′(0)=0 iyo f″(0)=0 oo aan lahayn qiime ugu badan/ugu yar x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hel derivative-ka shaqo kasta oo barbar dhig calaamaddiisa bidix iyo midig ee x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: U kala qaybi shaqooyinka calaamadda f′ ay isbeddesho iyo kuwa ay isbeddeli.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: x⁴ wuxuu leeyahay f′(0)=f″(0)=0 laakiin wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraanta gudaha x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: −x⁶ wuxuu leeyahay f′(0)=f″(0)=0 laakiin wuxuu leeyahay ugu badnaanta gudaha x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: x⁶ sidoo kale wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraanta gudaha x=0. Eeg haddii taabbagalku yahay lamaan.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Ee x³, f′(x)=3x² ma beddelo calaamad, sidaas darteed qiime ugu badan/ugu yar ma jiro.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Ee x³, f′(x)=3x²≥0, sidaas darteed f′ wuxuu leeyahay isla calaamadda ka hor iyo ka dib x=0, qiime ugu badan/ugu yar na ma jiro. Saddexda shaqo ee kale, calaamadda f′ way isbeddeshaa, sidaas darteed waxay leeyihiin qiimayaal ugu badan/ugu yar. Tani waxay la micno tahay f′(0)=f″(0)=0 oo keliya ma sheegi karo kee xaalad ayay tahay.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Marka f′(0)=0 iyo f″(0)=0, qor waxa aad hubin leedahay, iyo sida, si aad u go'aamiso haddii qiime ugu badan/ugu yar uu jiro x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qor sida ay u egtahay in la yiraahdo qiime ugu badan/ugu yar ayaa jira marka loo eego calaamadda f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Si gooni ah u qor habka aan mar dambe la isticmaali karin marka f″(0)=0 iyo habka weli la isticmaali karo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay in aad barbar dhigto calaamadda f′ bidix iyo midig ee x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri f″(0)=0 macnaheedu ma aha qiime ugu badan/ugu yar ma jiro?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Haddii f″(0)=0, derivative-ka labaad kuuma sheego haddii ay tahay ugu badnaanta gudaha ama ugu yaraanta gudaha. Sidaas darteed waa inaad si toos ah u eegtaa haddii calaamadda f′ ay isbeddesho bidix iyo midig ee x=0. Haddii ay isbeddesho, qiime ugu badan/ugu yar ayaa jira, haddii aanay isbeddelin, ma jiro.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Haddii qiimaha derivative-ka labaad uu yahay 0, imtixaanku wuu joogsadaa, sidaas darteed sawir jadwalka calaamadda ee f′(x). Haddii f′ ay ka beddelanayso taban ilaa togan (ugu yar) ama togan ilaa taban (ugu badan) 0 agteeda, waa qiime ugu badan/ugu yar, haddii calaamaddu isku mid ahaato na, ma aha.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Ma xariijin taabanaysa waxay qalooca ku kulantaa kaliya barta taabashada?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.a: Isku-xidhka x a ee barta taabashada
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan xadka dhexdiisa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: Kala-duwid: isla'egyada xariiqyada taabanaya, xariiqyada taabanaya ee qalooca saddex-jibbaarka
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Naftaada u dhis tusaale xariiq taabanaysa qalooc saddex-jibbaar ah oo mar kale la kulma qalooca meel aan ahayn barta taabashada, oo kala sooc baraha taabashada ee tani aysan ka dhicin.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca y=x³−3x barta A(1, −2) waa y=−2. Garaafka shaqada labajibbaarka, waxaad aragtay in xariiqda taabanaysa ay la kulanto qalooca hal bar taabasho oo keliya. Qalooca kan sidoo kale sidaas ma tahay?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.1: Naftaada u dhis tusaale buuxiya shuruudaha
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.2: Hel baraha taabashada ee ka reebitaanka ah
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.2: Xiriirrada u dhexeeya xididdada iyo isku-dhufteyaasha
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Haddii aad hesho dhammaan isku-xigeennada x ee baraha ay xariiqda taabanaysa y=−2 la kulanto qalooca y=x³−3x, maxaad heshaa?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Baraha xariiqda taabanaysa iyo qalooca ay ku kulmaan waa xalalka isla'egta dejinaysa labada tibaax siman. Dhig isla'egta.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal xaqiiqda ah x=1 waa xal si aad u jajabiso dhinaca bidix.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay maadaama ay tahay xariiq taabanaysa, ay la kulantaa qalooca barta taabashada oo keliya. Si toos ah u xalli isla'egta x³−3x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad x=1 iyo −1 u aragtay sida lammaane. Geli x=−1 isla'egta si aad u hubiso.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.c: Kani waa natiijada jajabinta x³−3x+2=0 sida (x−1)²(x+2)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad seegtay xididka laba-jeer x=1. x=1 waa barta taabashada, sidaas darteed waxay ku taal xariiqda taabanaysa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), sidaas darteed xalalku waa x=1 (xidid laba-jeer, barta taabashada) iyo x=−2. Barta (−2, −2), xariiqda taabanaysa waxay mar kale la kulantaa qalooca.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Gali laba ama ka badan lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) si xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca y=x³−3x barta (a, a³−3a) ay sidoo kale la kulanto bar (b, b³−3b) oo aan ahayn barta taabashada. (a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan oo ka mid ah −6 ilaa 6 oo ay ku jiraan labadooda, b≠a)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro qiime isku-xigeenka x ee barta taabashada a, hel isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa, oo qor isla'egta lagu helay markii lagu dhigo qalooca.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal xalka aad horeyba u taqaanay isla'egtaas (barta taabashada) si aad u hesho xalalka hadhay.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.b: Isku-xigeenka x b ee barta ay mar kale ku kulmaan
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a iyo b waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo ka mid ah −6 ilaa 6 oo ay ku jiraan labadooda.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Waa bar ka duwan barta taabashada.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c2: b waa inuu ka duwan yahay a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Barta (b, b³−3b) waxay ku taal xariiqda taabanaysa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Barta (b, b³−3b) kuma taal xariiqda taabanaysa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Dhigidda isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa barta (a, a³−3a) qalooca waxay siinaysaa (x−a)²(x+2a)=0, sidaas darteed isku-xigeenka x ee barta ay mar kale ku kulmaan waa b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), iyo (−3, 6) waa tusaalayaal; (1, 1) waa barta taabashada lafteeda, (1, −1) na ma aha bar xariiqda taabanaysa ku taal.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Eeg lammaanayaasha (a, b) ee aad heshay, qor xiriirka muujinaya b marka loo eego a, oo sharax sababta xiriirkaasi u qabto.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dhig qiimayaasha a iyo b ee tusaalayaashaada shax ku jira oo barbar dhig imisa jeer a ayaa b ah.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka fikir in isla'egta la isku daray ay tahay saddex-jibbaar iyo xidid noocee ah x=a (xidid keliya mise laba-jeer), oo qor saddexda xidid.

Kala-duwidda y iyo x laba jeer mid kasta oo la qaybinayo ma aha xisaabintaas. Safka 4 wuxuu isticmaalaa natiijada safka 3 oo keliya.
