n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), oo kala-duwidda tan marka loo eego t waxay siinaysaa (3/2)(1+1/t²). U qaybinta tan dx/dt=2t waxay siinaysaa d²y/dx². t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8, loo qaybiyay 4, waxay siinaysaa 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Gelinta t=2 d/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) waxay siinaysaa 15/8, u qaybinta dx/dt=4 na waxay siinaysaa 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Dooro qaacidada saxda ah ee lagu helo d²y/dx² qalooc lagu bixiyay halbeeg.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor waxa d²y/dx² loo akhriyi karo ‘kala-duwidda waxa marka loo eego waxa’.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Isticmaal sharciga silsilada si aad uga fikirto waxa aad ku dhufan lahayd ama u qaybin lahayd si aad kala-duwidda marka loo eego t ugu beddesho kala-duwidda marka loo eego x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: U qaybi y oo laba jeer lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t x oo laba jeer lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Kani waa habka Seoyeon isticmaalay. Saamiga qiimayaasha laba jeer la kala-duway marka loo eego t wuu ka duwan yahay dy/dx oo marka loo eego x la kala-duway.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: U qaybi dy/dx oo hal mar lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t x oo hal mar lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Tani waxay muujisaa habka kala-duwidda dy/dx marka loo eego x adigoo isticmaalaya sharciga silsilada.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: U qaybi dy/dx oo hal mar lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t x oo laba jeer lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad kala-duwaha labaad ee x geliyay hooseeyaha. Si loogu beddelo kala-duwidda marka loo eego x, waxaad u qaybisaa dx/dt hal mar.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: U qaybi dy/dx oo hal mar lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t labajibbaarka x oo hal mar lagu kala-duway marka loo eego t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad labajibbaartay hooseeyaha. Sharciga silsilada, waxa kaliya ee aad u qaybisid si aad kala-duwidda marka loo eego t ugu beddesho kala-duwidda marka loo eego x waa dx/dt, hal mar.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). t=2, qaacidooyinka kor ku xusan waxay siinayaan 6, 15/16, iyo 15/128 siday u kala horreeyaan, kuwaas oo ka duwan qiimaha saxda ah 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: Sidee loo beddelaa meesha barta P marka barta F dhaqaaqdo?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Ka xaqiiji qeexitaannada in isla dhismaha, beddelidda booska barta F ay u beddesho meesha goobo, ellipse, ama hyperbola, oo dhis caado ah inaadan gunaanadka hal xaalad u qaadin mid kale isagoo aan la beddelin.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: Sagxad ayaa ku jira goobo leh bartamaha O iyo radius 6, iyo bar F. Bar Q oo ku socota goobada, ha noqoto P barta uu bar-dhexaadka toosan ee qaybta FQ ku kulmo xariijinta OQ. Waxaan baari doonaa shaxda P ay raadsato marka Q ay ku socoto goobada, anagoo beddelayna booska F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga mar kasta oo shuruuddu is beddesho
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Helitaanka meesha adigoo isticmaalaya isugeynta iyo farqiga masaafooyinka
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.2: Ogaanshaha khatarta guud ka dhigidda xaalad gaar ah (F=O)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Qeexitaannada ellipse iyo hyperbola (isugeynta masaafooyinka, farqiga masaafooyinka)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Sifada ah in bar ku taal bar-dhexaadka toosan ee qayb ay isla masaafo ka tahay labada dhammaad
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gabal markiiba marka booska barta F is beddelo. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun ku salaysan kaliya waxa aad ilaa hadda taqaanid.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub yimaado, sawir shax muujinaya meesha barta P ku taal qaybta OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal PF=PQ si aad u hubiso haddii isugeynta ama farqiga PO iyo PF ay u fududaato qiime joogto ah.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Marka hore tixgeli xaaladda F ay tahay isla barta bartamaha O. Bar ku taal bar-dhexaadka toosan ee qaybta FQ waxay isla masaafo ka tahay F iyo Q, sidaa darteed PF=PQ. Barta P waxay ku taal xariijinta OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Marka Q hal mar goobada wareegto, shax noocee ah ayay P raadsataa?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii F=O, markaas PO=PQ iyo PO+PQ=OQ=6, sidaa darteed PO=3. P waa bar 3 ka fog O, sidaa darteed waxay raadsataa goobo radius 3 ah.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Goobo leh bartamaha O iyo radius 6
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad hadda ku celisay goobada Q raadsato. P maaha Q; waa bar ku taal bar-dhexaadka toosan ee FQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Goobo leh bartamaha O iyo radius 3
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in P ay joogto masaafo joogto ah O ka fog.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ellipse leh O iyo bar kale oo xudumihiisa ah
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Weli ma nihin xaalad laba xudun leh. F iyo O waa isla bar.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Marka Q dhaqaaqdo, P sidoo kale way dhaqaaqdaa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: F waxaa loo dhaqaajiyey bar goobada dhexdeeda ah, 4 ka fog O. Weli waa run in PF=PQ. Haddii aad sawirto shaxda, P waxay ku taal qaybta OQ (O iyo Q dhexdooda).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Maadaama P ay ku taal qaybta OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Isugeynta masaafooyinka laga bilaabo labada bar O iyo F waa 6 joogto ah, sidaa darteed waa ellipse leh xudumo O iyo F iyo dhidib weyn oo dhererkiisu yahay 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Weli waa goobo bartamihiisu yahay O: sababtoo ah Q waxay ku taal goobada
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Marka F ka tago O, PO weli joogto ma aha. Waxaad gunaanadkii tallaabadii hore u qaadatay isagoo aan la beddelin.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hyperbola leh farqi masaafo oo joogto ah laga bilaabo O iyo F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hyperbola leh farqi masaafo oo joogto ah laga bilaabo O iyo F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ma hubin haddii PO iyo PF la isku daro ama la jaro. Isticmaal xaqiiqda ah in P ay ku taal qaybta OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ellipse leh isugeyn masaafo oo joogto ah laga bilaabo O iyo F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in isugeyntu tahay joogto, maadaama PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Parabola leh bar isla masaafo ka fog F iyo xariijin
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Masaafooyinka isle'eg waa xiriirka u dhexeeya F iyo Q (PF=PQ), waana masaafada barta Q, ma aha xariijin.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Markan F waxaa loo dhaqaajiyey bar goobada dibaddeeda ah, 9 ka fog O. Haddii aad sawirto shaxda, P ma aha qaybta OQ ku taal laakiin waxay ku taal kordhinta xariijinta OQ (dhinaca Q ama dhinaca O). Weli waa run in PF=PQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ee kordhinta dhinaca Q, PO=OQ+PQ, sidaas darteed PO−PF=6, ee kordhinta dhinaca O na, PF−PO=6. Si kasta, |PO−PF|=6 waa joogto, sidaas darteed waa hyperbola leh xarumo O iyo F iyo dhidib hore dhererkiisu yahay 6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ellipse leh wadar joogto ah, sida xaaladda gudaha
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad sidii loo ahaa u gudbisay natiijada xaaladda gudaha. Haddii P aanay saarnayn gabal OQ, PO+PQ ma aha OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hubi haddii PO uu yahay joogto. Haddii F ay O ka fog tahay, ma aha joogto.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Dhidibka la qaybiya iyo xariiqda OQ ayay ku kulmaan ku dhawaad Q kasta.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Marka goobta F isbeddesho, isla dhismuhu wuxuu siiyey goobo, ellipse, iyo hyperbola nidaamka. Qaadidda natiijada gudaha sida ay tahay banaanka waa khalad. Iyadoo ku xidhan in barta P ay saran tahay gabal OQ ama kordhintiisa, waxay isbeddeshay haddii wadarta ama farqiga PO iyo PF ay joogto tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Sharax sababta goobta P ay u kala duwan tahay marka F ay goobada gudaheeda ku jirto iyo marka ay banaanka tahay, adigoo isticmaalaya PO, PF, iyo radiyaha goobada 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sheeg halka P ay ku taal xariiqda OQ xaaladda gudaha iyo xaaladda banaanka.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: Xaalad kasta, ku xidh xiriirka u dhexeeya PO iyo PQ dhererka 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay PO+PF=6 gudaha iyo |PO−PF|=6 banaanka?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday in wadarta iyo farqigu kala qaybsamaan sababtoo ah goobta P (gabalka ama kordhinta) way kala duwan tahay?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Haddii F ay gudaha tahay, P waxay saran tahay gabal OQ, sidaas darteed PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, wadartu waa joogto, waana ellipse. Haddii F ay banaanka tahay, P waxay saran tahay kordhinta, sidaas darteed farqiga PO iyo PQ waa 6, farqiga PO iyo PF waa joogto 6, waana hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Haddii F ay goobada gudaheeda tahay, wadarta masaafooyinka laga bilaabo O iyo F waa 6, sidaas darteed waa ellipse, haddii F ay goobada banaanka tahay na, qiimaha saafiga ah ee farqiga masaafooyinku waa joogto 6, sidaas darteed waa hyperbola. Tani waa sababtoo ah haddii P ay saran tahay gabalka ama kordhinta way isbeddeshaa.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Qaybaha conic: qeexitaannada iyo xariijimaha taabanaya ee parabola, ellipse, iyo hyperbola; is-waafajinta u dhexeysa shaxanka iyo isla'egyada
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: Xaggee ayay xarunta iyo directrix aadaan marka parabola la wareejiyo?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Si sax ah u akhri jihada wareejinta isla'egta, u dhaqaaji xarunta iyo directrix isla wareejinta, oo qor sharaxaad arday ka yar.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Dhaliil Haeun ayaa kuu soo diray qoraal markii uu isku dayayay inuu helo xarunta iyo directrix ee parabola (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Akhrinta sida calaamadaha isla'egtu ugu waafaqsan yihiin jihada wareejinta
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Dib u qorista sharaxaadda si ay ugu habboonaato qofka aad u sharaxayso
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.0: Xarunta iyo directrix ee parabola y²=4px
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.1: Wareejinta iyo sida isla'egtu u isbeddesho
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Kani waa qoraalka dhaliil Haeun kuu soo diray. Dooro safka koowaad ee khaldamay.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hel barta isla'egta cusub halka labada dhinac ay yihiin 0. Barbar dhig halkii doorkaas lagu ciyaaray isla'egta hore.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kala sooc haddii xisaabta saf kasta ay ka timaaddo safka hore ama ay tahay xukun cusub.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Ee y² = −8x, 4p = −8, sidaas darteed p = −2, xaruntu waa (−2, 0), directrix na waa x = 2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: (y−1)² = −8(x+2) wuxuu leeyahay x+2 iyo y−1, sidaas darteed waa y² = −8x oo lagu wareejiyey +2 jihada x iyo −1 jihada y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.2: U dhaqaajinta xarunta si isku mid ah waxay siinaysaa (−2+2, 0−1) = (0, −1).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: U dhaqaajinta directrix si isku mid ah waxay siinaysaa x = 2+2 = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed xaruntu waa (0, −1) directrix na waa x = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Waa safka 2. Dhigidda x+2 halkii x waxay wareejisaa −2 jihada x, dhigidda y−1 halkii y na waxay wareejisaa +1 jihada y. Calaamaduhu waa ka soo horjeedaan. Wax walba laga bilaabo safka 3 waa xisaabo raacaya jihada safka 2, sidaas darteed haddii jihadu khaldan tahay, dhammaan waa khalad. Safka 1 waa sax.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Dooro habka ugu la aamini karo ee lagu hubiyo haddii jihada wareejinta Haeun sax tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir muuqaalka barta u dhiganta fiiqii hore ee isla'egta cusub ee shaxda la wareejiyey leedahay.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore xusuuso haddii xarunta iyo directrix ay saran yihiin qalooca.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Beddel xarunta la helay, (0, −1), si aad u aragto haddii ay buuxiso isla'egta cusub (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: Xaruntu ma aha bar qalooca saran, sidaas darteed looma baahna inay buuxiso isla'egta marka la beddelo. Sidaas darteed hubintani ma sheegi karto jihada wareejinta.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Barbar dhig haddii isku-dhufteyaasha −8 ee isla'egta cusub ay la mid tahay isku-dhufteyaasha isla'egta asalka ah.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: Isku-dhufteyaashu wuxuu kuu sheegayaa qaabka (jihada uu furmo iyo ballaadhkiisa) oo keliya. Ma sheegayo jihadee ayaa goobta loo wareejiyey.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Hel barta halka labada dhinac ee isla'egta cusub ay yihiin 0 oo eeg haddii ay tahay halka fiiqii hore (0, 0) u dhaqaaqay.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Qiyaas garaafka oo eeg haddii jihada uu furmo ay la mid tahay sidii hore.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Wareejintu ma beddesho jihada uu furmo, sidaas darteed wuu u muuqdaa isku mid xitaa haddii jihada wareejinta khaldan tahay.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: Fiiqu wuxuu ahaa barta (0, 0) halka labada dhinac ee isla'egta hore ay ahaayeen 0, sidaas darteed barta (−2, 1) halka labada dhinac ee isla'egta cusub ay yihiin 0 waa halka fiiqu u dhaqaaqay. Sidaas darteed wareejintu waa −2 dhidibka x iyo +1 dhidibka y. Xarunta iyo directrix ma aha baro qalooca saran, sidaas darteed ma hubin kartid adigoo ku beddelaya isla'egta.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: Haeun waa arday sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare ah oo hadda wareejinta baratay. Qor jawaab loo diro Haeun. Waa inay ku jirtaa halka ay khaldantay, jihada saxda ah ee wareejinta, xarunta iyo directrix ee saxda ah, iyo sida loo hubiyo.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Go'aami nidaamka jawaabta: halka ay khaldantay, wareejinta la saxay, xarunta iyo directrix, sida loo hubiyo.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya wareejinta la saxay, u dhaqaaji fiiqa, xarunta, iyo directrix ee isla'egta asalka ah.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma tilmaantay halka ay khaldantay erayo Haeun fahmi karo?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma muujisay sida xarunta iyo directrix u dhaqaaqeen goobahoodii hore?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Habka lagu hubiyo ma ku jiraa jawaabta?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, jihadu waa rogan tahay safka 2. Haddii x+2 la dhigo halkii x, garaafku wuxuu u wareegsan yahay −2 jihada x, y−1 na wuxuu u wareegaa +1 jihada y. Barta isla'egta cusub halka labada dhinac ay yihiin 0 waa (−2, 1), sidaas darteed waad ogaan kartaa fiiqu wuxuu ka dhaqaaqay (0, 0) halkaas. Sidaas darteed xarunta (−2, 0) waxay u dhaqaaqdaa (−4, 1), directrix x=2 na waxay u dhaqaaqdaa x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, jihada wareejinta safka 2 waa khalad. (x+2) wuxuu u wareejiyaa 2 bidixda, (y−1) na wuxuu u wareejiyaa 1 kor. Waad hubin kartaa adigoo geliya in fiiqu yahay (−2, 1). Sidaas darteed xaruntu waa (−4, 1) directrix na waa x = 0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Sidee u akhrinaa xagal hooseeyahiisu yahay 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Farqinta: farqinta qarsoon iyo xariiqyada taabata baraha xagalku aan la qeexin
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Baar haddii xariiq taabata ay ku jirto barta hooseeyaha xagalka laga helay farqinta qarsoon uu yahay 0, oo hel oo hagaaji gabagabada khaldan ee xalka.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Kani waa xalka Hayoon ee helista xariiqda taabata barta P(2, −1) ee qalooca C: x²+xy+y²=3. (x² iyo y² waxay la macno yihiin x laba-jibbaaran iyo y laba-jibbaaran. In barta P ay ku taal C waa la hubiyay 4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Fasir xariiqda taabata halkaas oo xagalku aan la qeexin sidii qaabka jaantuska
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.2: Dooro shuruudaha lagu hubiyo ka hor gabagabada
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Farqinta qarsoon (u aragta y sidii shaqo x ah oo farqi labada dhinac marka loo eego x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Helista isla'egta xariiq taabata bar qalooca ku taal
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka Hayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri safaf kasta kor ka bilaabo oo hubi xisaab toos ah haddii ay ka timid safka isla markiiba ka horreeya.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii gabagabada safka ugu dambeeya ay sheegayso isla xaqiiqada laga helay safkii hore (waxa aan la qeexin).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Farqinta labada dhinac marka loo eego x waxay siinaysaa 2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.1: Xalinta y′ waxay siinaysaa y′ = −(2x + y)/(x + 2y).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Bedelidda P(2, −1), hooseeyaha x+2y waa 2+2·(−1)=0, sidaas darteed xagalku lama qeexin.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed xariiq taabata barta P ma jirto.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 4 waa khalad. Xisaabaha safafka 1 ilaa 3 waa sax. Laakiin "tibaaxda xagalku lama qeexin" waxay la macno tahay "ma jirto lambar la yidhaahdo xagal," ma aha inaysan jirin xariiq taabata. Soo-qaybiyaha 2x+y=3 ma aha 0, sidaas darteed xagalku wuu sii weynaan karaa si aan xad lahayn, taas oo ah, xariiq taabata oo barbar socota y-axis ayaa dhici karta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Haddii ay jirto xariiq taabata qalooca C barta P, qor isla'egteeda, oo qor sababta aad sidaas u xukuntay.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi qiimaha soo-qaybiyuhu qaato inta hooseeyuhu yahay 0, oo ka fikir sida xagalku u weynaado.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sawir sida xariiq xagalkeedu sii weynaanayo xad la'aan ugu egtahay diyaarada isku-duubyada, oo qor isla'egta xariiqdaas oo ka gudubta barta P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale. Marka la eego jihada xariiqda taabata ...
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in hooseeyuhu yahay 0 laakiin soo-qaybiyuhu aanu ahayn 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma bedeshay x=2 isla'egta qalooca oo aad eegtay sida qalooca iyo xariiqdu u kulmaan?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa farqiga u dhexeeya "xagal ma jiro" iyo "xariiq taabata ma jirto"?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Hooseeyuhu waa 0 soo-qaybiyuhuna waa 3, sidaas darteed xagalku wuu sii weynaadaa xad la'aan. Sidaas darteed xariiqda taabata waa xariiqda x=2, barbar socota y-axis. Bedelidda x=2 qalooca waxay siinaysaa y²+2y+1=0, sidaas darteed y=−1 waa xalka keliya, taasoo la macno ah xariiqdu waxay taabataa qalooca barta P, taasna sidoo kale waa ku habboon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: Waxaa jira xariiq taabata. Xagalku lama qeexin sababtoo ah xariiqda taabatu waa taagan tahay, isla'egteeduna waa x=2. Sidoo kale waan hubiyay in soo-qaybiyaha 2x+y uu yahay 3, ma aha 0, sidaas darteed ma aha qaabka 0/0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxaa ku filan in la hubiyo soo-qaybiyaha, xitaa adigoon isticmaalin habka bedelidda x=2 qalooca.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Maxaad hubisaa ka hor intaadan gabagabayn "waxaa jirta xariiq taabata taagan" barta hooseeyaha tibaaxda xagalka uu yahay 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qaabka y′ = (soo-qaybiye)/(hooseeye), barbar dhig sida jajabku u kala duwan yahay marka hooseeyuhu yahay 0 iyo qiimaha soo-qaybiyuhu kala duwan yahay.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ma qaababka 0/0 iyo 3/0 waa isla xaalad? Ka fikir waxa mid walba sheegayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Haddii, marka hooseeyuhu yahay 0, soo-qaybiyuhu sidoo kale aanu ahayn eber (taas oo ah, haddii aanu ahayn qaabka 0/0)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad ka fikirtay hubinta soo-qaybiyaha sidoo kale.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Haddii qiimaha y aanu noqon taban marka barta ay qalooca ku taal
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Calaamadda y waxba kuma laha haddii xariiq taabata jirto. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad isku dhex yaacday calaamadda isku-duub iyo jihada xariiq taabata.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Haddii qiimaha mar labaad la farqiyay y″ aanu ahayn 0
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: Farqinta labaad waxay kuu sheegtaa oo keliya jihada qalooca u foorarsado; ma go'aamiso haddii xariiq taabata jirto.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Haddii qalooca lagu qori karo qaabka y = (tibaax x ah)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Xariiq taabata ayaa jirta xitaa haddii shaqo qarsoon aan lagu qori karin qaabka y=f(x). Shuruuddan looma baahna.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Xitaa haddii hooseeyuhu yahay 0, haddii soo-qaybiyuhu aanu ahayn 0, xagalku wuu sii weynaadaa xad la'aan oo xariiq taabata taagan ayaa soo muuqata. Haddii soo-qaybiyuhu sidoo kale yahay 0, waa qaabka 0/0, sidaas darteed tibaaxdan oo keliya ma go'aamin karto, waana inaad eegtaa qaabka qalooca barta taas adigoo isticmaalaya hab kale.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: Daqiiqadda xawaaruhu yahay 0, ma barta ayaa dib u rogmata?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Farqinta: xawaaraha iyo dardargelinta, shuruudaha isbeddelka jihada
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Fahan, adigoo isticmaalaya isbeddelka calaamadda xawaaraha, farqiga u dhexeeya daqiiqadda xawaaruhu yahay 0 iyo daqiiqadda jihada dhaqdhaqaaqu isbeddesho, oo laftaada dhis oo hubi tibaaxaha xawaaraha buuxiya shuruudaha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Xawaaraha barta P ee ku socota xariiq lambar waqtiga t (t≥0) waa v(t), v(1)=0-na. Minsu wuxuu yiri, "Daqiiqadda xawaaruhu yahay 0, barta hubaal waxay beddeshaa jihada." (Beddelidda jihada macnaheedu waa ka socodka midig ilaa socodka bidix, ama ka socodka bidix ilaa socodka midig. Haddii xawaaruhu yahay togan, midig ayuu u socdaa; haddii uu yahay taban, bidix.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.0: Dooro shuruudda saxda ah ee isbeddelka jihada
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Dhis oo xaqiiji tibaaxaha xawaaraha buuxiya shuruudaha
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Kala saar waxa lagu xukumi karo qiyamka xawaaraha iyo dardargelinta oo keliya
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Xidhiidhka booska, xawaaraha, iyo dardargelinta (xawaaruhu waa derivative-ka booska, dardargelintuna waa derivative-ka xawaaraha)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Xidhiidhka calaamadda xawaaraha iyo jihada dhaqdhaqaaqa
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hadalka la mid ah "barta P waxay beddeshaa jihada waqtiga t₀."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore qor jiho kee ayay barta u socoto marka xawaaruhu yahay togan iyo marka uu yahay taban.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa calaamadda xawaaruhu tahay inay sameyso si jihadu u isbeddesho, oo barbar dhig kiiska ay noqoto 0 ka dibna ku soo noqoto isla calaamadda.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa haddii dardargelintu aanu ahayn 0, haddii xawaaruhu aanu ahayn 0 jihadu waa isku mid. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad isku dhex yaacday xawaaraha iyo dardargelinta.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Booska t₀ wuu ka weyn yahay boosaska waqtiyada oo dhan xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay tixgelisaa marka booska uu ugu weyn yahay (dhammaadka midig) oo keliya. Waxay ka tagtaa kiiska dib u rogmashada dhammaadka bidix.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 waa hal sifo oo daqiiqadda beddelidda jihada oo keliya, ma aha isla hadal. Ka fikir kiiska v=0 laakiin calaamaddu isku mid tahay.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Calaamadaha xawaaraha xoogaa ka hor iyo xoogaa ka dib t₀ way kala duwan yihiin
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad aragtay beddelidda jihada adigoo isticmaalaya isbeddelka calaamadda xawaaraha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Jihadu waxay isbeddeshaa marka calaamadda xawaaruhu ka beddesho togan ilaa taban ama taban ilaa togan. Xawaaruhu inuu yahay 0 waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah oo dhacda daqiiqadda calaamaddu isbeddesho, laakiin ma aha mid ku filan.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Marka xawaaraha lagu bixiyo v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n, geli laba ama ka badan saddex-lambar oo kala duwan (m, n, p) oo buuxiya dhammaan kuwa soo socda: barta P ma beddesho jihada t=1, waxayna beddeshaa jihada t=p. (m iyo n waa lambarro dabiici ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 6, p-na waa lambar dabiici ah laga bilaabo 2 ilaa 9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isku day dhowr qiime oo m iyo n ah oo samee miis calaamadaha (t−1)^m iyo (t−p)^n xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1 iyo t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: U kala qaybi kiisaska awoodda ay tahay lammaan iyo aan lammaan ahayn, oo barbar dhig haddii calaamaddu isku mid tahay ama kala duwan tahay xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib barta taas.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: m, n, iyo p waa lambarro dabiici ah baaxadaha gudahooda.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Waa inay noqdaan lambarro dabiici ah oo 1≤m≤6, 1≤n≤6, 2≤p≤9.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Calaamadda xawaaruhu waa isku mid xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Calaamadda xawaaruhu waa isbeddelaa xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1, sidaas darteed barta waxay beddeshaa jihada.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Calaamadda xawaaruhu way kala duwan tahay xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Calaamadda xawaaruhu waa isku mid xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=p, sidaas darteed barta ma beddesho jihada.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.explain: Haddii awoodda (t−1) ay tahay lammaan, qodobkani wuxuu leeyahay isla calaamad xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1, haddii awoodda (t−p) ay tahay aan lammaan ahayn-na, calaamaddu way kala duwan tahay xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=p. Qodobbada kale ma beddelaan calaamad barta agteeda (p≥2). (1, 1, 3), calaamaddu sidoo kale way isbeddeshaa t=1, (2, 2, 3)-na ma isbeddesho t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro mid ka mid ah tusaalayaasha aad heshay oo qor sababta barta aysan u beddelin jihada t=1 inkasta oo v(1)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qor v(t) adigoo isticmaalaya (m, n, p) aad dooratay, oo barbar dhig calaamadaha marka aad geliso qiime wax yar ka yar 1 iyo qiime wax yar ka weyn 1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ku xidh haddii (t−1)^m uu yahay togan ama taban xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1 haddii m uu yahay aan lammaan ahayn ama lammaan.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: tusaale. Xoogaa ka hor iyo ka dib t=1, calaamadda (t−1)^m waa ...
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Tusaalaha aad dooratay, ma runtii xisaabisay calaamadda xawaaraha ka hor iyo ka dib t=1?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma barbar dhigtay kiiska awooddu aan lammaan ahayn?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Waxaan dooray (2, 1, 3). v=(t−1)²(t−3), (t−1)² wuxuu yahay ugu yaraan 0 labada dhinac ee t=1, sidaas darteed calaamaddiisu ma isbeddesho, (t−3)-na wuxuu sii ahaadaa taban. Sidaas darteed v waa 0 marka t=1 laakiin calaamaddiisu isku mid ayay sii ahaataa, sidaas darteed jihadu ma isbeddesho.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Awoodda m waa lammaan, sidaas darteed (t−1)^m ma noqdo ka yar 0 marka t dhaafto 1. Xawaaruhu wuxuu taabtaa 0 oo wuxuu ku soo noqdaa isla calaamad, sidaas darteed jihadu way sii ahaataa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Waxay ka kooban tahay labadaba awoodda lammaanka iyo xaqiiqda ah in calaamaddu aysan isbeddelin.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.prompt: Marka xawaaruhu v yahay shaqo la farqin karo dardargelintuna tahay a(t)=v′(t), dooro dhammaan hadallada saxda ah.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Samee tibaaxo xawaare fudud laftaada, sida v=(t−1)² iyo v=(t−1)³, xisaabi v′(1) mid walba, oo barbar dhig haddii jihadu isbeddesho.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hadal kasta, hel hal tusaale lid ku ah si aad u hubiso haddii uu run yahay "had iyo jeer."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.a: Haddii v(t₀)=0 iyo a(t₀)≠0, barta waxay beddeshaa jihada t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in haddii dardargelintu aanu ahayn 0, jaantuska xawaaruhu uu ka gudbo 0 calaamaddiisuna isbeddesho.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.b: Haddii v(t₀)=0 iyo a(t₀)=0, barta ma beddesho jihada t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.b: Xitaa haddii a(t₀)=0, kiisas sida v=(t−1)³ jihadu way isbeddeshaa. Waxaad seegtay in marka dardargelintu tahay 0, tan oo keliya ma go'aamin karto.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.c: Haddii v(t₀)=0 iyo a(t₀)=0, barta hubaal waxay beddeshaa jihada t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.c: Xitaa haddii a(t₀)=0, kiisas sida v=(t−1)² jihadu way sii ahaataa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.d: Haddii barta ay beddesho jihada t₀, markaas v(t₀)=0 hubaal
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay in si jihadu u isbeddesho, xawaaruhu waa inuu si joogto ah u isbeddelo oo ka gudbo 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.explain: Haddii v(t₀)=0 iyo v′(t₀)=a(t₀)≠0, markaas v wuxuu ka gudbaa 0 wuxuuna beddelaa calaamadda. Dhinaca kale, haddii a(t₀)=0, calaamaddu laga yaabaa inaysan isbeddelin, sida (t−1)², ama laga yaabaa inay isbeddesho, sida (t−1)³, sidaas darteed waa inaad si toos ah u eegtaa calaamadda xawaaraha. Si jihadu u isbeddesho, v joogtada ah waa inuu beddelaa calaamadda, sidaas darteed v=0 daqiiqaddaas.

n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Ma heli karnaa xagalka shaqo isku-dhafan qiyamka miiska?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Farqinta: derivative-ka shaqo isku-dhafan iyo miisaska qiyamka shaqada iyo qiyamka derivative-ka
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Marka la helayo derivative-ka shaqo isku-dhafan, go'aami barta kee ay tahay in derivative-ka shaqada dibaddu lagu akhriyo, oo kala saar waxa lagu heli karo qiyamka miiska oo keliya.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
Qiyamka laba shaqo oo la farqin karo f iyo g waa sida miiska hoose. Qiyamka aan miiska ku jirin lama yaqaan. (f∘g)(x) waxay la macno tahay f(g(x)), (g∘f)(x)-na waxay la macno tahay g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6
n-m-h3-diffc-03.thinking.0: Kala saarista qiyamka loo baahan yahay
n-m-h3-diffc-03.thinking.1: Kala saarista waxa la heli karo iyo waxa la heli karin
n-m-h3-diffc-03.prereq.1: Akhrinta miis si loo helo qiyamka shaqada
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qiyamka loo isticmaalo helista (f∘g)′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qor derivative-ka shaqada isku-dhafan f(g(x)) sidii wax-ku-dhig qayb dibadda ah iyo qayb gudaha ah, oo eeg waa maxay qiimaha qaybta dibaddu u qaadato sidii gelitaankeeda.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal xaqiiqada ah marka x=1, natiijada gelinta 1 g waxay noqotaa gelitaanka f si aad u go'aamiso gelitaannada miiska laga akhrinayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad akhridday xagalka f x=1. Shaqada dibaddu f waa inay isticmaashaa xagalkeeda qiimaha shaqada gudaha, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad akhridday derivative-ka shaqada dibadda qiimaha shaqada gudaha, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: g(1) waa loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo barta ay shaqada dibadda ka tahay laga qaado derivative-ka.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ka fikirtay qaybta derivative-ka shaqada gudaha lagu dhufto.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: g′(2) waa janjeeraha x=2, sidaas darteed looma isticmaalo qiimaha la raadinayo x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Qiimaha shaqada f(2) waa dherer, ma aha janjeer, sidaas darteed looma isticmaalo xisaabinta derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Maadaama g(1)=2, akhri f′(2)=7 oo ku dhufo g′(1)=−3 si aad u hesho −21. Qodobka muhiimka ahi waa isticmaalka f′(g(1)), ma aha f′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: g(1)=2 waa qiimaha loo isticmaalo go'aaminta barta f′ laga akhrinayo, sidaas darteed si toos ah uguma muuqdo ku dhufashada, laakiin ku dhufashada f′(2) iyo g′(1) oo keliya waa isla xisaabta.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qiimayaasha jadwalka qiimayaasha oo keliya go'aamiyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Shaqo isku-dhafan kasta, marka hore hel oo qor qiimaha shaqada gudaha.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii derivative-ka shaqada dibadda ee gelintaas uu jadwalka ku jiro.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Waxaan u baahanahay janjeeraha g′(3) g(f(1))=g(3), laakiin jadwalka kuma jirto. Isticmaalka g′(1) ee jadwalka waxay isticmaashaa barta gelinta oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: Janjeeraha f′(2) ee gelinta shaqada dibadda g(1)=2 jadwalka ayuu ku jiraa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Waxaan u baahanahay janjeeraha g′(5) g(f(2))=g(5), laakiin jadwalka kuma jirto.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: Janjeeraha f′(1) ee gelinta shaqada dibadda g(2)=1 jadwalka ayuu ku jiraa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: Derivative-ka shaqada isku-dhafan waa la heli karaa kaliya haddii jadwalku leeyahay janjeeraha shaqada dibadda ee lagu akhriyey qiimaha shaqada gudaha. Ee (f∘g)′, qiimayaasha g, 2 iyo 1, labaduba waa qiimayaasha x ee jadwalka, sidaas darteed waa suurtagal, ee (g∘f)′ na, qiimayaasha f, 3 iyo 5, waa qiimayaasha x ee jadwalka ku jirin.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Hel qiimaha (f∘g)′(2). Sidoo kale qor sababta ay khaldan tahay xisaabinta f′(2)·g′(2)=42.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore ka akhri qiimaha g(2) jadwalka oo go'aami barta shaqada dibadda laga qaadayo derivative-ka.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xisaabta siisay 42, barbar dhig barta aad ku akhriday derivative-ka f iyo qiimaha runtii gala f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore heshay g(2) oo go'aamisay barta laga akhrinayo shaqada dibadda?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri janjeeraha barta kee ayaa lagu qasay qiimaha 42?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, sidaas darteed f′ waa in lagu akhriyaa 1, taasoo siinaysa (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. f′(2)·g′(2) wuxuu akhriyaa janjeeraha f x=2, laakiin qiimaha gala f ma aha 2 laakiin waa g(2)=1, sidaas darteed waa khalad.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: Derivative-ka shaqada isku-dhafan waa f′(g(2))g′(2). Maadaama g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 iyo g′(2)=6, wax-isku-dhufashaduna waa 24. 42 waa khalad sababtoo ah wuxuu isticmaalay f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-01.title: Hubinta xalka kala duwanaanshaha Gayoung
n-m-h3-dist-01.topic: Qaybinta suurtogalnimada: qiimaha la filayo iyo kala duwanaanshaha doorsoome kediso ah oo go'an
n-m-h3-dist-01.goal: Hel safka ugu horreeya ee khaldama xal kala duwanaansho, hel qiimaha saxda ah, oo hubi haddii natiijadu macno leedahay.
n-m-h3-dist-01.material: Doorsoome kediso ah X wuxuu qaataa qiimayaasha 0, 1, 2, 3 suurtogalnimooyin 0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 siday u kala horreeyaan. Gayoung wuxuu u xalliyay sida hoos ku xusan si uu u helo kala duwanaanshaha V(X). (E(X²) waa ‘qiimaha la filayo ee X labajibbaaran,’ {E(X)}² na waa ‘labajibbaarka qiimaha la filayo.’)
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.0: Raac safafka xalka mid mid oo hel safka khaldan
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.1: Hubi haddii natiijadu ku habboon tahay qaabka qaybinta
n-m-h3-dist-01.prereq.0: Qiimaha la filayo E(X) ee doorsoome kediso ah oo go'an
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan xalka Gayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi isku xigta kor ilaa hoos haddii saf kasta si sharci ah uga soo baxayo safka ka horreeya.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qor qeexidda E(X) iyo E(X²) erayo, oo barbar dhig haddii saf kasta lagu xisaabiyay iyadoo la raacayo qeexiddaas.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.1: Kala duwanaanshaha waxaa lagu helaa V(X)=E(X²)−{E(X)}².
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.2: E(X²) waa E(X) labajibbaaran oo keliya, sidaas darteed E(X²)=1.6²=2.56
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa khalad. E(X²) ma aha ‘labajibbaarka qiimaha la filayo’; waa qiimaha la helo marka qiime kasta oo X marka hore la labajibbaaro, kadibna lagu dhufto suurtogalnimooyinka oo la isku daro. Safafka 4 iyo 5 waxay ka sii wadaan natiijada safka 3, sidaas darteed xisaabahaas laftoodu waa sax, laakiin gabagabadu waa khalad.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.prompt: Sax safka khaldan oo hel qiimayaasha E(X²) iyo V(X). Sidoo kale hal jumlad ku qor sababta natiijada Gayoung V(X)=0 ay macno u leedahay qaybintan.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.0: Labajibbaar qiime kasta oo X ah 0, 1, 2, 3 oo ku dhufo isla suurtogalnimooyinka.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.1: Erayo ku dhig waxa kala duwanaansho 0 ay ka sheegayso qiimayaasha X.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.placeholder: tus. E(X²) waa ... iyo V(X) waa ...
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma si toos ah u xisaabisay E(X²) adigoo isticmaalaya labajibbaarka qiime kasta?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma odhan kartaa E(X²) iyo {E(X)}² waa laba tiro oo kala duwan?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma odhan kartaa qaybin noocee ah ayaa kala duwanaansho 0 suurtogal u ah?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.0: E(X²)=0²×0.1+1²×0.4+2²×0.3+3²×0.2=0.4+1.2+1.8=3.4. V(X)=3.4−1.6²=3.4−2.56=0.84, maadaama X uu qaato qiimayaal kala duwan 0, 1, 2, 3, kala duwanaanshuhu ma noqon karo 0.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.1: Waa inaad labajibbaartaa qiime kasta, ku dhufataa suurtogalnimada, oo isku daraysaa, sidaas darteed E(X²)=3.4 (=17/5) iyo V(X)=0.84. Kala duwanaansho 0 macnaheedu waa X had iyo jeer wuxuu qaataa hal qiime oo keliya, laakiin tani halkan sidaas ma aha.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.2: E(X²)=3.4 kala duwanaanshuhuna waa 0.84. Kala duwanaansho 0 macnaheedu waa dhammaan qiimayaasha way isku mid yihiin, kaas oo halkan sidaas ma aha.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Goorma ayaan ugu yeedhi karnaa qaybin laba-geesood haddii aan saddex kubbadood la dhex dhigno?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Qaybinta suurtogalnimada: shuruudaha qaybinta laba-geesoodka ay ku qabato
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Dooro macluumaadka hubaal loo baahan yahay si loo xukumo haddii loo tixgelin karo qaybin laba-geesood, oo tirooyin ku muuji sida suurtogalnimadu u is beddesho marka macluumaadkaasi is beddelo.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Sanduuq ayaa ka kooban 3 kubbadood oo cadaan ah iyo 2 kubbadood oo madow ah. Seoyun wuxuu yidhi, "Tirada kubbadaha cadaanka ah X marka 3 kubbadood la soo bixiyo waxay raacdaa qaybinta laba-geesoodka B(3, 3/5)." Seoyun inuu sax yahay lama ogaan karo wixii ilaa hadda la qoray.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Kala sooc macluumaadka lagama maarmaanka u ah xukunka iyo kan aan ahayn
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Xisaab ku hubi farqiga ka dhasha marka shuruud jabto
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Macnaha qaybinta laba-geesoodka B(n,p): samee n tijaabo oo madaxbanaan, mid walbana leh isla suurtogalnimada guusha p
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Maxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u xukunto haddii Seoyun sax yahay?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore xasuuso sifooyinka tijaabooyinku yeelan karaan si loo isticmaalo qaybin laba-geesood.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Mid mid go'aami haddii doorasho kasta ay hubinayso sifadaas, mise ay weydiinayso wax horeyba la ogaa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Mar kale tiri si aad u hubiso in sanduuqa runtii ku jiraan 3 kubbadood oo cadaan ah iyo 2 kubbadood oo madow ah
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: Tirada kubbadaha horeyba waa la bixiyay. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu helo suurtogalnimada 3/5, laakiin ma kuu sheegayo haddii isla suurtogalnimada la ilaaliyo mar kasta.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Hubi haddii soo bixinta 3 kubbadood ay tahay tiro tijaabo oo ku filan
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: Qaybin laba-geesood ma qabato sababtoo ah tirada tijaabooyinku way badan tahay. Xitaa haddii ay yar tahay, sida n=3, waa qaybin laba-geesood haddii shuruudaha la buuxiyo.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Hubi haddii kubbad kasta la soo bixiyay lagu celiyo sanduuqa kahor intaan kubbadda xigta la soo bixin
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad hubinaysaa in waxa sanduuqa ku jira ay isku mid yihiin mar kasta. Tani waa shuruudda muhiimka ah ee qaybinta laba-geesood.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Hubi haddii kala horreynta kubbadaha cadcad ee soo baxaya hore loo go'aamiyey
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Kala horreyntu waxba kuma laha qaybinta tirada X ee kubbadaha cadcad. Waxa go'aamiya haddii ay tahay qaybin laba-geesood waa haddii tijaabooyinku ay isku saameeyaan.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.explain: B(3, 3/5), ixtimaalka kubbad cad waa inuu noqdaa 3/5 mar kasta oo kubbad la bixiyo, iyadoo aan saamayn dhex marin bixinta. Haddii kubbad kasta oo la bixiyey dib loo celiyo, tani way run tahay, laakiin haddii kale, natiijooyinka hore waxay beddelaan ixtimaalka dambe. Tirada kubbadaha horey ayaa loo ogaa, tirada tijaabooyinkuna uma baahna inay weyn tahay.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka soo qaad 3 kubbadood oo la bixiyo adigoo aan dib u celin. Haddii kubbaddii ugu horreysay ay cad tahay, hel ixtimaalka kubbadda labaad inay cad tahay, oo tan isticmaal si aad u qorto sababta X aysan u noqon karin B(3, 3/5) xaaladdan.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qor tirada kubbadaha sanduuqa ku hadhay iyo tirada kuwa cad ka dib marka kubbadda koowaad la bixiyo.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ixtimaalkaas dhinac dhig ixtimaalka bixinta koowaad oo isbarbar dhig.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Haddii kubbadda koowaad ay cad tahay, kubbadaha hadhay waa ...
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma naftaada u tiriyay tirada kubbadaha hadhay (4) iyo kuwa cad (2)?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi kartaa sida ixtimaalka beddelka ugu xidhan yahay "aan madaxbannaanayn"?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sharaxi kartaa waxa dhaca marka kubbadaha dib loo celiyo?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Haddii kubbadda koowaad ay cad tahay, kubbadaha hadhay waa 2 cad 4 ka mid ah, sidaa darteed ixtimaalku waa 2/4=1/2. Wuxuu ka duwan yahay 3/5 asalka ah, sidaa darteed shuruudda ixtimaalku inuu mar kasta isku mid yahay waa jabtaa, oo ma aha B(3, 3/5).
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Haddii kubbadaha dib loo celin, natiijada bixintii hore ayaa beddesha ixtimaalka xiga. Haddii kubbad cad la bixiyo marka hore, ixtimaalka kan xiga inuu cad yahay waa 2 ka mid ah 4 (0.5), taasoo ka duwan 3/5, sidaa darteed tijaabooyinku madaxbannaan ma aha oo ma noqon karto qaybin laba-geesood.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Laba ciyaar oo leh celcelis isku mid ah: ma kala firdhisku isku mid yahay?
n-m-h3-dist-03.topic: Qaybinta ixtimaalka: variance-ka isugeynta iyo jibbaarka doorsoomayaasha kaban
n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Xukun adigoo si toos ah u barbar dhigaya qaybinta haddii celcelis isku mid ah macnaheedu yahay in kala firdhisku isku mid yahay, oo sababta ku sharax variance.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: Ha noqoto X tirada la muujiyo marka dhagax lix-geesood caadi ah la tuuro. Waxaa jira laba ciyaarood. Ciyaarta A, dhagaxa mar ayaad tuurtaa dhibcahaaguna waa laba jibbaar tirada la muujiyey (2X), Ciyaarta B na, dhagaxa laba jeer ayaad tuurtaa dhibcahaaguna waa isugeynta labada tiro (X₁+X₂). Labada ciyaarood celceliska dhibcuhu waa 7 dhibic. Youngsu wuxuu yiri, "Maadaama celceliska isku mid yahay, kala firdhisku waa inuu isku mid noqdaa sidoo kale."
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.0: Dooro habka isbarbar dhigga ee tijaabiya sheegashada
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Dhis caddayn tusaale lid ku ah adigoo isticmaalaya ixtimaalo gaar ah
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Guud ka dhig adigoo isticmaalaya xeerarka sida variance-ku u beddelo
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Qiimaha la filayo iyo variance-ka doorsoome kaban oo kala go'an
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: Variance-ka isugeynta laba doorsoome kaban oo madaxbannaan V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Waa kuwee isbarbar dhigga ugu habboon ee lagu tijaabiyo sheegashada Youngsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sheegashada Youngsu waxay ku saabsan tahay "kala firdhisku," ma aha celceliska. Xogtee ayaa tan muujin lahayd?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, ka fikir haddii ay muujin karto farqi u dhexeeya labada ciyaarood.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Dib u xisaabi si aad u hubiso in celceliska labada ciyaarood runtii isku mid yahay, 7 dhibic
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: Horey ayaa la bixiyey in celceliska isku mid yahay. Mar kale hubinta isla qiimaha kuma sheegi doono kala firdhisku.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Isticmaal xaqiiqda ah in celceliska hal tuurid dhagax uu yahay 3.5 si aad u barbar dhigto labada ciyaarood
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay kuu sheegaysaa oo keliya in celceliska 7 dhibic ee labada ciyaarood uu ka yimid qiimahan. Ma muujiyo kala firdhiska.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Dhinac-dhinac dhig dhibcaha suurtagalka ah ee labada ciyaarood iyo ixtimaalka dhibic kasta
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad barbar dhigaysaa qaybinta dhibcaha oo dhan. Tani waa hab lagu arko si toos ah haddii qaabka qaybintu kala duwanaan karto xataa marka celcelisku isku mid yahay.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Dhagaxa tuur jeer badan oo eeg haddii celceliska dhibcaha labada ciyaarood ay u dhowaadaan 7 dhibic
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Wuxuu muujiyaa haddii celcelisku u ururo 7 agtiisa, laakiin ma kuu sheegayo wax ku saabsan kala firdhiska.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Celcelisku waa hal soo koobid oo qaybin. Haddii aad dhinac-dhinac dhigto dhibcaha iyo ixtimaalada, isla markiiba waad arki kartaa haddii qaabka qaybintu kala duwanaan karto xataa celcelis isku mid ah. Dib u xisaabinta celceliska ama kaliya hubinta haddii ay ururto celceliska agtiisa ma tijaabin karto sheegashada Youngsu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Hel ixtimaalka dhibcuhu noqdaan 2 ama 12 ciyaar kasta (ixtimaalka isku-dhafan ee labada xaaladood), oo sharax in sheegashada Youngsu aysan sax ahayn.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qor tirooyinka dhagaxa ee siinaya 2 dhibic iyo 12 dhibic Ciyaarta A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ciyaarta B, tiri dhammaan lammaanayaasha la kala horreeyey ee labada tiro ee siinaya 2 dhibic iyo 12 dhibic, oo hel imisa ka mid ah 36 natiijo ayay yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Ciyaarta A, si loo helo 2 dhibic ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma naftaada u tiriyay siyaabaha loo helo 2 dhibic iyo 12 dhibic Ciyaarta B sida lammaane la kala horreeyey?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi kartaa in qaabka qaybintu kala duwanaan karto xataa marka celcelisku isku mid yahay?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa sida farqiga labada ixtimaal u muujiyo farqiga kala firdhiska?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: Ciyaarta A, tuurid 1 ama 6 waxay siisaa 2 ama 12 dhibic, sidaa darteed waa 2/6=1/3. Ciyaarta B, waxaa jira labo natiijo oo keliya, (1,1) iyo (6,6), sidaa darteed waa 2/36=1/18. Celceliska isku mid ah, ixtimaalada dhibcaha xad-dhaafka ahi aad bay u kala duwan yihiin, sidaa darteed kala firdhiska lagama yiraahdi waa isku mid.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Ixtimaalka helitaanka 2 ama 12 dhibic waa soddon A iyo mid-tobnaad-iyo-sideed B. Inkastoo celcelisku yahay 7 labadaba, A wuxuu siiyaa dhibco xad-dhaaf ah si aad uga badan, sidaa darteed variance-yadu way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: Ha noqoto V variance-ka tirada X ee la muujiyo hal tuurid dhagaxa. Waa maxay variance-yada dhibcaha Ciyaarta A 2X iyo dhibcaha Ciyaarta B X₁+X₂ (labada tuurid isma saameeyaan)?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X waa hal natiijo oo laba jibbaaran, X₁+X₂ na waa laba natiijo oo kala duwan oo la isku daray. Labada si gooni ah ka fikir.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Geli lambar fudud V (tusaale V=1), hel labada variance doorasho kasta, oo isbarbar dhig haddii ay la jaanqaadaan kala firdhiska labada ciyaarood ee aad aragtay tallaabadii hore.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.a: Variance-ka 2X waa 2V, variance-ka X₁+X₂ na waa 2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad 2X u aragtay inuu la mid yahay "X oo laba jeer lagu daray." Ku darista isla qiimaha laba jeer way ka duwan tahay ku darista natiijooyinka laba tuurid oo gooni ah.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.b: Variance-ka 2X waa 4V, variance-ka X₁+X₂ na waa 2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: 2X, qiime kasta waa la laaban yahay, sidaa darteed variance-ku wuxuu noqonayaa 2² jeer ka weyn; isugeynta laba natiijo oo madaxbannaan, variance-yadu way isku darmaan, sidaa darteed waa 2 jeer ka weyn.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.c: Variance-ka 2X waa 4V, variance-ka X₁+X₂ na waa 4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad xeerka ah in ku dhufashada joogto ay labajibbaarto isku-dhufashada variance-ka ku dabaqday isugeynta laba tuurid sidoo kale. Isugeyn madaxbannaan, variance-yadu si fudud ayay isku darmaan.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.d: Variance-ka 2X waa 2V, variance-ka X₁+X₂ na waa 4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad is beddeshay variance-ka jibbaarka iyo variance-ka isugeynta.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V, isugeynta laba doorsoome kaban oo madaxbannaan, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Celcelisyadu labaduba waa 7, laakiin variance-yadu way kala duwan yihiin: 4V iyo 2V. (Variance-ka tuurid dhagax waa V=35/12, sidaa darteed waa 35/3 iyo 35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Ma qiimaha la filayo waa qiimaha ugu badan ee soo baxa?
n-m-h3-dist-04.topic: Qaybinta ixtimaalka: macnaha qiimaha la filayo
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Kala saar qeexidda iyo macnaha qiimaha la filayo, oo dhis oo hubi qaybin halkaas oo qiimaha la filayo uu ahayn mid suurtagal ah iyo mid ixtimaalkiisu ugu weyn yahay toona.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: Waxaa jira doorsoome kaban X oo qaadanaya qiimayaasha 0, 1, 2. Marka aad go'aamiso ixtimaalada saddexda qiime ee shaxda qaybinta ixtimaalka, qiimaha la filayo E(X) waa la go'aamiyey.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Kala saarida hadallada ku saabsan qiimaha la filayo run iyo been
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Dhis qaybin buuxisa shuruudaha oo u isticmaal sida tusaale lid ku ah
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Shaxda qaybinta ixtimaalka ee doorsoome kaban oo kala go'an
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hadallada saxda ah ee ku saabsan qiimaha la filayo E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hadal kasta, ka fikir haddii aad tijaabin karto adigoo samaynaya shax qaybinta ixtimaalka.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore ku tijaabi qaybin fudud halkaas oo qiimayaashu yihiin 0 iyo 1 oo keliya, labada ixtimaalna isle'eg yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.a: E(X) waa mid ka mid ah qiimayaasha X qaadan karo
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Xataa haddii X qaadan karto kaliya qiimayaal tirooyin dhan ah, E(X) wuxuu noqon karaa jajab tobanle ah. Tusaale ahaan, celceliska tirada madaxyada marka lacag la tuuro wuxuu noqon karaa qiime sida 0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) waa isugeynta qiime kasta oo lagu dhufto ixtimaalkiisa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad si sax ah u sheegtay qeexidda.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.c: E(X) waa qiimaha X ee ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad qiimaha la filayo iyo "qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn" u aragtay isku shay. Qiimaha ugu badan ee suurtagalka ahi waa fikrad gooni ah, labaduna badanaa way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Haddii tijaabo jeer badan la ku celiyo, celceliska qiimayaasha la arkay wuxuu ururaa E(X) agtiisa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: Si sax ah ayaad u sharaxday meesha celcelisku degaa marka tijaabada la ku celiyo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) waa isugeynta qiimaha × ixtimaalka, waana qiimaha celcelisku u degaa marka tijaabada jeer badan la ku celiyo. Ma jirto dammaanad ah inuu yahay qiime X runtii qaadan karto, ama inuu yahay qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka soo qaad X wuxuu qaataa qiimayaasha 0, 1, 2. Dooro ixtimaalkooda sida boqolkiiba tirooyin dhan (p0, p1, p2). Shuruudaha: ① saddexda ixtimaal mid kasta waa ugu yaraan 1% oo isugeyntoodu waa 100% ② qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn waa 2 oo keliya ③ E(X)≤1.2 (qiimaha la filayo waa ugu yaraan 0.8 ka yar 2, qiimaha ugu badan ee suurtagalka ah). Samee 3 tusaale oo kala duwan (oo leh qiimayaal p2 oo kala duwan).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro p0, p1, p2 si ay isugeyntoodu u noqoto 100, oo p2 ka dhig kan ugu weyn.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Xisaabi E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100 oo hubi haddii uu yahay ugu badnaan 1.2. Haddii uu aad u weyn yahay, isku day inaad kordhiso p0 ama p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: U beddel p2 qiimayaal kala duwan sida 45 iyo 39, oo mar kasta mar kale dooro p0 iyo p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ixtimaaladu waa tirooyin dhan oo ah ugu yaraan 1% oo isugeyntoodu tahay 100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Saddexda ixtimaal waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo ah ugu yaraan 1% oo isugeyntoodu tahay 100.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Qiimaha 2 oo keliya ayaa leh ixtimaalka ugu weyn.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) waa inuu ka weyn yahay mid kasta oo ka mid ah labada ixtimaal ee kale (ma noqon karo mid ka mid ah isle'eg).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Tusaale ahaan, (40, 15, 45), E(X)=1.05, qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn na waa 2. E(X)=1.05 maaha qiime X qaadan karo, sidoo kalena wuu ka duwan yahay 2, qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn. Tusaalayaal kaliya dib u habeeya (p0, p1, p2) looma baahna in loo tiriyo isla tusaale.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Dooro mid ka mid ah tusaalayaashaada oo, adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyinkiisa, sharax sababta ay khalad u tahay in E(X) loo akhriyo "qiimaha ugu badan ee soo baxa" ama "qiimaha runtii soo baxa."
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Hel E(X) tusaalaha aad doorteen oo la barbar dhig qiimayaasha X qaadan karo: 0, 1, 2.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Qor sida qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn ugu xidhan yahay qiimaha E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma naftaada u xisaabisay E(X) tusaalaha aad doorteen?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay sababta E(X) u yahay qiime aan runtii dhici karin?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay sida qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn uga duwan yahay E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Tusaale ahaan, (40, 15, 45), E(X)=0.15 + 0.9 = 1.05. Tani maaha qiime X qaadan karo, qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn na waa 2. Sidaa darteed E(X) maaha qiimaha ugu badan ee soo baxa ama qiime soo bixi kara.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: (37, 24, 39), E(X)=1.02, laakiin X wuxuu noqon karaa kaliya 0, 1, ama 2, sidaa darteed 1.02 weligeed ma dhici karto. Qiimaha ixtimaalkiisa ugu weyn waa 2, 39%, sidaa darteed wuu ka duwan yahay qiimaha la filayo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: (25, 36, 39), E(X)=1.14 maaha qiime X qaadan karo, sidoo kalena wuu ka duwan yahay 2, qiimaha ugu badan ee suurtagalka ah.

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Haddii Ixtimaalku Yahay 0, Runtii Weligeed Ma Dhici Karto?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Qaybinta ixtimaalka: ixtimaalka hal bar ee doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Go'aami haddii qiime dhici karo marka ixtimaalkiisa hal bar ee doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah uu yahay 0, oo sharax xukunkaas, iyo saamaynta ku darista ama ka reebista dhammaadyada, ereyo saaxiib fahmi karo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Bas ayaa imanaya si isle'eg waqti kasta u dhexeeya 0 iyo 10 daqiiqo hadda ka bilaabo. Waqtiga sugitaanka X (daqiiqo) wuxuu noqon karaa qiime kasta laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 10 oo ay ku jiraan labada dhammaad. Ixtimaalka xad waxaa u tarmaya dhererkiisa: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. Jia waxay qortay kuwa soo socda.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Sharaxaadda fikrad adag adigoo isticmaalaya ereyo fudud iyo tusaalayaal
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Go'aaminta haddii ku darista ama ka reebista dhammaadka ay beddesho ixtimaalka
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Macnaha doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah iyo hawsha cufnaanta ixtimaalka (ixtimaalku waa aagga xad kor ah)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka khaldan ee qoraalka Jia.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Si kala horreyn ah u hubi haddii sadar kasta uu si sax ah uga imanayo sadarkii ka horreeyey.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hel sadarrada leh "ixtimaalku waa 0" iyo "ma dhici karto," oo tijaabi haddii sababayntii isku xidhaysay ay sax tahay adigoo ka fikiraya bas runtii imanaya.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X wuxuu qaadan karaa qiime kasta laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 10, P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10 na.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) waa ixtimaalka xad dhererkiisu yahay 0, sidaa darteed waa (4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Maadaama ixtimaalku yahay 0, basku inuu imaado saxda 4 daqiiqo waa wax aan dhici karin.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 waa khalad. Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, xataa haddii ixtimaalka hal bar uu yahay 0, qiimahaas lagama maarmaan inuu dhici waayo. Waxaa jira qiimayaal aan tiro lahayn u dhexeeya 0 iyo 10, sidaa darteed mid kastaa wuxuu leeyahay ixtimaal 0, haddana qiime ayaa dhaca. Sadarrada 4 iyo 5 si sax ah ayay u raacaan.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor farriin qoraal ah oo Jia lagu sharaxayo. Sheeg qaybta sababaynteeda ee in la saxo, iyo sida P(X≤4) iyo P(X<4) u barbar dhigmaan cabbir ahaan, adigoo isticmaalaya ereyo fudud iyo tusaale.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qiyaas intee ayay yartahay fursadda aad ku soo qaadato saxda hal qiime oo u dhexeeya 0 iyo 10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isla fikraddaas ku celi aag ahaan: waa maxay aagga hal xariijin dhumuc la'aan ah?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaashay ereyo iyo tusaale saaxiib dugsiga dhexe fahmi karo?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay in "ixtimaal 0" aanu macnaheedu ahayn "aan suurtagal ahayn"?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay sababta ixtimaalku isku mid u yahay haddii dhammaadka la daro ama la reebo?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: Waxaa jira qiimayaal aan tiro lahayn 0 iyo 10 daqiiqo u dhexeeya, sidaa darteed fursadda lagu dhufan karo saxda 4 daqiiqo aad bay u yar tahay, 0 u dhow, ilaa ay noqoto 0. Laakiin macnaheedu maaha in basku weligiis imaan waayo 4 daqiiqo, sababtoo ah wuxuu yimaadaa waqti. 4 daqiiqo ha lagu daro ama ha la reebo, ixtimaalka uu ku darayo waa 0, sidaa darteed P(X≤4) iyo P(X<4) way isle'eg yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Sababtoo ah waa joogto, xataa haddii hal bar ixtimaalkeedu yahay 0, basku weli wuu imaan karaa daqiiqadaas. Waa sida hal bar oo ku taal xariijin oo aagga uu yahay 0 halka xariijintu weli baro ku leedahay. Ku darista ama ka saarista hal bar ixtimaalka ma beddesho, sidaa darteed P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, laakiin waqtiga imaatinku waa hal qiime oo go'an, sidaa darteed qiimahaas inuu soo baxo maaha wax aan suurtagal ahayn. Hal bar dhumuc ma laha, sidaa darteed ku darista ama ka saarista ixtimaalka ma beddesho, labada ixtimaal na way isle'eg yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.prompt: Kee ka mid ah kuwa soo socda ayaa sax ah?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir sida hadal kasta ugu xidhan yahay qiimaha P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tuurid dhagax X (kala go'an), hel P(X≤3) iyo P(X<3) oo isbarbar dhig.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Xataa doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, P(X≤a) had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in "≤" ay ka kooban tahay xaalado badan, sidaa darteed ixtimaalkeedu waa inuu ka weyn yahay. Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, ixtimaalka hal bar waa 0, sidaa darteed labaduba way isle'eg yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, haddii P(X=a)=0, markaas X ma la simi karo a.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad ixtimaal 0 u aragtay inuu la mid yahay aan suurtagal ahayn. Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, qiime leh ixtimaal 0 runtii wuu dhici karaa.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, ixtimaalku waa isku mid haddii dhammaadyada xad lagu daro ama aan lagu darin.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Ixtimaalka hal bar waa 0, sidaa darteed ku darista ama ka reebista dhammaad ma beddesho ixtimaalka.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Doorsoome kaban oo kala go'an sidoo kale, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) had iyo jeer waa run.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Doorsoome kaban oo kala go'an, P(X=a) wuxuu noqon karaa mid aan eber ahayn, sidaa darteed laga yaabaa inaysan isle'eg ahayn.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Doorsoome kaban oo joogto ah, P(X=a)=0, sidaa darteed P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Doorsoome kaban oo kala go'an, P(X=a)>0 waa suurtagal, sidaa darteed ku darista ama ka reebista dhammaad wuxuu beddeli karaa ixtimaalka.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Dhismaha qaybinta laba-qaybleha laga bilaabo celcelis iyo kala duwanaansho
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Qaybinta itimaalka: celceliska iyo kala duwanaanshaha qaybinta laba-qaybleha
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Isticmaal xidhiidhka u dhexeeya celceliska iyo kala duwanaanshaha qaybinta laba-qaybleha si aad u saarto isku-darka aan suurtagalka ahayn, oo dhis qaybinno laba-qaybleh ah oo buuxiya shuruudaha la bixiyay si aad u hesho xeer.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad qeexdo xog adigoo isticmaalaya qaybinta laba-qaybleha B(n,p). Halkan n waa lambar dabiici ah p-na waa lambar inta u dhexeysa 0 iyo 1. Celceliska qaybinta laba-qaybleha waa np kala duwanaanshuhuna waa np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.0: Hubi shuruudaha qarsoon (n waa lambar dabiici ah, 0<p<1)
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Dhis tusaalayaal laftaada oo buuxiya shuruudaha oo hel xeer
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Celceliska np iyo kala duwanaanshaha np(1−p) ee qaybinta laba-qaybleha B(n, p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Lammaannada celcelis iyo kala duwanaansho ee soo socda kuwee runtii dhici kara qaybinta laba-qaybleha B(n, p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dhig celceliska la mid np iyo kala duwanaanshaha la mid np(1−p), ka dibna eeg waxa hadha marka aad kala duwanaanshaha u qaybiso celceliska.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta hubi haddii p aad heshay u dhexeeyo 0 iyo 1 iyo haddii n uu yahay lambar dabiici ah.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: Halkan kala duwanaanshuhu wuu ka weyn yahay celceliska. Maadaama kala duwanaanshuhu yahay np(1−p), ma ka weyn karo celceliska np.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Haddii aad hesho p ka dibna n=np÷p, n ma aha lambar dabiici ah. Waxaad iska indho tirtay shuruudda ah n waa lambar dabiici ah.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Haddii kala duwanaanshuhu la mid yahay celceliska, markaas 1−p=1, sidaas darteed p=0. Markaas celcelisku wuxuu noqon lahaa 0, taas oo aan ku habboonayn.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: Kala duwanaansho ÷ celcelis = 1−p wuxuu go'aamiyaa p, n-na sidoo kale wuxuu u soo baxaa lambar dabiici ah, sidaas darteed tani waa suurtagal.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: Kala duwanaansho ÷ celcelis = 1−p. (8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, iyo n=8÷(1/4)=32, sidaas darteed waa suurtagal. (10, 12), 1−p>1 sidaas darteed p<0; (8, 5), p=3/8 iyo n=64/3, taas oo aan ahayn lambar dabiici ah; (6, 6)-na, p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Dhis 3 qaybinno laba-qaybleh oo kala duwan B(n, p) oo leh celcelis 12 iyo kala duwanaansho ugu badnaan 8. U qor n sidii lambar dabiici ah p-na sidii boqolley tiro dhan ah (p%). (tusaale p=25%, qor 25)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow qorista lammaannada n iyo p ee buuxiya celceliska np=12 (p sidii boqolley tiro dhan ah).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Lammaane kasta, xisaabi kala duwanaanshaha 12(1−p) oo hubi haddii uu yahay ugu badnaan 8.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: n waa lambar dabiici ah p-na wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 1% iyo 99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: n waa inuu noqdaa lambar dabiici ah p-na waa inuu noqdaa boqolley tiro dhan ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Kala duwanaanshaha np(1−p) waa ugu badnaan 8.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Kala duwanaanshuhu wuu ka weyn yahay 8.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Laga bilaabo np=12, p=q/100. Si kala duwanaanshaha np(1−p)=12(1−p) u noqdo ugu badnaan 8, p waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 1/3. Tusaalayaasha n iyo p labaduba ku habboon yihiin shuruudaha waa (30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), iyo (15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Marka aad eegto saddexda qaybinno, qor xidhiidhka u dhexeeya p iyo kala duwanaanshaha marka celcelisyadu siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor p iyo kala duwanaanshaha saddexda qaybinno dhinac-dhinac, sida miis.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.1: Eeg haddii kala duwanaanshuhu weynaado ama yaraado marka p weynaado.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.placeholder: tusaale. Marka celcelisku isku mid yahay, 12, marka p weynaado kala duwanaanshuhu ...
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma runtii xisaabisay kala duwanaanshaha saddexda qaybinno?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay xidhiidhka u dhexeeya p iyo kala duwanaanshaha iyo shuruudda ah in celcelisyadu siman yihiin?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma isticmaashay xaqiiqada ah in kala duwanaanshaha lagu qori karo 12(1−p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.0: Marka celceliska np uu isku mid yahay, 12, kala duwanaanshuhu waa 12(1−p), sidaas darteed marka p weynaado, kala duwanaanshuhu wuu yaraadaa. Tusaale ahaan, p=40% wuxuu siinayaa 7.2 p=75%-na wuxuu siinayaa 3.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.1: Saddexda qaybinba waxay leeyihiin celcelis 12, laakiin kala duwanaanshuhu wuu yaraaday marka p weynaaday. Tusaale ahaan, 6 marka p=50% iyo 2.4 marka p=80%: marka itimaalka guushu sarreeyo, firdhisku wuu yaraadaa.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.2: Marka celcelisyadu siman yihiin, marka p weynaado, kala duwanaanshaha 12(1-p) wuu yaraadaa.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Xal bixiyay itimaal 2: safkee ayaa khaldamay?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Qaybinta itimaalka: qeexidda shaqada cufnaanta itimaalka
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Aqoonso inaadan isku dhafi karin kala-dhexaadka dibaddiisa halkaas oo shaqada cufnaanta itimaalku aanu eber ahayn, hel safka khaldamay, oo hel itimaalka saxda ah.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Doorsoome joogto ah X wuxuu leeyahay shaqada cufnaanta itimaalka f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), iyo f(x)=0 x kale kasta. Halkan waa xalka Minjun ee helista joogtada k iyo P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.0: Hel safka ugu horreeya ee xalka ee khaldamay
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Hubi haddii natiijadu ku jirto baaxadda suurtagalka ah ee itimaalka
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka Minjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Laga bilaabo kor hubi haddii safaf kasta si sharci ah uga yimid safka ka horreeya.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Safaf kasta, barbar dhig jaantuska kala-dhexaadkaas x loo isticmaalay iyo f(x) ee dhibaatada lagu bixiyay.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2) iyo f(x)=0 meel kale, wadarka bedkuna waa 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya bedka saddex-geesoodka, (1/2)×2×2k=2k=1, sidaas darteed k=1/2.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: P(1≤X≤3) waa bedka u dhexeeya jaantuska y=x/2 iyo x-axis laga bilaabo x=1 ilaa x=3.

n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Ugu Yaraan Mid Waa Gabadh: Waa Maxay Suurtagalnimada Labaduba Inay Yihiin Gabdho?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Suurtagalnimo: suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan, madaxbanaanida iyo ku-tiirsanaanta, sababeynta qaabka Bayes, dejinta meel muunad
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: Xal suurtagalnimo shuruudaysan, hel oo saxo halka kiisaska aan isku suurtagal ahayn loo tiriyey sida isku suurtagal, oo xaqiiji in kiisaska harsan ay isbeddelaan iyadoo ku xidhan sida shuruudda loo qoray.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Waxa kaliya ee aan ognahay waa in qoys uu leeyahay laba carruur ah. Ilmo kasta wuxuu yahay gabadh suurtagalnimo 1/2, waxaana u malaynaynaa in jinsiga labada ilmo midba midka kale aanu saameyn. Seungwoo wuxuu xalliyey "suurtagalnimada labada ilmo ay labaduba yihiin gabdho, iyadoo la siiyey in ugu yaraan mid ay gabadh tahay" sida hoose.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Dib u dhis meel muunad laga bilaabo kiisas la kala saari karo
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.2: Barbar dhig suurtagalnimooyin isbeddela iyadoo ku xidhan erayada shuruudda
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Macnaha suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan (saamiga kiisas qaar ka mid ah kiisaska ku habboon shuruudda)
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.1: Tirinta natiijooyinka marka nidaamka la kala saaro
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee aan sax ahayn ee xalka Seungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka bilow sare, hal saf mar mar, hubi haddii saf kasta si sax ah uga yimaado safka isla markiiba ka horreeya.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Naftaada qor kiisaska la yiraahdo isku suurtagal, adigoo kala saaraya ilmaha koowaad iyo kan labaad, oo barbar dhig haddii ay runtii isku cabbir yihiin.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: Shuruudda ah ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah labada ilmo waa gabadh hoostiisa, hel suurtagalnimada labada ilmo inay labaduba yihiin gabdho.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Isku-darka labada ilmo waa mid ka mid ah saddex nooc, "2 gabdhood," "1 gabadh iyo 1 wiil," iyo "2 wiilal," saddexda nooc na waa isku suurtagal.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Ka saarista "2 wiilal," oo aan ku habboonayn shuruudda ah ugu yaraan mid waa gabadh, waxay ka tagaysaa laba nooc.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: Labada nooc ee harsan, waxaa jira mid halka labada ilmo labaduba yihiin gabdho.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 ayaa ah meesha ugu horreysa ee khaldantay. "1 gabadh iyo 1 wiil" wuxuu ka kooban yahay labadaba kiiska ilmaha koowaad uu gabadh yahay iyo kiiska ilmaha labaad uu gabadh yahay, sidaas darteed marka koowaad iyo labaad la kala saaro, ma aha isku suurtagal "2 gabdhood" ama "2 wiilal." Safafka 3 ilaa 5 waxay aamini saddexda nooc laga bilaabo safka 2, sidaas darteed xisaabaha ku jira way sax yihiin laakiin natiijadu waa khalad.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya xalka la saxay, hel suurtagalnimada labada ilmo inay labaduba yihiin gabdho, oo qor sababta qiimaha uga duwan yahay kii Seungwoo. (Ilmo kasta wuxuu yahay gabadh suurtagalnimo 1/2, labaduna waxaa loo malaynayaa inayna midba midka kale saameynin.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kala saar ilmaha sida koowaad iyo labaad, oo qor dhammaan isku-darrada jinsiga. Imisa ayaa jira, ma isku suurtagal yihiin?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tiri kiisaska ku habboon shuruudda oo keliya, oo barbar dhig imisa ka mid ah ayaa leh labada gabdho.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Haddii aan kala saarno ilmaha koowaad iyo labaad, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma taxday dhammaan kiisaska suurtagalka ah, adigoo kala saaraya ilmaha koowaad iyo labaad?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma haysay kiisaska ku habboon shuruudda oo keliya oo ma heshay saamiga kiisaska labada gabdho ee ku dhex jira?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma tiri "1 gabadh iyo 1 wiil" ma aha hal kiis?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Haddii aan kala saarno ilmaha koowaad iyo labaad, (gabadh, gabadh), (gabadh, wiil), (wiil, gabadh), iyo (wiil, wiil) dhammaantood waa isku suurtagal. 3 kiis ee ugu yaraan mid ay gabadh tahay dhexdooda, 1 wuxuu leeyahay labada gabdho, sidaas darteed suurtagalnimadu waa 1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: Hal gabadh iyo hal wiil waxay u kala qaybsamaan laba kiis, (koowaad gabadh, labaad wiil) iyo (koowaad wiil, labaad gabadh), sidaas darteed waa inaan loo tirin hal kiis. Sidaas darteed waxaa jira 3 kiis oo ku habboon shuruudda, mid keliya oo ka mid ahna wuxuu leeyahay labada gabdho, sidaas darteed suurtagalnimadu waa hal saddex-meelood.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Taxidda calaamado sida G iyo B way fiican tahay.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Haddii shuruuddu aysan ahayn "ugu yaraan mid waa gabadh" laakiin "ilmaha koowaad waa gabadh," waa maxay suurtagalnimada labada ilmo inay labaduba yihiin gabdho?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qor kiisaska ka harsan shuruuddan hoosteeda, adigoo kala saaraya ilmaha koowaad iyo labaad.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dhig liiska kiisaska harsan ee dhibaatadii hore agtiisa liiskan oo hel waxa isbeddelay.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad si khaldan u tirisay kiisaska ku habboon shuruudda, ama waxaad ku qasatay "ugu yaraan mid gabadh" iyo "labadaba gabdho."
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad bixisay suurtagalnimada wadarta asalka ah adigoon isticmaalin shuruudda. Marka ay jirto shuruud, kiisaska harsan way isbeddelaan.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad ula dhaqantay shuruudda dhibaatadii hore iyo tan sida isku mid. Markan jinsiga ilmaha labaad oo keliya ayaa la daayey furan.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Haddii ilmaha koowaad uu gabadh yahay, kiisaska harsan waa (gabadh, gabadh) iyo (gabadh, wiil), kuwaas oo isku suurtagal ah. Kuwan dhexdooda, 1 wuxuu leeyahay labada gabdho, sidaas darteed suurtagalnimadu waa 1/2. "Ugu yaraan mid waa gabadh" sidoo kale wuxuu oggol yahay (wiil, gabadh), sidaas darteed waxaa harsan 3 kiis suurtagalnimaduna waa 1/3. Meel muunadda harsan waxay ku xidhan tahay sida shuruudda loo qoray.

n-m-h3-est-02.title: Maxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u hesho dhererka kala-dhexaadka kalsoonida?

Haddii cabbirka muunaddu yahay n celceliska muunaddu na yahay x̄, dhexda kalsoonida 95% waa x̄−1.96×σ/√n ≤ m ≤ x̄+1.96×σ/√n.
