n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore sawir qaybtee ee qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka ayuu heerka kalsoonida 90% tilmaamayaa.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.1: U kala qaybi qaybtaas kala bar 0 oo barbar dhig qaabka shaxda P(0≤Z≤z).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.0: Leexashada caadiga ah ee celceliska muunadda waa σ/√n=8/√64=1.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.1: Heerka kalsoonidu waa 90%, sidaas darteed isticmaal z oo P(Z≤z)=0.90.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.3: Inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida waa 50−1.28×1 ≤ m ≤ 50+1.28×1.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa khalad. Heerka kalsoonida 90% macnaheedu waa suurtogalnimada u dhexeysa −z iyo z: P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90. Isku-simanaanta awgeed, P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, shaxdana z=1.645. Safafka 3, 4, iyo 5 waxay raacaan safka 2, sidaas darteed natiijooyinkoodu waa khalad. Inta u dhexeysa saxda ah waa 50±1.645×1, taasi waa, 48.355 ≤ m ≤ 51.645.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.prompt: Hel inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida 90% adigoo isticmaalaya xalka la saxay. Kadibna, adigoo isticmaalaya shaxda, xisaabi P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28) z=1.28 ee Jiho, qor heerka kalsoonida qiimahan u dhigmo, oo muuji sababta inta u dhexeysa Jiho aysan u ahayn mid 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor qiimaha P(0≤Z≤z) si P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, kadibna hel z shaxda.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.1: 1.28, ku dar P(0≤Z≤1.28) laba jeer (hal mar dhinac kasta).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.placeholder: tus. P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, sidaas darteed z=..., iyo inta u dhexeysa waa ... Z=1.28 ee Jiho, ...
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma heshay kala bar suurtogalnimada dhexe 0.90, taasoo ah 0.45, oo hel z=1.645?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma si sax ah u xisaabisay dhammaadyada sida 50±1.645×1?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma xisaabisay labada dhinac 1.28 (2×0.3997) oo xaqiijisay inay tahay ku dhawaad 80%?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.0: Haddii P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, markaas P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, sidaas darteed z=1.645. Inta u dhexeysa waa 50±1.645×1, sidaas darteed 48.355 ilaa 51.645. z=1.28 ee Jiho, P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28)=2×0.3997=0.7994, ku dhawaad 80%, sidaas darteed ma aha inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.1: z waa 1.645 inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida na waa [48.355, 51.645]. Haddii aad isticmaasho 1.28, suurtogalnimada isku darka labada dhinac waa 0.7994, ku dhawaad 80% oo keliya, sidaas darteed inta u dhexeysa aad bay u cidhiidhi tahay heerka kalsoonidiisuna wuu ka yar yahay 90%.

n-m-h3-est-07.title: Sahan Doorta Fasal Dhan: Ma Aamini Kartaa Celceliska Muunadda?
n-m-h3-est-07.goal: Fahan in arday kasta oo leh fursad siman oo la doorto ay ka duwan tahay muunadda oo si fiican u matasha dadweynaha, oo dhis oo sharax xaalad male-awaal ah oo daaha ka qaadda daciifnimada.
n-m-h3-est-07.material: Dugsi sare wuxuu leeyahay 20 fasal oo 30 arday ah mid walba, 600 arday guud ahaan. Waxaad qorshaynaysaa sida loo doorto 30 arday si loo sahamiyo celceliska wakhtiga hurdada maalinlaha ah.
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.0: Hubi haddii fursadaha la doorto ay siman yihiin
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.1: Dhis xaalad tusaale lid ku ah oo buuxisa shuruudaha
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.2: Sharax daciifnimada habka muunad qaadashada iyo sida loo hagaajiyo
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.0: Macnaha muunad qaadasho kediso ah iyo dadweyne
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.1: In celceliska muunaddu uu yahay qiime loo isticmaalo qiyaasidda celceliska dadweynaha
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hababka 600-ka arday dhammaantood ay leeyihiin isla suurtogalnimada in muunadda lagu doorto.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dooro hal arday oo qor, sida tibaax, suurtogalnimada ardaygaasi ku dhammaado muunadda habka kasta hoostiisa.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.1: Sidoo kale qaado arday sannadka koowaad, sannadka labaad, iyo sannadka saddexaad isku xigta oo hubi in suurtogalnimooyinku isku mid yihiin.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.a: Lambarayn liiska buuxa ee ardayda oo dooro 30 adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin kediso ah.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.a: Arday kasta waxaa la doortaa suurtogalnimo 30/600, dhammaantood isku mid. Hubi haddii aad seegtay habkan.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.b: Si kediso ah ugu soo bixi hal fasal 20-ka fasal oo dooro dhammaan 30-ka arday ee ku jira.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.b: Arday kasta waxaa la doortaa suurtogalnimo 1/20, fursadda fasalkooda la doorto, dhammaantood isku mid. Hubi haddii aad seegtay habkan.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.c: Si kediso ah u soo bixi 30 ka mid ah 200-ka arday ee sannadka saddexaad.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.c: Ardayda sannadka koowaad iyo labaad fursad la doorto gabi ahaanba ma laha. Waa cadaalad sannadka saddexaad dhexdiisa oo keliya, ma aha dhammaan ardayda.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.d: Dooro 30-ka arday ee ugu horreeya ee aad ku kulanto hoolka waqtiga qadada.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.d: Ardayda inta badan hoolka ku jirta waxay u badan yihiin in la kulmo, sidaas darteed suurtogalnimada la doorto arday ilaa arday way kala duwan tahay.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.explain: A, 30 ayaa laga doortaa 600, sidaas darteed arday kasta wuxuu leeyahay suurtogalnimo 30/600, B na hal fasal oo 20 ka mid ah ayaa la doortaa, sidaas darteed arday kasta waxaa la doortaa suurtogalnimo 1/20=30/600. C suurtogalnimada ardayda sannadka koowaad iyo labaad waa 0, D na suurtogalnimada la kulmidda arday ilaa arday way kala duwan tahay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, B wuxuu bixiyaa fursado siman laakiin ardayda wada la doortay waxay isu eg yihiin, sidaas darteed ma loo tixgelin karo isla habka A.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.prompt: Ka soo qaad dugsigu wuxuu leeyahay laba fasal oo 30 arday ah mid walba oo keliya. Haddii aad si kediso ah u soo bixiso hal fasal oo aad u isticmaasho 30-kiisa arday sida muunad, fasal kasta oo la doorto, muunaddu waa inay ka duwanaato celceliska wakhtiga hurdada dugsiga oo dhan ugu yaraan 1 saac. Samee 2 lammaane oo kala duwan oo celcelisyada wakhtiga hurdada labada fasal a iyo b (saacado, laga bilaabo 4 ilaa 10 oo ay ku jiraan) oo gali.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka labada fasal ay leeyihiin tiro arday oo isku mid ah, marka hore qor celceliska dugsiga oo dhan marka loo eego a iyo b.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hel farqiga u dhexeeya celceliska fasalka la doortay iyo celceliska dugsiga oo dhan, oo dooro farqiga a iyo b si uu u noqdo ugu yaraan 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waxay u dhexeeyaan 4 iyo 10 oo ay ku jiraan labadooda.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a ama b ma u dhexeeyaan 4 iyo 10 oo ay ku jiraan labadooda.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Fasal kasta oo la doorto, wuxuu ka duwan yahay celceliska dugsiga oo dhan ugu yaraan 1 saac.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Iyadoo ku xidhan fasalka la doorto, waxaa jira kiis uu ka duwan yahay celceliska dugsiga oo dhan wax ka yar 1 saac.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.explain: Maadaama labada fasal ay leeyihiin tiro arday oo isku mid ah, celceliska dugsiga oo dhan waa (a+b)/2, fasal kasta oo la doortona, inta uu ka duwan yahay waa isku mid, |a−b|/2. Si ay u noqoto ugu yaraan 1, |a−b|≥2. Tusaale ahaan, haddii fasaladu celcelis yihiin 6 saacadood iyo 8 saacadood, celceliska dugsigu waa 7 saacadood, dooridda hal fasal waxay siinaysaa 6 ama 8 saacadood, mid walba wuxuu ka duwan yahay 7 1 saac.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.prompt: Barbar dhig habka fasalka oo dhan iyo habka doorashada 30 ka mid ah 600-ka arday adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin kediso ah. Adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalaha aad kor ku samaysay, sharax daciifnimada dooridda fasal dhan, oo qor hal hab oo lagu yareeyo daciifnimadan.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tusaalaha aad samaysay, ku qor tirooyin sida celceliska muunaddu u is beddelo iyadoo ku xidhan fasalka la doorto.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir ardayda imisa fasal ayaa ku dhammaata hal muunad marka 30 la doorto adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin kediso ah.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.placeholder: tus. Ardayda isla fasalka ... sidaas darteed ... Si loo yareeyo tan ...
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday daciifnimada adigoo isticmaalaya labada celcelis ee fasalka ee aad kor ku samaysay?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay in xitaa fursado siman oo la doorto, celceliska muunaddu uu ka fogaan karo?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Hagaajintaadu ma ku socotaa jihada isku darista ardayda dhowr fasal?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.0: Ardayda isla fasalka waxay leeyihiin caadooyin isu eg, sidaas darteed haddii aad doorato fasal dhan, celceliska muunaddu wuu ka fogaan karaa celceliska dugsiga oo dhan iyadoo ku xidhan fasalka la doorto. Tusaale ahaan, fasal 6 saacadood iyo fasal 8 saacadood, midka la doorto kasta wuxuu ka duwan yahay 1 saac. Waad yareyn kartaa adigoo ku dooranaya tirooyin kediso ah liiska buuxa, ama adigoo doorta dhowr arday fasal kasta.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.1: Ardayda hal fasal ku jirta way isu eg yihiin, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii aad doorato 30, macluumaadku ma qiimo leh 30 arday. Haddii fasaladu leeyihiin celcelisyo kala duwan, natiijadu aad bay u kala duwan tahay iyadoo ku xidhan fasalka la doorto (qaladku wuu weynaadaa), wuuna hagaagaa haddii aad si kediso ah oo siman u doorato fasallo badan.

n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ogtahay ilaa hadda oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Isku-dhafyada cayiman iyadoo aan lahayn antiderivative
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Isku-dhafka: isku-dhafyada cayiman iyadoo la adeegsanayo bedelid iyo isku-dubbaridda kala-dhexaadka (helista qiimaha iyadoo aan lahayn antiderivative)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Dib u eegista xukunkaaga marka macluumaadku kordho, xaqiiji in xidhiidh isku-dubbarid ah oo laga helay bedelid uu go'aamiyo qiimaha isku-dhaf cayiman adigoo aan helin antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Raac, tallaabo tallaabo, habka helista qiimaha isku-dhafka cayiman I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (∫_0^{π/2} waa isku-dhafka cayiman laga bilaabo 0 ilaa π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.0: Qiyaas cabbirka natiijo si ku dhawaad ah
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.1: Tiri tirada isla'egaha iyo tirada aan la aqoon
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.2: Eeg jihada kala-dhexaadka ka dib bedelid
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Xukun shuruudaha isla habkaas uu ku shaqeeyo
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo muuqdo, tiri "immisa aan la aqoon iyo immisa isla'eg ayaa jira."
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii qiyaastaadii koowaad iyo qiimaha dambe la helay aysan aad u kala duwanayn.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Way adag tahay in si toos ah loo helo antiderivative tibaaxdan. Qiyamka shaqada isku-dhafka h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) waa h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, dhererka kala-dhexaadkuna waa π/2 (qiyaastii 1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Qiyaasta cabbirka I kee ayaa ugu habboon?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Dhererku wuxuu ka kacaa 0 ilaa 1 isagoo leh qiime dhexe 1/2, sidaas darteed bedku waa qiyaastii ku wareegsan (1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Qiyaastan waxaa dambe loo isticmaali karaa si loo hubiyo haddii qiimaha aad heshay uu sax yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I waa qiyaastii 1.57: sababtoo ah waxaad dhererka u qaadataa 1 oo ku dhufataa dhererka 1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Dhererku waa 1 dhammaadka kala-dhexaadka oo keliya. Qiyaastani waxay dhererka u qaadataa 1 kala-dhexaadka oo dhan.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I waa qiyaastii 0.8: sababtoo ah dhererku wuxuu u kala duwan yahay 0 ilaa 1, celcelisku waa qiyaastii 1/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad qiyaastay isbeddelka dhererka adigoo isticmaalaya celcelis. Ma aha qiimaha saxda ah, laakiin waxaa loo isticmaali karaa cabbirka.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I waa 0: sababtoo ah h(0)=0 barta bilowga
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Qiimaha oo ah 0 hal bar ma ka dhigto isku-dhafka cayiman 0. Eeg qiyamka kala-dhexaadka oo dhan.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Sidoo kale eeg J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Ku darista labada jajab waxay ka dhigtaa soo-qaybiyaha mid la mid ah hooseeyaha, sidaas darteed I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ma I la go'aamin karaa macluumaadkan oo keliya?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Waxaa jirta hal isla'eg oo keliya, I+J=π/2, sidaas darteed I iyo J si gooni gooni ah looma go'aamin karo. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad hesho hal xidhiidh oo kale oo u dhexeeya I iyo J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waa la go'aamin karaa: I+J=π/2, sidaas darteed I=π/4.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad u kala qaybisay badh adigoon hubin haddii I=J. I+J=π/2 waa hal xidhiidh oo u dhexeeya I iyo J oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lama go'aamin karo: I+J=π/2 ma caawiso gabi ahaanba helista I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Qiimaha I+J waa macluumaad faa'iido leh. Wuxuu bixiyay hal xidhiidh oo u dhexeeya I iyo J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Weli ma ku filna: waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato hal xidhiidh oo kale oo u dhexeeya I iyo J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad xustay in ay jiraan laba aan la aqoon, I iyo J, laakiin hal isla'eg oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: J gudaheeda, ha noqdo x=π/2−t. Markaas dx=−dt, marka x ka kaco 0 ilaa π/2-na, t wuxuu ka kacaa π/2 ilaa 0. Maadaama sin(π/2−t)=cos t iyo cos(π/2−t)=sin t, J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, taas oo la mid I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J iyo I+J=π/2, sidaa darteed I=π/4 (ku dhawaad 0.785). Tani aad bay ula jaanqaadaysaa qiyaastii koowaad ee 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I=π/4: sababtoo ah J=I iyo I+J=π/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad isku isticmaashay labada isla'ego I=J iyo I+J=π/2. Sidoo kale waxay la jaanqaadaysaa qiyaastii koowaad ee 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad qiimaha I+J ku qaldatay qiimaha I. J sidoo kale wuxuu kujiraa isla xaddigaas.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad dhererka hal bar dhexe ku qaldatay qiimaha isku-darka go'an. Waa inaad dhererka ku dhufataa dhererka xadka.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga qiyaas oo keliya ayaa suurtagal ahayd, xataa ka dib marka la helay isla'egta I+J, muhiim ayay ahayd in "badh u kala qaybinta" weli aad u hore tahay. Kaliya ka dib marka beddelku siiyay xiriirka J=I ayaa I la go'aamiyey. Adigoo isticmaalaya isku-midka xadka isku-dar go'an, waxaad heli kartaa qiimaha adigoo aan helin hawl asal ah.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Marka aad J ku beddesho x=π/2−t, dx=−dt, haddana J wuxuu noqdaa +I ma aha −I. Sharax sababta, adigoo xooga saaraya xadka isku-darka (sare iyo hoose).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hel qiimaha t ee u dhigma x=0 iyo x=π/2, oo qor xadka sare iyo hoose ee isku-darka cusub.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qor waxa ku dhaca calaamadda marka isku-dar go'an oo xadkiisa sare ka yar yahay xadkiisa hoose dib loogu celiyo jihada caadiga ah.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma naftaada u qortay in ka dib beddelka xadka hoose uu yahay π/2 xadka sare na 0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Marka x laga bilaabo 0 ilaa π/2, t waxay ka socotaa π/2 ilaa 0, sidaa darteed xadka sare iyo hoose ee isku-darka waa is beddelaan. Rogidda xadku waxay beddeshaa calaamadda, oo iyada iyo dhimista dx=−dt calaamadaha way is baabi'iyaan, sidaa darteed J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Ka dib beddelka, xadku waa rogan yahay, laga bilaabo π/2 ilaa 0. Saxidda xadka rogan waxay abuurtaa hal calaamad dhimis, tan iyo dhimista dx=−dt ayaa is baabi'iya, sidaa darteed calaamaddu waxay ku dambaysaa togan.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Dooro isku-darka go'an oo qiimihiisa lagu heli karo isla habkii lagu helay I (ku beddel x π/2−x oo ku dar tibaaxda lammaanaha ah).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, qor waxa ku dhaca xadka iyo hoosaadka marka x lagu beddelo π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi haddii korreeyaha iyo hoosaadku isle'eg noqdaan marka aad ku darto tibaaxda asalka ah iyo tibaaxda la beddelay.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Haddii xadku yahay [0,π/3], markaas x iyo π/2−x lammaane kuma aha isla xadkaas dhexdiisa, sidaa darteed habka kore ma shaqeeyo sida uu yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Hoosaadku isku mid ma aha, sidaa darteed xataa haddii aad ku darto tibaaxda lammaanaha ah jajabku kuma fududaanayo hal tiro.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in ku beddelidda x π/2−x ay is beddesho sin³ iyo cos³, iyo in isugeynta labada tibaax ay tahay 1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Hoosaadku wuxuu noqonayaa 0 xadka dhexdiisa (x=3π/4), sidaa darteed isku-darka go'anku xataa ma qeexna.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: c, xadka [0,π/2] wuxuu isku khariidaa x→π/2−x, hoosaadka sin³x+cos³x na waa isku mid, sidaa darteed ku darista tibaaxda lammaanaha ah waxay siinaysaa 1. Sidaa darteed qiimuhu waa π/4. Dhibaatada a waa xadka, b isku-midka hoosaadka, d na barta hoosaadku yahay 0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Sharaxaadda Farqiga Celceliska Muunadaha Labada Magaalo Saaxiib Si Sax ah
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Marka laba celcelis muunad ay yar ku kala duwan yihiin, xisaabi dhexda kalsoonida si aad u hubiso is-dulsaarka, ka dibna dib u qor sheegashada erayo aan ku dhawaaqin guuleysta, oo u sharax saaxiib.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Maqaal wargeys deegaan: "Ardayda dugsiga sare ee Magaalada A waxay isticmaalaan taleefoonnada gacanta celcelis ahaan 3.4 saacadood maalintii, in ka badan Magaalada B (3.1 saacadood). Ardayda Magaalada A waxay isticmaalaan wakhti dheer." Labada magaalo, 100 arday ayaa si random ah loo muunad qaaday, wakhtiga isticmaalku wuxuu raacaa qaybinta caadiga ah, leexashada caadiga ah ee dadweynaha na waxaa la yaqaan inay tahay 1.5 saacadood labada magaalo.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Naftaada xisaabi dhexda kalsoonida oo barbar dhig
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Kala saar farqiga qiyaasyada bar iyo is-dulsaarka dhexda
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Dib u qor saxid si ay ugu habboonaato qofka helaya
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Dhexda kalsoonida ee celceliska dadweynaha ee qaybinta caadiga ah leh leexashada caadiga ah ee dadweynaha la yaqaan
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Hel dhexda kalsoonida 95% ee celceliska dadweynaha magaalo kasta oo gali qiimayaasha lagu wareejiyey god tobanaad saddexaad (sidaas darteed, laba god tobanaad). (Magaalada A: xadka hoose iyo sare; Magaalada B: xadka hoose iyo sare)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hel leexashada caadiga ah ee celceliska muunadda hal magaalo, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ku dhufo qiimahaas 1.96 si aad u hesho xadka khaladka, ka dibna ku dar oo ka jar celceliska muunadda magaalo kasta.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c1: Dhexda Magaalada A ma aha mid sax ah. Hubi 3.4 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Dhexda Magaalada B ma aha mid sax ah. Hubi 3.1 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.explain: Celceliska muunadda ± 1.96×1.5/√100 = ± 0.294, sidaas darteed Magaalada A waa 3.106 ilaa 3.694 Magaalada B na waa 2.806 ilaa 3.394. Haddii aadan u qaybin √n, sida 3.4±1.96×1.5, dhexdu aad bay u ballaadhan tahay, haddii aad isticmaasho z=1.645 na, waxaad heleysaa dhex 90%.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.prompt: Marka la eego labada dhex ee kalsoonida, dooro xukunka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan maqaalka.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sawir labada dhex xariiqda tirada oo hubi haddii ay is dulsaaraan.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii qiimaha qaybta is dulsaaran ee ay noqon karto celceliska dadweynaha labada magaalo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.a: Magaalada A waa ka dheer tahay, sababtoo ah celceliska muunaddeeda waa 0.3 saacadood ka weyn
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad barbar dhigtay cabbirrada celcelisyada muunadda oo keliya. Celceliska muunaddu wuu is beddelaa muunad ilaa muunad, sidaas darteed marka qaladka la tixgeliyo, kala horreyntu way rogmataa.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.b: Way adag tahay in si hubaal ah loo yidhaahdo Magaalada A ayaa ka dheer; intaa u dhexeysa way is dul dhacaan, sidaas darteed weli waxay noqon karaan siman.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.c: Labada magaalo waa isku mid, sababtoo ah labada inta u dhexeysa way is dul dhacaan, sidaas darteed celcelisyada dadweynaha waxaa loo tixgelin karaa siman.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad is dul dhaca u akhrisay caddayn ‘isku mid.’ Is dul dhac macnaheedu waa in siman noqoshadu weli suurtogal tahay; ma xaqiijinayo inay siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.d: Lama xukumi karo; 100 arday oo keliya magaalo kasta, barbar dhig micno leh ma jiro.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.d: Muunad yar ma ka dhigto inta u dhexeysa waxtar la'aan. Weli waxay kuu sheegaysaa xadkee ayay celcelisyadu ku jiraan.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.explain: Labada inta u dhexeysa, 2.806 ilaa 3.394 iyo 3.106 ilaa 3.694, waxay is dul dhacaan laga bilaabo 3.106 ilaa 3.394. Is dul dhac waa hubin dhakhso ah oo keliya; si sax ah, waa inaad eegtaa haddii inta u dhexeysa 95% ee farqiga labada celcelis ay ka kooban tahay 0. Halkan inta u dhexeysa farqiga waa ku dhawaad −0.12 ilaa 0.72, taasoo ka kooban 0, sidaas darteed way adag tahay in la gabagabeeyo in Magaalada A ay ka dheer tahay. Laakiin lama caddeynin sidoo kale in labada celcelis ay siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa akhriyay maqaalkan oo ku dhejiyay wada-sheekaysiga kooxda, "Carruurta magaalada A hubaal waxay taleefannadooda ka isticmaalaan wakhti ka dheer carruurta magaalada B." Marka loo eego xisaabaadka inta u dhexeysa ee kor ku xusan, qor fariin sax ah oo ka kooban laba ama saddex jumladood, erayo ay fahmi karto saaxiib dugsiga sare ah.

n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kadibna, erayo fudud, sii wad suurtogalnimada is dul dhaca inta u dhexeysa ay furan tahay.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.placeholder: tus. Maqaalku wuxuu leeyahay 3.4 saacadood iyo 3.1 saacadood, laakiin ...
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ku qortay erayo fudud oo saaxiibkaa fahmi karo?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay is dul dhaca inta u dhexeysa sida caddayntaada ugu yaraan hal mar?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ilaaliyay dheelitir adigoo leh "way adag tahay in la hubiyo" halkii "khalad"?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.0: Kaliya sababtoo ah A waa 3.4 saacadood B-na 3.1, goor hore ayay tahay in la yidhaahdo A ayaa ka dheer. Waxay sahamiyeen 100 arday oo keliya mid kasta, inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida 95%, ku dhawaad 3.11 ilaa 3.69 A iyo ku dhawaad 2.81 ilaa 3.39 B, way is dul dhacaan. Dhab ahaan, labada magaalo waxay noqon karaan ku dhawaad isku mid.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.1: Farqiga celcelisyada muunadda ee 0.3 saacadood wuxuu ku jiraa xadka qaladka. Maadaama labada inta u dhexeysa kalsoonida ay is dul dhacaan, way adag tahay in la yidhaahdo A ayaa isticmaasha wakhti dheer, waxayna noqon karaan siman.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.2: Farqigu waa 0.3 saacadood oo keliya, sidaas darteed waxay noqon karaan isku mid ah, hubaal na ma odhan karo. Labada inta u dhexeysa way is dul dhacaan.

n-m-h3-integc-02.title: Samaynta shaqooyin saddex-jibbaar oo kala duwan oo leh isku-dhaf cayiman 4
n-m-h3-integc-02.topic: Isku-dhafka: sifooyinka isku-dhafyada cayiman — is baabbi'inta ereyada awoodda aan lammaan ahayn kala-dhexaad isku-dubbarid ah
n-m-h3-integc-02.goal: Isticmaal xaqiiqada ah in isku-dhafyada cayiman ee ereyada awoodda aan lammaan ahayn kala-dhexaad isku-dubbarid ah ay yihiin 0 si aad u dhisto shaqooyin kala duwan oo leh isla isku-dhaf cayiman, oo sharax qaab-dhismeedka.
n-m-h3-integc-02.material: Tixgeli isku-dhafka cayiman ee shaqada saddex-jibbaarka f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d [−1,1]. (x³ waxay la macno tahay x saddex-jibbaaran, ∫_{-1}^{1}-na waa isku-dhafka cayiman laga bilaabo −1 ilaa 1.)
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.0: Arag haddii qaybo tibaax ay is baabbi'iyaan kala-dhexaad isku-dubbarid ah
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.1: Dhis shaqooyin kala duwan oo siinaya isla isku-dhaf cayiman
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.2: Hubi shuruudaha habkan lagu isticmaali karo (kala-dhexaad isku-dubbarid ah, awood aan lammaan ahayn)
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.0: Xisaabinta isku-dhafyada cayiman ee shaqooyinka polynomial-ka
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.1: Sida calaamadda qiimaha shaqo ugu kala duwan tahay x iyo −x
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan shaqooyinka isku-dhafkoodu cayiman [−1,1] yahay 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tibaax kasta u kala qaybi ereyo oo calaamadee ereyada isbeddela sida marka aad bedesho −x x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dooro hal tibaax oo isku-dhafkiisa cayiman aanu ahayn 0 oo xisaabi isku-dhafka eray kasta [−1,1] si aad u hubiso.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.a: Ereyada awoodda lammaanka ah waxay leeyihiin isla qiime x iyo −x, sidaas darteed ma is baabbi'iyaan. Xisaabi isku-dhafka cayiman ee mid walba oo ka mid ah labada eray.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in ay jiraan ereyo awood aan lammaan ahayn oo keliya, sidaas darteed qiyamka x iyo −x waa ka soo horjeedaan.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.e: Waxaad aragtay in ay jiraan ereyo awood aan lammaan ahayn oo keliya, sidaas darteed qiyamka x iyo −x waa ka soo horjeedaan.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.c: Ereyga joogtada ah 1 wuxuu leeyahay isla qiime x iyo −x, sidaas darteed ma is baabbi'iyo. Hubi isku-dhafka ereyga joogtada ah.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ereyga x wuu is baabbi'a laakiin ereyga x² ma is baabbi'o. Waxaad ku xukuntay tibaaxda oo dhan hal eray oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.explain: Ereyada qiyamkoodu x iyo −x yihiin kuwo is-diidan (x, x³, x⁵, …), bedka bidix iyo bedka midig ee [−1,1] waxay ku kala duwan yihiin calaamadda oo keliya, sidaas darteed isku-dhafka cayiman waa 0. x⁴−x² waa 2/5−2/3, x³+1 waa 2, x²+x-na waa 2/3, midna ma aha 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.prompt: Ha noqdo f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d waa tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo −20 ilaa 20 oo ay ku jiraan) oo leh ∫_{-1}^{1} f(x)dx = 4, oo samee saddex f oo kala duwan oo runtii leh eray x³ iyo eray x (a≠0, c≠0). Geli a, b, c, d mid kasta.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore xisaabi waxa aad heshid marka aad isku-dhafto ax³ iyo cx si gooni gooni ah [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore dooro (b, d) si tibaaxda hadhay 2b/3+2d ay u la mid noqoto 4, ka dibna buuxi a iyo c adigoo isticmaalaya lambarro aan eber ahayn.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Dhammaan afarta isku-dhufte waa tirooyin dhan baaxadda gudaheeda.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Afarta isku-dhufte waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo −20 ilaa 20 oo ay ku jiraan.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Haddii a uu yahay 0, eray x³ ma jiro.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Haddii c uu yahay 0, eray x ma jiro.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.explain: [−1,1], ∫ax³dx=0 iyo ∫cx dx=0, sidaas darteed ∫f(x)dx = 2b/3 + 2d. Haddii tani tahay 4, markaas b+3d=6. Tusaalayaasha waa (1,0,2,2), (3,3,−1,1), iyo (−2,6,5,0). (1,3,2,2) wuxuu siinayaa 2+4=6, ma aha 4, tusaalayaasha leh a=0 ama c=0 waxaa ka reebay shuruudaha.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka dib helista saddex ama ka badan f oo kala duwan, waxaad aragtaa in isku-dhafka cayiman uu sii ahaado isku mid inkasta oo a iyo c ay si xor ah u isbeddelaan. Sharax sababta.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Xisaabi isku-dhafka mid walba oo ka mid ah ax³ iyo cx [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qor sidii tibaax haddii isku-dhafka ereyada hadhay uu isticmaalo b iyo d oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma ku xidhay sababta x³ iyo x ay u leeyihiin isku-dhaf cayiman 0 [−1,1] isku-dubbaridda kala-dhexaadka?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma xaqiijisay tibaax in isku-dhafka uu go'aansan yahay b iyo d hadhay oo keliya?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: ax³ iyo cx waxay leeyihiin calaamado is-diidan x iyo −x, sidaas darteed [−1,1] isku-dhafyadooda cayiman way is baabbi'iyaan oo waa 0. Sidaas darteed qiimaha waxaa go'aamiya isku-dhafyada bx² iyo d oo keliya, 2b/3+2d.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Isku-dhafyada cayiman ee ereyada awoodda aan lammaan ahayn ax³ iyo cx waa 0, sidaas darteed a iyo c ma saameyn karaan qiimaha. Kaliya b awood lammaanka ah iyo ereyga joogtada ah d ayaa saameyn leh.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.prompt: Sifadani waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka kala-dhexaadku isku-dubbaridan yahay 0 agtiisa, sida [−1,1]. Dooro isku-dhafka cayiman ee habkani ku habboon yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore hubi haddii kala-dhexaadku bartamihiisu yahay 0, iyadoo dhererka bidix iyo midig siman yihiin.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ka dibna hubi haddii beddelidda x −x shaqada isku-dhafka ay beddesho calaamadda oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad xustay in kala-dhexaadku isku-dubbaridan yahay 0 agtiisa shaqada isku-dhafkuna leedahay ereyo awood aan lammaan ahayn oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.b: Shaqada isku-dhafku waa shaqo lammaan ah, sidaas darteed is baabbi'in ma dhacdo. Xisaabi qiimaha dhabta ah.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.c: Kala-dhexaadka [0,2] ma aha isku-dubbaridan 0 agtiisa. Xitaa shaqo aan lammaan ahayn, kala-dhexaadku waa inuu isku-dubbaridan yahay si bidix iyo midig is baabbi'iyaan.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.d: Kala-dhexaadka [−1,3] ma aha isku-dubbaridan 0 agtiisa. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad si gooni gooni ah u maareyso qaybta isku-dubbaridan iyo qaybta aan isku-dubbaridnayn.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.explain: ∫_{-2}^{2}(x³−4x)dx waa 0 sababtoo ah kala-dhexaadku waa isku-dubbaridan shaqada isku-dhafkuna waxay leedahay ereyo awood aan lammaan ahayn oo keliya. [0,2] iyo [−1,3] ma aha isku-dubbaridan, sidaas darteed isla markiiba ma odhan kartid isku-dhafku waa 0, x²−4-na waa shaqo lammaan ah, sidaas darteed ma is baabbi'o (qiimuhu waa −32/3).

n-m-h3-integc-03.title: Mugga ka dhasha wareejinta gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc: halkee ayuu ku khaldamay?
n-m-h3-integc-03.topic: Isku-dhafka: mugga jidh ka sameysmay wareejinta gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc (qaabka qaybta)
n-m-h3-integc-03.goal: Xal ku saabsan mugga jidhka wareegga ee gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc, hel oo hagaaji safka khaldamay qaabka qaybta, oo garo mugga gobolka kee ayay tibaaxda khaldan runtii siinayso.
n-m-h3-integc-03.material: Soyoung wuxuu helay mugga jidhka ka dhashay wareejinta gobolka ay xidhaan labada qalooc y=x iyo y=x² hal mar x-axis. (x² waxay la macno tahay x laba-jibbaaran.)
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.1: Dib u shaqee si aad u hesho gobolka tibaaxda khaldan matasho
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.2: Xaqiiji khaladka adigoo si toos ah u barbar dhigaya bedadka qaybaha
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.0: Mugga jidhka wareegga ee ku saabsan x-axis
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.1: Sawirka gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka Soyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dooro hal bar sida x=1/2 oo sawir inta uu gobolku ka fog yahay x-axis halkaas iyo halka uu u fidayo.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Go'aami haddii qaybta la wareejiyay ay tahay saxan adag ama saxan leh god.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.0: Qalooyinka y=x iyo y=x² waxay kulmaan x=0 iyo x=1, 0≤x≤1-na, x≥x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.1: Marka gobolkan la wareejiyo x-axis, qaybta x waa goobo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.2: Sidaas darteed mugga waa V = π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa kan ugu horreeya ee khaldamay. Marka gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc la wareejiyo x-axis, qaybtu waa washer, saxan leh god (garab-dhexaadka dibadda x, garab-dhexaadka gudaha x²). Ma aha goobo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay farqiga labada garab-dhexaad. Laga bilaabo safka 3, xisaabtu waxay raacaysaa qaybta khaldan ee safka 2, sidaas darteed xisaabtu waa sax laakiin natiijadu waa khalad.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.prompt: Hagaaji safka khaldan oo hel mugga. Ka dibna, adigoo isticmaalaya qaybta x=1/2, sharax hal ama laba jumladood sababta tibaaxda Soyoung aysan u sax ahayn.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sawir qaybta x si aad u hubiso haddii ay tahay goobo weyn oo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay x oo laga saaray goobo yar oo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.1: x=1/2, qor oo barbar dhig bedadka goobada weyn, goobada yar, iyo goobada Soyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay garab-dhexaadka dibadda iyo garab-dhexaadka gudaha ee qaybta x oo aad heshay bedkeeda?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma barbar dhigtay bedka qaybta Soyoung iyo kan saxda ah x=1/2?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma garatay in (x−x²)² iyo x²−x⁴ ay kala duwan yihiin?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.0: Qaybta x waa washer leh garab-dhexaad dibadda x iyo garab-dhexaad gudaha x², sidaas darteed bedkeedu waa π(x²−x⁴). V=π∫_0^1 (x²−x⁴)dx=π(1/3−1/5)=2π/15. x=1/2 qaybta saxda ahi waa π(1/4−1/16)=3π/16, laakiin tibaaxda Soyoung waa goobo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay 1/4, taas oo ah π/16 oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.1: Qaybta ka dhalata wareejinta gobolka u dhexeeya laba qalooc waa saxanka weyn oo laga jaray saxanka yar, sidaas darteed waa π(x²)−π(x²)², mugguna waa 2π/15. Laba-jibbaarida farqiga garab-dhexaadyada ma la mid aha farqiga bedadka goobooyinka waaweyn iyo yaryar.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.prompt: Tibaaxda Soyoung heshay, π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx, waa mugga wareejinta gobolka kee hal mar x-axis?

n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, qor qaabka qaybta x marka lagu wareejiyo x-axis.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.a: Gobolka ay xidhaan y=x iyo y=x²
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.a: Gobolkani wuxuu sameeyaa qayb leh god, sidaas darteed waxaad u baahan lahayd inaad isku-dhafto π(x²−x⁴). Hubi qaybta x=1/2.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.b: Gobolka ay xidhaan y=x, x-axis, iyo x=1
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.b: Qaybta gobolkan waa goobo adag oo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay x, sidaas darteed waxay noqotaa π∫x²dx.

n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad xustay in kani yahay gobolka soo saara goobooyin adag oo garab-dhexaadkoodu yahay dhererka qalooca x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.explain: y=x−x² waa ugu yaraan 0 0≤x≤1, marka gobolka u dhexeeya qaloocan iyo x-axis lagu wareejiyo x-axis-na, qaybtu waa goobo adag oo garab-dhexaadkeedu yahay x−x². n-m-h3-integc-05.title: Isku-darka Go'an ee Hawlaha Xilliga leh: Maxaad u Baahan tahay inaad Ogaato?

n-m-h3-integc-05.goal: Marka la helayo isku-dar go'an oo hawl xilli leh, kala saar macluumaadka loo baahan yahay (xilliga, qiimaha hal xilli) iyo waxa aan loo baahnayn, oo xaqiiji in furaha uu yahay haddii dhererka xaduhu yahay jibbaar xilliga.
n-m-h3-integc-05.material: Waxaa jira hawl joogto ah f. Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho qiimaha isku-darka go'an ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (∫_2^{11} waa isku-darka go'an laga bilaabo 2 ilaa 11.)

Meel kasta oo xadka xilligu ka bilaabmo, isku-darka go'an ee hal xad celinaya waa isku mid, sidaa darteed ∫_2^{11} f = 3×6 = 18. Taas waxaad u baahan tahay xilliga (b) iyo qiimaha isku-darka go'an ee hal xilli (d), wax kale na looma baahna.

n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qor ∫_0^2 px dx iyo ∫_0^2 q dx adigoo isticmaalaya p iyo q, oo isbarbar dhigooda u beddel shuruud.

n-m-h3-integc-06.title: Isku-darka Qaybaha: Ma Dooran Kartaa u Sida Aad Doonto?
n-m-h3-integc-06.topic: Isku-darka: halbeegyada dooridda u iyo v' isku-darka qaybaha
n-m-h3-integc-06.goal: Xaqiiji in adkaanta isku-darka hadhay ay ku xidhan tahay sida aad u dooranayso u iyo v' isku-darka qaybaha, oo sharax halbeegyada dooridda ereyo saaxiib fahmi karo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.material: Hajun wuxuu u sameeyey isku-dar qaybo ∫ x eˣ dx isagoo isticmaalaya u=eˣ iyo v'=x, tibaaxduna waxay noqotay mid ka dhib badan. Hajun wuxuu yiri, "Ma dooran kartaa u iyo v' sida aad doonto isku-darka qaybaha?" (eˣ waa e awoodda x, ln x na waa logarithm dabiici ah oo x.)
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.0: Isbarbar dhig sida isku-darka hadhay u beddelo iyadoo ku xidhan doorashada
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.1: Deji halbeeg dooris (way fududaataa marka la kala duwo / way fududahay in la isku daro)
n-m-h3-integc-06.prereq.1: Dhalmooyinka iyo isku-darrada hawlaha logarithm iyo exponential
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.prompt: Hajun wuxuu u sameeyey isku-dar qaybo ∫ x eˣ dx isagoo isticmaalaya u=eˣ iyo v'=x. Kee ka mid ah kuwa soo socda ayaa qeexaya waxa dhaca doorashadan?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Marka u=eˣ iyo v'=x, naftaada u hel u' iyo v oo qor isku-darka dhinaca midig ee qaacidada uv − ∫u'v dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig isku-darka asalka ah iyo isku-darka hadhay oo eeg sida awoodda x u beddeshay.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.a: Isku-darka hadhay wuxuu ka kooban yahay x², sidaa darteed awoodda x runtii way kor u kacdaa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad aragtay in haddii u iyo v' la beddelo, isku-darka v' uu kordhiyo awoodda, natiijana isku-darka hadhay wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka dhib badan kii asalka ahaa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.b: Isku-darka hadhay wuxuu noqonayaa 0, sidaa darteed jawaabta isla markiiba ayaa soo baxda.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.b: Si isku-darka hadhay u noqdo 0, u'v waa inuu noqdaa 0. Naftaada u hel u' iyo v oo hubi.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.c: Qaacidada isku-darka qaybaha ma run aha, sidaa darteed lama xallin karo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.c: Qaacidadu waa run lakab kasta oo aad u qaadato u. Waxa is beddela waa adkaanta isku-darka hadhay.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.d: Isku-darka hadhay waa eˣ oo keliya, sidaa darteed aad buu u fududaanayaa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.d: Waxa hadha waa wax-ku-dhafka u'=eˣ iyo v=x²/2. Naftaada u hel u' iyo v.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.explain: Marka u=eˣ iyo v'=x, u'=eˣ iyo v=x²/2, sidaa darteed ∫ x eˣ dx = (x²/2)eˣ − ∫ (x²/2)eˣ dx. Isku-darka hadhay wuxuu leeyahay x oo awood hal ka sarreysa kii asalka ahaa, sidaa darteed wuu adkaaday. Qaacidadu waa run, laakiin doorashadu ma ahayn mid fiican. Haddii aad qaadato u=x iyo v'=eˣ, isku-darka hadhay waa ∫ eˣ dx oo keliya.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho ∫ x ln x dx adigoo isticmaalaya isku-darka qaybaha. Dooro talada ku habboon ee Hajun la siiyo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, marka hore hubi haddii aad isla markiiba heli karto v.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig haddii wax-ku-dhafka u' iyo v uu ka fudud yahay isku-darka asalka ah.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.a: Kan ugu fudud waa in la qaato u=x iyo v'=ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.a: Helitaanka v v'=ln x isla markiiba ma aha (v=x ln x−x). Isku-darka hadhay sidoo kale wuxuu leeyahay ln x oo ma fududaado.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.b: Kan ugu fudud waa in la qaato u=1 iyo v'=x ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.b: Helitaanka hawl asal ah ee v'=x ln x waa isla dhibaatadii asalka ahayd, sidaa darteed horumar ma jiro.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.c: Kan ugu fudud waa in la qaato u=ln x iyo v'=x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad u qaadatay lakabka marka la kala duwo uu fududaado (ln x) sida u iyo lakabka isku-darkiisu fudud yahay (x) sida v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.d: Ma jiro farqi sida aad u dooranayso, maadaama isku-darka hadhay uu isku adag yahay, sidaa darteed wax kasta dooro.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.d: Iyadoo ku xidhan doorashada, isku-darka hadhay wuu fududaan karaa ama wuu adkaan karaa. Xusuuso khibraddii Hajun ee tallaabadii hore.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.explain: Marka u=ln x iyo v'=x, u'=1/x iyo v=x²/2, ∫ x ln x dx = (x²/2)ln x − ∫ (x/2) dx = (x²/2)ln x − x²/4 + C. Isku-darka hadhay waa tibaax toosan oo x ah, sidaa darteed waa fudud yahay. Halbeegga doorasho fiican waa in lakabka marka la kala duwo fududaado (ln x → 1/x) loo qaato u, lakabka isku-darkiisu fudud yahayna (x) loo qaato v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.prompt: Qor jawaab Hajun. Hajun wuxuu yiri, "Ma dooran kartaa u iyo v' sida aad doonto isku-darka qaybaha?" Adigoo ∫ x ln x dx u isticmaalaya tusaale, ereyo fudud ku sharax sida si fiican loo doorto iyo sababta.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.0: ∫ x ln x dx, hel kuwee ka mid ah ln x iyo x ayaa marka la kala duwo fududaada iyo kuwee isku-darkiisu fudud yahay.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Qor waxa isku-darka hadhay doorashadaas ku noqonayo, oo u isticmaal sida caddayn aad Hajun tusto.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay halbeeg dooris, hal weedh, halkii aad ka odhan lahayd "sida aad doonto"?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma runtii ku dabaqday halbeegga ∫ x ln x dx?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ku qortay ereyo Hajun fahmi karo (ma aha kaliya liis calaamado ah)?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.0: Hajun, qaacidadu waa run sida aad u doorato, laakiin haddii isku-darka hadhay uu fududaado way ka duwan tahay. ∫ x ln x dx, waa inaad qaadataa u=ln x iyo v'=x. ln x wuu fududaadaa, 1/x, marka la kala duwo, x na isku-darkiisu waa fudud yahay. Kadibna isku-darka hadhay wuxuu noqonayaa ∫ x/2 dx oo fudud.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.1: Isku day u=ln x iyo v'=x. Halbeegga waa in lakabka marka la kala duwo fududaado loo qaato u, lakabka isku-darkiisu fudud yahayna loo qaato v'. Kadibna isku-darka hadhay waa x/2 oo keliya, kaas oo si dhakhso ah loo xalliyo. Haddii aad qaadato u=x taa beddelkeeda, waa inaad ku bilaabtaa isku-darka ln x, kaas oo ka adag.

n-m-h3-prob-06.goal: Laftaada hel lammaanno dhacdooyin jibbaarro ah oo madaxbanaan, oo sharax adigoo tiriya in isku-mid-prime noqoshadu aysan ku filnayn madaxbanaanaan.

n-m-h3-prob-06.thinking.2: Sharaxaadda tusaale lid ku ah halkaas oo lambarradu yihiin isku-mid-prime laakiin aan madaxbanaanayn
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad sawirtaa hal kaar 20 kaar oo lambarkoodu yahay 1 ilaa 20. Ha noqdo A dhacdada ah in jibbaar 3 la sawiro B-na dhacdada ah in jibbaar 4 la sawiro. Waa maxay itimaalka P(A∩B) in labada dhacdo ay wada dhacaan?

n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.a: 0: ma jiro kaar ah jibbaarka 3 iyo 4 labadaba
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in maadaama 3 iyo 4 ay yihiin isku-mid-prime, kaararku is dul dhicin. Laakiin 12 waa jibbaarka 3 iyo 4 labadaba.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.c: 1/12: maadaama 3×4=12, waa hal toban iyo laba-meel
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.c: Ma aadan tirin jibbaarrada guud oo waxaad u isticmaashay qiimaha 3×4 sidii hooseeye. Ma aadan isticmaalin xaqiiqada ah in ay jiraan 20 kaar oo keliya.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.d: 1/2: saamiga kaararka ah jibbaarrada 3 ama jibbaarrada 4
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad heshay ururinta ("ama"). Waxa aan rabnaa waa "labadaba."
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.explain: Jibbaarrada 3 waa 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 (6 kaar), jibbaarrada 4 waa 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 (5 kaar), kaar keliya, 12, ayaa labadaba ku jira. Sidaas darteed P(A∩B)=1/20, halka P(A)P(B)=6/20×5/20=3/40. Labada qiime way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed A iyo B ma madaxbanaan.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.prompt: Tirooyin dabiici ah p, q oo 2 ≤ p < q ≤ 20, hel oo gali ugu yaraan 3 lammaane oo kala duwan (p, q) oo A = "jibbaar ah p" iyo B = "jibbaar ah q" ay madaxbanaan yihiin.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tiri imisa ka mid ah 20-ka kaar ayaa jibbaarro p ah, jibbaarro q ah, iyo jibbaarro guud oo p iyo q ah, oo barbar dhig 20×(tirada kaararka labadaba ah) iyo (tirada jibbaarrada p)×(tirada jibbaarrada q).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ku bilow tirinta lammaanayaal yar gacanta, oo raadi waxa lammaanayaasha shaqeynaya wadaagaan.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dabiici ah oo 2≤p<q≤20.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ma madaxbanaana. Tiri jibbaarrada p, jibbaarrada q, iyo kaararka labadaba ah, oo barbar dhig P(A∩B) iyo P(A)P(B).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.explain: 20 kaar, lammaanayaasha suurtogalka ah waa shanta lammaane (2,3), (2,5), (2,7), (2,9), (4,5). (3,4) waa isku-aasaas ah, haddana 20×1=20 iyo 6×5=30, sidaas darteed ma madaxbanaana, (2,4) na wuxuu siinayaa 20×5=100 iyo 10×5=50, sidaas darteed ma madaxbanaana.

n-m-h3-prob-07.title: Kubbadda Koowaad Ee Aynaan Arkin: Waa Maxay Suurtogalnimada Kubbadda Labaad?
n-m-h3-prob-07.goal: Hubi sida suurtogalnimooyinku ugu is beddelaan shuruudaha marka macluumaadka tallaabo tallaabo loo muujiyo, oo fahan in macluumaadka dambe lagu bartay uu sidoo kale beddeli karo suurtogalnimada soo bixinta hore.

n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Waa maxay suurtogalnimada kubbadda labaad ee la soo saaray inay casaan tahay?

n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 5/7: kubbadda labaad waa casaan, sidaas darteed kubbadda koowaad waxay u badan tahay inay buluug ahayd

n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.reflect: Marka aynaan arkin kubbad kasta, suurtogalnimada kubbadda labaad waxay ahayd 3/8, la mid bilowga, laakiin marka aan ogaanay kubbadda koowaad way is beddeshay ilaa 2/7. n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma xisaabisay masaafada laga bilaabo P ilaa diyaarad kasta oo muujisay inay kala duwan yihiin?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ku sharaxi kartaa erayada "isla janjeer, boos kala duwan"?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.0: Xitaa haddii vector-ka caadiga ahi yahay isku mid, (1, 0, 0), diyaaradaha x=2 iyo x=5 waa diyaarado barbar socda oo kala duwan. Masaafooyinkooda laga bilaabo P(1, 1, 1) waa 1 iyo 4, kuwaas oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.1: Waxaa jira diyaarado barbar socda oo aan dhammaad lahayn oo leh isla vector caadi ah, boosaskoodana way kala duwan yihiin. Tusaale ahaan, z=0 iyo z=3 waxay leeyihiin isla caadi, laakiin masaafooyinkooda laga bilaabo P way kala duwan yihiin, 1 iyo 2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.2: Diyaaradaha z=0 iyo z=3, oo leh caadi (0,0,1), waxay ku yaalaan masaafooyin 1 iyo 2 laga bilaabo barta P(1,1,1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.3: Diyaaradaha z=1 iyo z=4 waxay leeyihiin isla vector caadi ah (0,0,1). Masaafooyinkooda laga bilaabo P waa 0 iyo 3, sidaas darteed way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.prompt: Ka soo qaad α wuxuu ka gudbaa saddexda bar A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), C(0, 0, 3). Dooro masaafada laga bilaabo P(1, 1, 1) ilaa α.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.0: Isticmaal xaqiiqada ah saddexda bar waxay ku yaalaan dhidibyada isku-duubyada si marka hore aad u dejiso isla'egta diyaaradda, oo ku hubi adigoo bedelaya saddexda bar.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi in hooseeyaha qaacidada masaafada uu yahay cabbirka vector-ka caadiga ah.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.a: Waxay u badan tahay inaad isticmaashay qiimaha laba-jibbaaran 49 hooseeyaha halkii cabbirka vector-ka caadiga ah √(36+9+4)=7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad dejisay diyaaradda sida 6x+3y+2z=6, waxaad heshay 6+3+2−6=5, waxaadna u qaybisay cabbirka caadiga ah 7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.c: Waxay u badan tahay inaadan ka jarin ereyga joogtada ah ee diyaaradda 6 qiimaha la bedelay 6+3+2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.d: Waxay u badan tahay inaad ku khaldantay xariiqyada 1, 2, 3 isku-dhufteyaasha oo aad dejisay diyaaradda sida x+2y+3z=1.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.explain: Saddexda bar waxay leeyihiin x-intercept 1, y-intercept 2, z-intercept 3, sidaas darteed diyaaraddu waa x/1+y/2+z/3=1, taas oo ah, 6x+3y+2z−6=0. Masaafada laga bilaabo P waa |6+3+2−6|/√(36+9+4)=5/7.

n-m-h3-vec-03.title: Haddii vector-yada jihaduhu barbar socdaan, ma xariiqyadu waa isku mid?
n-m-h3-vec-03.goal: Kala saar caddaynta laga helo vector-yada jihada iyo baraha laba xariiq ay ku filan tahay si loo go'aamiyo haddii ay yihiin isla xariiq, oo laftaada hubi kiis caddayntu aysan ku filnayn.
n-m-h3-vec-03.material:
Saddex xariiq meel bannaan ah waxaa lagu qoray halbeegyo t iyo s. (t iyo s waa lambarro dhab ah. l₁ waxaa loo akhriyaa "l hal," (2, −1, 1)-na waa vector-ka qaybahiisu yihiin 2, −1, 1.)
l₁: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 2) + t(2, −1, 1)
l₂: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 3) + s(−4, 2, −2)
l₃: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 4) + s(−4, 2, −2)
Mina, Hajun, Seoyun, iyo Dohyun waxay sameeyeen sheegashooyinka soo socda ee ku saabsan xidhiidhka l₁ iyo l₂.
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.0: Xukunka xidhiidhka u dhexeeya sheegashooyinka iyo caddaynta
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.1: Hubinta haddii xariiqyadu isku mid yihiin xitaa marka tibaaxuhu kala duwan yihiin
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.2: Kala saarista shuruudaha lagama maarmaanka ah iyo kuwa ku filan
n-m-h3-vec-03.prereq.0: Isla'egta vector (qaabka halbeegga) ee xariiq meel bannaan ah
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.prompt: Sheegashooyinka afarta qof ee ku saabsan l₁ iyo l₂ dhexdooda, dooro sheegashada sababaynteeda aan lahayn godad.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hubi lambarka aad ku dhufato hal vector jihada si aad u hesho kan kale.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka dibna ku beddel isku-duubyada barta l₂ ka gudubto qaacidada l₁ oo eeg haddii t ku habboon uu jiro.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.a: Mina: Vector-yada jihada (2, −1, 1) iyo (−4, 2, −2) ma siman yihiin, sidaas darteed l₁ iyo l₂ waa xariiqyo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad eegtay xaqiiqada ah in vector-yada jihadu aysan ahayn isla tibaax oo keliya. Marka xariiq la go'aaminayo, vector jiho waxaa loo qori karaa dherer iyo jiho (calaamad) kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Vector-yada jihada (2, −1, 1) iyo (−4, 2, −2) waa barbar socdaan, sidaas darteed l₁ iyo l₂ waa isla xariiq.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.b: Gabagabadu waa sax laakiin sababaynta ma ku filna. Xariiqyada vector-yada jihadooda oo keliya barbar socda waxay noqon karaan xariiqyo barbar socda oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.c: Seoyun: Vector-yada jihada (2, −1, 1) iyo (−4, 2, −2) ma barbar socdaan, sidaas darteed l₁ iyo l₂ waa skew.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.c: (−4, 2, −2) waa −2 jeer (2, −1, 1), sidaas darteed waa barbar socdaan. Xitaa ma aadan hubin xisaabta haddii ay barbar socdaan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.d: Dohyun: Vector-yada jihadu waa barbar socdaan barta (3, −1, 3) ee l₂ ka gudubto-na waxay ku taal l₁, sidaas darteed labada xariiq waa isla xariiq.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.d: Jihooyinku waa isku mid oo waxay wadaagaan bar, sidaas darteed xariiqyadu way is dul dhacaan. Labada shuruudood waxaa loo hubiyay sidii caddayn.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.explain: (−4, 2, −2)=−2(2, −1, 1), sidaas darteed vector-yada jihadu waa barbar socdaan. Sidoo kale, gelinta t=1 l₁ waxay siinaysaa (3, −1, 3), sidaas darteed barta l₂ waxay ku taal l₁. Haddii jihooyinku barbar socdaan oo hal bar is dul dhacdo, xariiqyadu waa isla xariiq. Vector-yada jihada barbar socda oo keliya ma ku filna, vector-yada jihada oo aan ahayn isla tibaax-na macnaheedu ma aha xariiqyadu waa kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.prompt: Markan, barbar dhig l₃ (bar (3, −1, 4), vector jiho (−4, 2, −2)) iyo l₁. Go'aami haddii labada xariiq ay yihiin isla xariiq, oo qor sababaynta go'aankaaga iyo xisaabtaada.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ku waafaji isku-duubyada x iyo y ee barta l₃ (3, −1, 4) qaacidada l₁ oo hel t.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal t kaas si aad u xisaabiso isku-duubka z sidoo kale oo barbar dhig barta l₃.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Vector-ka jihada l₃ waa ... barta l₃-na waa ...
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore hubisay in vector-yada jihadu barbar socdaan?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma bedeshay barta l₃ qaacidada l₁ oo barbar dhigtay dhammaan saddexda isku-duub?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma tiri "xariiqyadu waxay yeelan karaan jihooyin barbar socda iyadoo aysan ahayn isla xariiq"?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.0: Vector-ka jihada l₃ waa −2 jeer kan l₁, sidaas darteed waa barbar socdaan. Laakiin haddii aan geliyo barta l₃ (3, −1, 4) l₁, x iyo y waxay siinayaan t=1, ka dibna z=3, taas oo ka duwan 4, sidaas darteed barta ma ku taal l₁. Sidaas darteed waa barbar socdaan laakiin ma aha isla xariiq.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.1: Xitaa isla jiho, ma odhan karno waa isla xariiq. Laga bilaabo (1+2t, −t, 2+t)=(3, −1, 4), labada isla'eg ee ugu horreeya waxay siinayaan t=1 laakiin kan saddexaad wuxuu siinayaa t=2, is-diidmo. Barta ma ku taal l₁, sidaas darteed waa xariiqyo barbar socda oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.prompt: Dooro xidhiidhka xariiqda l₄: (x, y, z) = (5, −2, 4) + u(−6, 3, −3) iyo l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore hel xidhiidhka jibbaarka u dhexeeya vector-yada jihada.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ku beddel barta l₄ qaacidada l₁ si aad u hubiso haddii ay ku taal l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.a: Waxay barbar socotaa l₁ laakiin waa xariiq ka duwan
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad hubisay oo keliya in vector-yada jihadu barbar socdaan mana aadan hubin haddii barta ay ku taal l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.b: Doorashadani waxay hubisay labadaba in vector-yada jihadu barbar socdaan iyo in barta ay ku taal l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.c: Waxay la kulantaa l₁ hal bar oo keliya
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.c: Laba xariiq oo vector-yada jihadooda barbar socdaan ma kulmi karaan hal bar oo keliya. Haddii ay kulmaan, way is dul dhacaan; haddii kale ma kulmaan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.d: Laba xariiq oo vector-yada jihadooda barbar socdaan ma noqon karaan skew. Xariiqyada skew ma aha kuwo barbar socda ama is goysa.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.explain: (−6, 3, −3)=−3(2, −1, 1), sidaas darteed waa barbar socdaan. Gelinta t=2 l₁ waxay siinaysaa (5, −2, 4), sidaas darteed barta l₄ waxay ku taal l₁. Sidaas darteed l₄ waa isla xariiq l₁. Isla xariiqda waxaa lagu muujin karaa doorasho kasta oo bar iyo vector jiho ah.

n-m-h3-vec-05.title: Samaynta Xariiq Aan La Kulmin Dhidib
n-m-h3-vec-05.goal: Ha ka fikirin shuruudda xariiq aan la kulmin dhidib sida hal shuruud oo vector-ka jihada ah; sidoo kale tixgeli kiiska xariiqdu ku jirto dhidibka, oo samee tusaalayaal.
n-m-h3-vec-05.material: Booska waxaa ku jira dhidib α: x + y − 2z = 0. Waxaad rabtaa inaad samayso xariiq l oo marta barta (p, 1, 1) oo leh vector jihada (a, b, c) si aysan u kulmin α. (l waxaa loo akhriyaa "el," p waa tiro dhan, vector-ka jihada (a, b, c) na waa vector-ka qaybahiisu yihiin a, b, c.)
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.0: Naftaada u samaynta tusaalayaal buuxiya shuruudaha
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.1: Hubinta xadka u dhexeeya barbar-socod iyo ku jirid
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.2: Go'aaminta meesha xariiq ee dhidib marka loo eego laba shuruudood
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.0: Isla'egta xariiq iyo isla'egta dhidib booska
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.1: Vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidib iyo wax-soo-saarka dot
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro (p, a, b, c) si xariiqda l: (x, y, z) = (p, 1, 1) + t(a, b, c) aysan u kulmin dhidibka α: x + y − 2z = 0. p, a, b, c waa tirooyin dhan (a, b, c) na waa inaanu ahaan vector eber ah. Si vector-yo jihada isku jihada ah loo soo celin, qaybiyaha guud ugu weyn ee a, b, c waa inuu noqdaa 1, a>0 ama (a=0 iyo b>0). Samee saddex tusaale oo leh vector-yo jihada oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami xiriirka vector-ka jihada iyo vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidibku waa inuu leeyahay si xariiqdu ula barbar-socoto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka dib samaynta hal tusaale, sidoo kale hubi haddii bar xariiqda ku taal ay ku taal dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.a: Qaybta x a ee vector-ka jihada
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.b: Qaybta y b ee vector-ka jihada
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.c: Qaybta z c ee vector-ka jihada
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c1: p, a, b, c waa tirooyin dhan oo qiimahooda saxda ah ugu badnaan 50.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c1: p, a, b, c waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo qiimahooda saxda ah ugu badnaan 50.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c2: Vector-ka jihada ma aha vector eber ah, qaybiyaha guud ugu weyni waa 1, shuruudda calaamaddu sidoo kale way qabataa.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Vector-ka jihada waa inaanu ahaan vector eber ah, qaybiyaha guud ugu weyni waa inuu noqdaa 1, a>0 ama (a=0 iyo b>0).
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c3: Vector-ka jihada wuxuu ka toosan yahay vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Hubi xiriirka u dhexeeya vector-ka jihada iyo vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidibka (1, 1, −2) si jihada xariiqdu ula barbar-socoto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c4: Barta xariiqda ku taal kuma jirto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Hubi haddii xariiqdu aysan la kulmin dhidibka xitaa hal bar, iyo haddii barta (p, 1, 1) ee xariiqda ku taal ay ku jirto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.explain: Vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidibku waa (1, 1, −2). Si xariiq aysan u kulmin dhidibka, vector-ka jihadeedu waa inuu ka toosan yahay vector-ka caadiga ah, sidaas darteed a+b−2c=0. Laakiin taasi keligeed waxay u ogolaan kartaa xariiqda inay ku jirto dhidibka. Haddii barta (p, 1, 1) ee xariiqda ku taal ay ku jirto dhidibka (p+1−2=0, taasi waa, p=1), xariiqda oo dhan waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka. Sidaas darteed p≠1 ayaa sidoo kale loo baahan yahay.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.prompt: Sharax sababta aadan u isticmaali karin vector jihada buuxinaya a+b−2c=0 marka p=1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.0: Marka p=1, geli isku-xigeennada barta xariiqdu marto isla'egta dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa ku dhaca baraha kale ee xariiqda ku taal marka shuruudda vector-ka jihada sidoo kale la isticmaalo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.placeholder: tus. Haddii p=1, bar xariiqda ku taal ...
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ma xisaabisay haddii barta (1, 1, 1) ee xariiqda ku taal ay ku jirto dhidibka x+y−2z=0 marka p=1?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi kartaa sababta shuruudda vector-ka jihada keligeed aysan dammaanad qaadin "ma kulmo"?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.0: Haddii p=1, barta (1, 1, 1) ee xariiqdu marto waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka. Haddii jihaduna sidoo kale ay barbar-socoto dhidibka, bar kasta oo xariiqda ku taal waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka, sidaas darteed xariiqdu waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka. Markaas ma ahan inaysan la kulmin dhidibka; waxay la kulantaa baro aan dhammaad lahayn.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.1: Haddii p=1, (1,1,1) wuxuu buuxiyaa dhidibka x+y−2z=0, sidaas darteed bar xariiqda ku taal waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka. Vector-ka jihada wuxuu ka toosan yahay caadiga, sidaas darteed xariiqda oo dhan waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka, taasoo ka dhigaysa mid ku jirta halkii barbar-socod.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.prompt: Dooro xiriirka u dhexeeya xariiqda m: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 0) + t(0, 1, 1) iyo dhidibka β: y − z = 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore xisaabi wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-ka jihada iyo vector-ka caadiga ah ee dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.1: Geli isku-xigeennada barta xariiqdu marto isla'egta dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.a: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaadan hubin haddii wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-ka jihada iyo vector-ka caadiga ah (0, 1, −1) uu yahay 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.b: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad hubisay oo keliya in jihadu ay barbar-socoto dhidibka oo aadan hubin haddii barta xariiqda ku taal ay ku jirto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.c: Doorashadani waxay hubisay in vector-ka jihada uu ka toosan yahay caadiga ah iyo in barta (1, 0, 0) ee xariiqda ku taal ay ku jirto dhidibka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.o.d: Xariiqdu waxay ka toosan tahay dhidibka
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.d: Haddii vector-ka jihada uu ka toosan yahay vector-ka caadiga ah, xariiqdu waxay barbar-socotaa dhidibka. Si ay uga toosan tahay dhidibka, vector-ka jihada waa inuu barbar-socdaa vector-ka caadiga ah.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.explain: Wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-ka jihada (0, 1, 1) iyo vector-ka caadiga ah (0, 1, −1) waa 0, sidaas darteed xariiqdu waxay barbar-socotaa dhidibka. Sidoo kale, barta (1, 0, 0) waxay buuxisaa y−z=0, sidaas darteed waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka. Sidaas darteed xariiqdu waxay ku jirtaa dhidibka.

n-m-h3-vec-06.title: U Sharaxidda Walaal Yar Oo Aan Weli Aqoonin Cosine Wax-soo-saarka Dot
n-m-h3-vec-06.goal: Sharax macnaha wax-soo-saarka dot (hal tiro oo muujinaysa inta laba vector ay isku jihada u dhigan yihiin) dhagaystayaal aan aqoonin cosine, adigoo beddelaya xaaladda.
n-m-h3-vec-06.material: Jisu waxay u sharaxday wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-yada walaasheeda/walaalkeeda yar ee fasalka 7aad sidan: "Wax-soo-saarka dot ee laba vector a iyo b waa |a||b|cosθ. Waxaad si fudud ugu dhufataa qaybaha oo isku darta, waana 0 haddii ay is-toosan yihiin." Walaalkeedu weli ma baran cos, sidaas darteed wuxuu dib u weydiiyay, "Laakiin wax-soo-saarka dot waa maxay?" (|a| waa cabbirka a, θ waxaa loo akhriyaa "theta," cos na waa cosine.)
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.0: Beddelidda erayada si ay ugu habboonaadaan dhagaystayaasha
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.2: Sharaxidda sidoo kale kiisaska jihada ka soo horjeeda iyo is-toosnaanta
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.0: Qeexidda wax-soo-saarka dot iyo xagalka u dhexeeya laba vector
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.1: Calaamadda wax-soo-saarka dot iyo shuruudda is-toosnaanta
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.prompt: Dooro jumladda ugu fiican ee sharraxaysa macnaha wax-soo-saarka dot erayo uu walaalkaa fahmi karo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore sheeg haddii jumlad kasta ay sheegayso natiijada wax-soo-saarka dot inay tahay tiro mise vector.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.1: Jumlad kasta mid mid ku tijaabi marka labada vector ay isku jihada u dhigan yihiin, is-toosan yihiin, iyo jihooyin ka soo horjeeda u dhigan yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.a: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa hal tiro oo muujinaysa inta vector uu ugu jihada u dhigan yahay kan kale, iyadoo cabbirkooda la tixgelinayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.a: Sharraxaaddan waxay qabataa dhammaan sifooyinka wax-soo-saarka dot: way sii weynaataa marka jihooyinku sii isku waafaqaan, waa 0 marka is-toosan yihiin, waana taban marka ay jihooyin ka soo horjeeda u dhigan yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.b: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa xisaab ku dhufata qaybaha labada vector midba midka kale si loo sameeyo vector cusub. Natiijaduna sidoo kale waa fallaadh.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.b: Natiijada wax-soo-saarka dot ma aha vector laakiin waa hal tiro. Waxaad isku qaldday habka xisaabta iyo nooca natiijada.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.c: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa wax-soo-saarka cabbirrada labada vector. Wuxuu siinayaa isla qiime jihada labada fallaadh ee ay u dhigan yihiin ha ahaadeene.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.c: Qiimaha wax-soo-saarka dot wuxuu ku xidhan yahay xagalka u dhexeeya labada vector. Sharraxaaddan waxay iska indhatirtaa jihada.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.d: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa qiime kuu sheegaya xagalka u dhexeeya laba vector digrii ahaan. Haddii ay yihiin xagal-qumman, waxaad heshaa 90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.d: Wax-soo-saarka dot ma aha xagalka laftiisa. Xagal-qumman, wax-soo-saarka dot waa 0, ma aha 90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.explain: Wax-soo-saarka dot waa hal tiro ku xidhan labadaba cabbirka labada vector iyo xagalka u dhexeeya. Way sii weynaataa marka jihooyinku sii isu eg yihiin, waa 0 marka is-toosan yihiin, waana taban marka ay jihooyin ka soo horjeeda u dhigan yihiin. A wuxuu natiijada u qaatay vector, B wuxuu iska indhatiray jihada, D na wuxuu isku qaldeen xagalka laftiisa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.prompt: Hadda naftaada u qor sharraxaadda aad u dirayso walaalkaa. (1) U sharax muuqaalka jiidista xiimad xadhig, (2) barbar dhig jiidista isla jihada xiimadu ku socoto iyo jiidista is-toosan (kor), iyo (3) ha isticmaalin erayada sida cos, θ, ama saadaal.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qiyaas kiiska jihada xiimadu ku socoto iyo jihada xadhigu jiido ay isku mid yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kadibna ka fikir inta loo isticmaalo socodka hore marka jiidista xadhigu ay xagal-qumman ku tahay jihada dhaqdhaqaaqa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.placeholder: tus. Marka aad xiimad xadhig ku jiidid, ...

n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma erayo ku dhigtay "inta isla jihada loo isticmaalo" halkii aad ka qori lahayd qaacido?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.0: Marka aad xiimad xadhig ku jiidid, haddii xadhigu uu ku yaal isla jihada xiimaddu ku socoto, xooggaaga oo dhan wuxuu galaa socodka hore. Haddii xadhigu janjeero, qayb ka mid ah xoogga oo keliya ayaa la isticmaalaa, haddii aad si toos ah samada u jiidid, midna kuma gelayo socodka hore, sidaas darteed waa 0. Wax-soo-saarka dot waa hal tiro kuu sheegaysa inta xoogga ee jihada uu u socdo la isticmaalo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.1: Marka aad gaadhi gacan riixdo, wuxuu si fiican u socdaa marka aad ku riixdo isla jihada uu u socdo. Haddii jihadu wax yar ka leexato, si yar ayuu u socdaa, haddii aad dhinaca ku riixdo xagal-qumman na, gaadhigu kuma caawinayo inuu hore u socdo, sidaas darteed waa 0. Wax-soo-saarka dot waa tiro muujinaysa inta laba fallaadh ay isku jihada u dhigan yihiin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.2: Haddii aad xadhigga kor u jiidid, midna kuma gelayo socodka hore, sidaas darteed waa 0. Haddii saxda ah ay tahay jihada xiimaddu ku socoto, xoogga oo dhan waa la isticmaalaa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.3: Haddii aad si toos ah ugu jiidid jihada xiimaddu ku socoto, xoogga oo dhan waa la isticmaalaa, haddii ay janjeerto na qayb oo keliya ayaa la isticmaalaa. Xagal-qumman, waa 0.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.prompt: Walaalkaa wuxuu weydiiyay, "Markaas muuqaalkee ayaa wax-soo-saarka dot uu ku yahay taban?" Dooro kan ku habboon muuqaalka xiimadda.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.0: Isla jihada, is-toosan, iyo jihada ka soo horjeeda, qor haddii mid walba caawiyo ama dhibaya socodka hore.

n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.b: Marka xadhigga kor loo jiido xagal-qumman
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.c: Marka xadhigu jiido ka soo horjeedka jihada xiimaddu ku socoto

n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.d: Jiho janjeedha ee dhinaca isku mid ah, wax-soo-saarka dot waa togan yahay xagalkuna wuu ka yar yahay 90°.

Muuqaalka xiimadda, jiidista dhinaca kale waxay dhibtaa socodka hore, sidaas darteed waxay u dhigantaa qiime taban.

n-m-h3-vec-07.title: Haddii Laba Dhidib Aysan Barbar-socon, Saddexda Dhidib Ma Ku Kulmaan Hal Bar?
n-m-h3-vec-07.goal: Hubi saadaal ku saabsan meelaha saddex dhidib adigoo isticmaalaya tusaale lid ku ah aad naftaada samaysay, oo sharax qaab dhismeedka tusaalaha lid ku ahi leeyahay.
n-m-h3-vec-07.material: Ka fikir saddex dhidib oo kala duwan. Saaxiib ayaa yidhi haddii laba ka mid ah dhidibyada aysan barbar-socon, saddexda dhidib had iyo jeer waxay ku kulmaan hal bar. Labada dhidib x=0 iyo y=0 ma barbar-socdaan, waxayna ku kulmaan xariiq. (x=0 waxaa loo akhriyaa "x le'eg 0," ax+by+cz=d na waa isla'egta dhidib.)
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.0: Tijaabinta saadaal adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal aad naftaada samaysay
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.1: Helidda shuruudaha loo baahan yahay in lagu sameeyo tusaale lid ku ah
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.2: Sharaxidda meelaha adigoo isticmaalaya habaynta xariiqyada isgoyska
n-m-h3-vec-07.prereq.0: Isla'egta dhidib iyo vector-ka caadiga ah
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hel xariiqda ay ku kulmaan dhidibyada x=0 iyo y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii waxa ay wadaagaan is beddelaan iyadoo ku xidhan sida dhidibka saddexaad ugu kulmo xariiqdaas.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.a: Had iyo jeer run ma aha. Waxaa jira kiisas saddexda dhidib aysan lahayn bar guud
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.a: Xukunkani sidoo kale wuxuu tixgeliyay xiriirka u dhexeeya xariiqda ay laba dhidib ku kulmaan iyo dhidibka saddexaad.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.b: Had iyo jeer waa run. Dhidibyada aan barbar-socon way kulmaan, sidaas darteed saddex dhidib sidoo kale waxay ku kulmaan hal bar
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.b: Laba dhidib oo lammaane lammaane ah ku kulmaya iyo saddex dhidib oo leh bar guud waa arrimo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.c: Had iyo jeer run ma aha. Laakiin waxaa jira laba kiis oo keliya: ku kulmidda bar ama xariiq
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.c: Ma baarin kiiska aan lahayn bar guud. Ka fikir kiiska dhidibka saddexaad uu barbar-socdo xariiqda isgoyska ee labada dhidib ee ugu horreeya.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.d: Had iyo jeer waa run. Saddexda dhidib ma kulmaan marka laba ka mid ah ay barbar-socdaan oo keliya
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.d: Kani waa xukun aan si toos ah u hubin haddii bar guud la'aan ay suurtogal tahay xitaa dhidibyo barbar-socda la'aan.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.explain: Dhidibyada x=0 iyo y=0 waxay ku kulmaan dhidibka z. Natiijadu waxay ku xidhan tahay haddii dhidibka saddexaad uu la kulmo xariiqdan ama aanu la kulmin. Xitaa haddii laba ka mid ah saddexda dhidib aysan barbar-socon, waxaa laga yaabaa inayan lahayn bar guud. Hubi haddii tani run tahay adigoo naftaada u samaynaya tusaale.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.prompt: Waxaa jira dhidibyada x=0 iyo y=0. Dooro dhidib saddexaad ax + by + cz = d si laba ka mid ah saddexda dhidib aysan barbar-socon oo saddexda dhidib aysan lahayn bar guud. a, b, c, d waa tirooyin run ah. Samee saddex dhidib oo kala duwan.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore ogow halka xariiqda ay ku kulmaan dhidibyada x=0 iyo y=0 ay tahay.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir qaabkee ay isla'egtu tahay inay yeelato si aysan bar xariiqdaas ku taal u buuxin dhidibka saddexaad.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Dhidibka saddexaad ma barbar-socdo dhidibka x=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Dhidibka saddexaad wuxuu barbar-socdaa dhidibka x=0. Hubi haddii vector-ka caadiga ah (a, b, c) uu barbar-socdo (1, 0, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Dhidibka saddexaad ma barbar-socdo dhidibka y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Dusha saddexaad waxay la barbar socotaa dusha y=0. Hubi haddii vector-ka caadiga ah (a, b, c) uu la barbar socdo (0, 1, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Bar ay saddexda dusha oo dhan ka gudbaan ma jirto.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Waxaa jirta bar ay saddexda dusha oo dhan ka gudbaan. Hubi haddii barta xariiqda ay dusha x=0 iyo y=0 ku kulmaan ay saran tahay dusha saddexaad.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.explain: Dusha x=0 iyo y=0 waxay ku kulmaan dhidibka z. Haddii dusha saddexaad ay ka gudubto xitaa hal bar oo dhidibka z ku taal, saddexda dusha waxay leeyihiin bar guud. Beddelka barta (0, 0, z) ee dhidibka z waxay siinaysaa cz=d, si z midna uusan u buuxin tan waxaan u baahanahay c=0 iyo d≠0. Sidoo kale, a iyo b waa inaysan eber ahayn si dushu ugu noqon karto mid aan la barbar socon x=0 iyo y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.prompt: Adigoo qaadanaya mid ka mid ah dusha aad samaysay sida tusaale, sharax sababta saddexda dusha ay laba-laba ugu kulmaan laakiin aanay bar guud u lahayn saddexdaba.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor waxa dhaca marka aad barta xariiqda ay samaystaan x=0 iyo y=0 ku beddesho dusha aad samaysay.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir sida saddexda xariiq ee ka dhasha marka dusha laba-laba ay ku kulmaan ay isu xiriiraan.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Xariiqda ay x=0 iyo y=0 ku kulmaan waa ..., dusha saddexaad na ...
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma tiri sida saddexda xariiq ee isgoysyada dusha loo habeeyey?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma muujisay qaacidada sababta dusha saddexaad ugu kulmi waayo dhidibka z?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma kala saartay inay laba-laba kulmaan laakiin aanay saddexdaba wada kulmin?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.0: Qaado x+y=1, tusaale ahaan. x=0 iyo y=0 waxay ku kulmaan dhidibka z, laakiin x+y=1 waa la barbar socda dhidibka z, barta dhidibka z ku taal na waxay leedahay x+y=0, sidaas darteed ma buuxin kartid dushan. Laba dusha midna ma la barbar socdo, laakiin bar guud oo saddexda oo dhan ka dhexeysa ma jirto.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.1: Saddexda xariiq ee isgoysyada dusha dhammaantood waa xariiqyo la barbar socda dhidibka z. Sida saddexda wejiyada dhinaca ee prism saddexagal, dushu laba-laba ayay ku kulmaan, laakiin bar saddexdaba wada ka gudbaan ma jirto.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.2: x+y=1 waa la barbar socda dhidibka z. Gelinta barta (0,0,z) ee dhidibka z waxay siinaysaa 0=1, taasoo suurtagal ahayn, sidaas darteed bar guud oo saddexda dusha ah ma jirto.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.3: Dhidibka z wuxuu la barbar socdaa dusha saddexaad, sidaas darteed ma kulmaan. Sidaas darteed dushu laba-laba ayay kulmaan, laakiin bar ay saddexdaba wada kulmaan ma jirto.
